reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sand and snorkeling but very crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great, sandy beach with good, mild snorkeling. The downside is the small beach that is very crowded. It's a good beach if you don't mind strangers being on top of you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach and water. Waves can get a bit rough for the keiki (kids).  Sand is gold and soft.  Absolutely beautiful. Note- can be a bit crowded since all the resorts line the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The clear and show water on this beach will let you see the ocean floor at about 6 feet. If you go a little bit inside to the ocean with snorkeling gear, you could swim with the sea turtles for free.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a great beach but can get very crowded! You definitely want to get there early to avoid all of the crowds and find a good spot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but getting overused
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach but Black Rock snorkeling is getting way overused. The turtles rarely even come in that area anymore because there are so many people. Granted this is December which is a very popular time of year. Lots of jumpers at black rock cliff diving. My prediction unfortunately is it that will soon be closed off and the snorkeling will have to be restricted for environmental reasons. This is a gem the speech and I hope that it is looked after and protected

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, snorkeling and fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On days when the currents or waves are less, it is a brilliant snorkel! Swam with 2 turtles, some fish next to the black rock

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice resort area that had great swimming and snorkeling, along with other places to go and things to do.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing!!😍 Clean, nice store front, shops places to eat and get drinks. Everyone is very kind and sweet. So many places to stop at with beautiful views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is a trail going along the beach for about 2 miles. Nice morning or evening walk. The beach is very nice, clean. Be careful of sudden waves and currents!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent spot  so much care is taken to keep everything pristine and tidy and there pride taken in it golden sands on Pacific Ocean safe enough to swim but exercise caution

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for snorkelling and swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water is crystal clear and great for snorkeling and swimming. Beautiful blue Ayer and loads of fish and if your lucky turtles. Take the go pro for underwater photos. Not a lot of shade

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean with shower and restroom. Big wave and too deep for young children...It is really American style vacation...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing Beachside
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at Westin Ocean Villas with access to this beach spent a day or two here waters were very clean, warm, and was not overly crowded except for sunset time did pick up. Recommend wearing water shoes if you are not snorkeling as there are rocks and coral around. Great spot for every day snorkel even a turtle or two will visit. Waters were not too crazy and easy to swim. Excellent beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A big and beautiful beach with plenty of room, great spots to snorkel. The Black Rock is a must-do for first-timers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are several public areas, but some of the beach is private or restricted access with hotels on the north end. I highly recommend staying at one if those hotels from the Sheraton north to The Aston. No sea shell to pick up. Great sand. If you go to the public beach, take chairs. There is a grocery store across from the Aston that sells chairs (and vodka). A must go to is “Java Jazz” for a drink or great food. There is a coffee bar but the food is wonderful so don’t be fooled by the name.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too many aggressive sales people.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The actual beach is awesome. The waves can seem really scary for little kids, as my kid was totally intimidated. My only complaint is how aggressive the sales people are. The people at the ‘excursion deals’ desks were really annoying and really aggressive. They are trying to recruit people to ‘take a look’ at a timeshare unit. I started dreading doing the walk to Whaler’s Village.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach and snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Find the covered public parking and walk to beach access.  Great swimming and sunning beach and snorkeling on right side at black Rock

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just plain beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was so close to our hotel that it was unfair! We walked there every day and loved the softness of the sand and the whole beach in general.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Maui Trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So beautiful.  Stayed at the Royal Lahaina.  Can’t wait to go back!  Perfect vacation. Lots of activities for kids; lots of relaxing for adults

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Windy beach on the west Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arriving here by ATR-72-500, shaked by the wind before landing,I found this beach is one of the best place for surfing ,strong wind, high tides,less precipitation, always sunshine.However, the resorts and hotels in this area are so bloody expensive, for water activities lovers,Don"t miss this beach.it's easily connected with Lahaina and Kahului by public buses or private car on the veru wide laned highway.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali beach is beautiful. Just be aware the surf can be pretty rough depending on the time of year. It is not a super large sandy beach in areas. Gorgeous sunsets. They had a nice craft fair while we were there. The area is undergoing some remodeling. You can walk to Whalers village and Black rock.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach by Black Rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We wanted to visit Ka’anapali Beach & do some snorkeling there. We weren’t staying in the area so we needed to hunt down the free parking lots in the area. It took a while of searching & waiting but we snagged a spot. It was quite the walk with chairs, backpacks with snorkel gear to get to our snorkeling destination. We walked the path & had some nice views of the beautiful beach along with eateries & hotels. The sand is soft & the water is pretty calm & warm. There were plenty of fish & turtles to see as we snorkeled.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed on this beach and it was beautiful.  Water was so clear, highly recommend it.  And the sunsets - WOW

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love Ka'anapali Beach!  We stayed at the Sheraton Maui on Ka'anapali beach and loved it too!  Black Rock rocks!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Black Rock was our best snorkel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Turtles at Black Rock was absolutely our highlight snorkel of the trip (remember to stay at least 5ft from them, don't harass protected wildlife). Go early to avoid crowds and watch out for people jumping off the rock into the sea. Also there is very little public parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning & easiest way to get my 10,000 steps in!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can walk on the beach or a walkway.  There are hotels, water activities & restaurants along the way &, in the morning, yoga.  At the Sheraton end, you can bring your snorkeling equipment & swim with the sea turtles along the black rock.    There's also the delightful Whalers Village to explore along the way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach was right there in front of our Kaanapali Ali beach resort and pool.  The beach was so sandy and went forever.  I and others were all old farts that are crowding 70.  I just had two new hips put in and i went down a 10 ft sand bank to get wet.  I wanted to walk out from where the beach sand is being pulled out.  12 waves went by and I felt confident.  It was that 13 wave that was bigger than me and slammed me down under and pulled me out to sea.  It was strange I still had my Army Jungle hat still on.  I seen a RED FLAG flying on shore.  oooops that means conditions are right for under tows.  Care Takers of resorts are always watching and made sure I was alright as young beach goes laughed.  Hips were woke up and had more respect for Flags on the beach after that.  Fun all up and down the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach of Dreams
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You know there are places that you’ve never been to before and as soon you hear about them you know you’re going to love them and you hope they end up being as good as the picture you’ve cooked up inside your head? This beach is that good, everything you’ve been dreaming about. Exceptionally pretty, just big enough, not too crowded. Things that make you say “Ahhhhhhhh!!!”

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Warm water, easily one can spent 4-5 hours, lot of water activities to do, rental stores located in beach, one can get all sort of fun at one place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Sandy Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great sandy beach with clear blue water. Good snorkeling at Black Rock. Can get really windy & sand will blow in your face & eyes, so better in the morning. Highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went here whilst in the area, its a lovely beach to sit and people watch also very clean too. I would recommend and return here

reviewsWithKeywords.title: As Beautiful As it Looks!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The places located at Ka'anapali Beach are as beautiful as you may have seen or heard. My number one choice on the island. I recently stayed at a place north of Ka'anapali and was not very happy. I was hoping when I booked it that it was better but this location is so hard to beat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, no facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tough to find the public entrance, but the beach path for the public is directly next to the Hyatt where there is a small free public parking. Not too crowded but couldn't find any public bathroom facilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hotel was on this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful strip of beach in front of our hotel.  A short walk to the water, so not to big of a beach.  But oh what sunsets!!  Absolutely spectacular.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sea Turtles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I took my daughter here for her 16th birthday, we did may things. She loved this beach best. We parked at the Sheraton. Which is the only way to do it. Unless there is another hidden way. But if u get lucky. There is free parking right by Sheraton. Like the next turn on your right.  Maybe 100 feet. But there is only 15 parking spots or so. It was weird walking through the Sheraton,  but we couldn't  find any other way. The beach was clean, the waves weren't huge. And we saw a sea Turtle and tons of fish. Right by the black rock. We rented snorkel gear, on the beach by Sheraton. And ate lunch there as well. It was amazing. Would  recommend

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect in Every way
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing spot for a sunset. Clouds, mountains, palm trees.Perfectly Hawaii. Great spot for a picnic, relaxing in the shade at sunset, wading, swimming, or surfing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a gem for swimming, snorkeling, whale watching-during humpback season, great lodging-esp. the Westin Ka'anapali ocean resort villas , outstanding dining, excellent craft shows and great people watching.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful  beach with astounding views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: wow what can i say?  this is the best beach location in the world with crystal blue sea and beautiful views of Lanai and Molokai.  So clean and water was 78 degrees so like a bath.  Word of warning though, the sea is really inviting but dangerous as the are strong currents.  We stay here every year and we have seen some really strong waves coming in at times, and unexpected soaking sunbathers and sweeping away belongings.  Fun to enjoy and warm too but be careful and heed red flags when out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach anywhere?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at Kaanapali is always perfect.Not too busy, not too rough, but some fun waves.Frequented mostly by the resort crowd from the Sheraton, the Whaler, the Weston etc. The beach has a gradual drop off and a favourite of kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bring towels. Very clean area. Felt safe. Also be sure to bring lawn chairs if you need them. Family friendly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's a beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We do not spend time on the beach because we prefer the pool but it was great hearing the crashing waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super fun trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Scuba lahaina Kaanapali in2scuba rocks!Lots of restaurants to choose from.The beach is endlessLove the shopsTiki torches at night were beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good family place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The hotel rooms could really stand to be updated, but it is clean, friendly and a good value. They are on the beach and have a pool.too. You are also within walking distance from Whalers village and a short drive to Lahaina with lots of restaurants and shops

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Major disappointment in this highly anticipated beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think this beach gets good reviews due to tourists that stay at one of the many condos lining it. If you are staying there, then I'm sure it's a good one for you. But, we drove there based on great reviews. First, couldn't figure out how to get to the beach. Ended up in serval condo parking lots and by accident found a public parking lot with one spot left. Took a bush lined walking path to beach. Beach is long and wide swath of sand. The sand was deep and hot, hot, hot. Had to wear flip flops to make it near the water. Then, crazy is there was a sandy ledge then you drop down a couple feet to get to another  sandy area that gradually went into the water. Remember, you have to climb back up it. Mistakenly, that's a key word, we found a spot near this ledge and got comfortable. Yikes, we got attacked by a giant wave that came up and over that ledge and totally engulfed us in salt water and sand. Someday I may laugh about it, but that day hasn't come yet. All I could say was that's it, I'm done. Oh, and add to that there were too many people, the view was condos on one side and on the other wasn't even endless ocean views. No shade on beach. I swear the condo's landscape so shade just covers their property and the boardwalk. Should have stopped along the road where the locals were parked and enjoying the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely stunning beach with one of a kind views!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka’anapali Beach is gorgeous for its soft and inviting sands alone, but what makes it truly special is is location between other neighboring islands that paints a beautiful landscape. The way the nearby island‘s clouds form at the peek of Lanai with rays of sunlight piercing through create a picturesque view be in the morning glory or whilst watching a warm sunset. In the morning, the waters are calm and like glass, in the afternoon and around dusk the waves start to barrel nicely making this a fun destination for boogie boarding but the water no matter the time of day is crystal clear and purified by volcanic sediment over millennia. Have fun and happy beach going my friends 😎🤙🏼

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach by high rise hotels
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I took a snorkeling trip which initiated on this beach. Shops and hotels butt up against it, and it wasn't too crowded in October. The water was warm and waves not too high to swim. The beach was clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach! Had a great time with Mother and sister staying at the Mana Kai in September 2019. I will be returning in Dec to check out another location ( Sugar Beach Resort). Hope it is as nice as Mana Kai.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but lots of other people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kaapanapali isn’t Waikiki, but I’m afraid it’s headed that way. Too much tourism, too many high end shops, not enough parking, it’s just too much. Still, beautiful, but....  we will see what it’s like in another five years.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka’anapali beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was beautiful! The water was blue and you can snorkel to see tropical fish.the sand is coarse, not sugary. Paradise!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Favorite Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous views, beautiful water, sand is soft and you can snorkel right off the beach in places.  I cannot wait to return.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My second favorite beach in the world!  I Love the walk along the beach!  Lots of sand and soft areas.  Cliff jumping, all activities and very nice people!  Highly recommended!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a resort on Ka'anapali beach and loved being able to snorkel without having to drive and fight for parking space somewhere else. We did try quite a few of the other beaches and there are some great ones, but when it came down to it, we saw beautiful fish, sea turtles, etc, right there, making it our favorite place to snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We Loved This Beach (Black Rock Area)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Sheraton Maui Resort and Spa, which is directly on Kaanapali Beach, at Black Rock.  Therefore, we hit up this portion of the beach each day during our visit.•It’s a clean, wide beach with lots of space and plenty of beautiful blue water and sandy bottom.  It goes for about three miles I believe.  Black Rock seems to provide a bit of a barrier from the waves where we swam.  It was always pretty calm in this area.   Although, if you venture out to the point where Black Rock ends, the currents really picked up.•Even at peak times (at least in October), the beach never seemed overcrowded.•We would snorkel each morning at Black Rock.  Pretty amazing and it’s free!  There was always colorful fish and at least one sea turtle (usually there was a full family of turtles).•Based on our experience, I would suggest visiting the area early for snorkeling.  It gets pretty crowded as the days goes on (as far as the amount of snorklers).  We would go each morning from say 8 – 10 and it was perfect.•People also cliff jump off of Black Rock.  We did several times, and it was a blast!  From the water, it does not look that tall, but it sure does when you are up at the top ready to jump.   Seemed pretty safe, and never saw anyone have any issue.•I will also note that TripAdvisor lists this beach as being in Lahaina, but I think that’s wrong.  It’s actually in Kaanapali, at least the part we hung out at.  Lahaina was a 10 – 15 minute drive from our resort, so this seems wrong to me.We visited many beaches on our visit, and this was one of our two favorites (the other being in Hana).  I am sure part of the attraction to us was we walked right out of our hotel to it, but I think even if we would have traveled to it we would have felt the same.  It just was a great relaxing spot with good swimming and snorkeling.  Love this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My only regret is not bringing my snorkeling mask to swim around the rocks on black beach.We came 9-noonish before it was blazing hot and the water temperature was lovely. The tide was going out so the wave were pulling a little strong but you could swim a few feet in and be in calm water. Picture perfect views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely uncrowded beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We traveled off season, so the beach was never crowded. It stretches a long way, so even with all the hotels located on this beach, there was plenty of sand (and water) for everyone. The sand is smooth with almost no rocks or trash. One strange thing - it's very steep both on the shore and underwater. The drop-off is pretty quick, so we couldn't wade very far before we stopped being able to touch. Makes sense, since Maui is a volcano!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved the layout of the beach.  Watching the catamarans come in & is watch the sunset.  Super clean beach and accessible bathrooms. 👍👍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Black Rock is awesome!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Snorkeling is awesome near black rock! Saw two turtles and awesome colorful fish. The Beach is beautiful. We parked at a hotel with beach parking- the Marriott maybe? Get there no later than 9:30am for a spot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Where is the postcard beach?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are a millionaire staying at one of the resorts that chopped up the beach into private parts, you might enjoy it. We came here with a car, traffic everywhere, nowhere to park, no obvious public access... really sad that this is the prime swimming area in Hawaii. Left disappointed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the prettiest beach on the island.  Mellow, clear warm water, near restaurants and shops, clean beaches and no wind.  There are a couple spots for boogie boarding but it's not really known for it's surfing.  More relaxing, snorkeling and jumping off black rock!  I dive, but sometimes it's nice to go snorkeling.  I've never snorkeled here and not seen one or more turtles.  They love the area, especially close to the black rock.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Honeymoon Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was absolutely amazing. The clarity and colors  of the water was astounding. Soft sand and cool/warm water made the visit relaxing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent the majority of our trip on this beach. It was clean and everyone was respectful, it is great for families!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in a resort on this beach, has a nice boardwalk and beautiful water that is great for snorkeling right off the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches are memorable!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand on the beach is different, very fine.  The water is warm, it was great to swim in and very clear, not matter what beach you go to, we had a lot of fun!!  Also saw some Sea Turtles that was awesome!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Always Beauitful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sunshine kissed, cool trade breezes, water sports galore and stunning beaches, what more could you ask for.... wait, it’s there too, a short walk to whalers village gets you shopping, dining and more. P.S. Macy’s in the Hyatt is perfect for resort wear and things forgotten for a trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Black Rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best section of the Kaanapali Beach is right in front of the Sheraton Hotel. That beach is bounded by large lava ridge known as Black Rock. Snorkeling there is fine. Youngsters and some oldsters leap from the top of Black Rock into the water making for a pretty good photo opportunity. Enjoy your stay on Black Rock Beach and don't hesitate to snorkel there as turtles are almost always in evidence.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked the boardwalk and ended up staying and playing on kaanapali beach.  The water was perfect.  Super clear not too rough.  There is access to a lot of hotels , restaurants shops etc along the beach which is also great!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Huge sandy beach near black rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this is a great beach.  Mild surf and plenty of sand.  At the end near black rock is a great location to snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went here with a group of 6 for a morning and we had a blast. The beach/sand was a huge area so we had no issues finding a spot to lay out. The snorkel gear  was good quality and inexpensive - and we  saw lots of fish. The cliff jumping was so much fun. And the swimming was great.  Excellent spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking complicated but nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was there yesterday (Oct 22) around noon and it was surprisingly not crowded like we thought it was going to be. Beach is beautiful and plenty of space to sunbathe. PARKING: impossible to find a space at free public parking. However, there is a way to park fres. Park at Whalers Village shopping mall paid parking garage. This parking spot is right by the beach and you can get your ticket validated by the stores there if you purchase something. For example, we went to a coffee shop (sorry, forgot name) on the ground level and they said they could validate our parking ticket if we purchase $15 or more. It was fair as we wanted coffee anyway. They put a bad code over our parking ticket and we exited the parking lot without paying !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but Popular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Early morning was an awesome time to visit this beach- between 6a-10a. Past that it was too crowded for our liking. The water is refreshing but a bit tougher than some others nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great swimming, great snorkeling, great FUN!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We’ve been coming back to this beach for 8 years.  I wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else.  Lots of turtles near black rock but one also swam by me way up by the Westin.  Perfect waves for floating and still fun for boogie boarding with the kids.  This is my all time favorite beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: go on the boardwalk that follows the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: you don't have to stay in one of the hotels or condos. Thankfully ALL beaches are open to the public. Stroll from the Hyatt to the Sheraton on the board walk. If you have enough energy you can keep going beyond that all the way to the Aston Mahana. Along the way you can stop at many different restaurants, watch people (which can be most interesting), take lots of pictures, get your feet wet, take a swim, or do some jogging (best done in the AM). It's an iconic beach, however, keep going. There are many more glorious beaches on this island and often less crowded with free parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but waves are strong and dangerous undertow. We found out after that there is other beach's in the area with calmer waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Nice Beach With Crystal Clear Water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The section of this beach that was in front of where we stayed was very nice and never very crowded. The sand was a little coarser than at some other beaches we've been to, but the water was crystal clear. The water was a little colder than many beaches in the Caribbean, but not too terribly cold. The best way to get acclimated to it was to just dive right in and then stay in the water up to your neck. The surf can get a little rough around high tide but not anywhere near as rough as on the north shore of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka’anapali Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort (Marriott Maui Ocean Club) was tight on this beach so we spent quite a bit of time on this beach.  It is massive, with many busy resorts backing on to it.  That said, the beach never felt crowded and there was always plenty of room to spread out.  Decent snorkelling at Black Rock but not as good as other places.  Really pretty beach with great weather and fun waves.  Overall, really great area to stay or to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach shopping
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I enjoy walking along the beach walking path and going in the variety of shops. I have visited many beach towns along the way. From Kapalua, Kahuna, Napili, Honokawai,  all the way to Lahaina.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Soft sand and good snorkeling. Love this stretch of Maui. Second year in a row coming here.  Enjoy the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Expansive beaches, warm water, surfing, boogie boarding, parasailing, sunset cruises, body surfing and more. What’s not to love?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunny Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want a great beach, this is it. Mostly used by hotel guests. Parking at the Whalers Village and other hidden areas. Wide sandy beach. Very family oriented. I come to Maui for this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great snorkeling at the black rock, clear blue water, and beautiful sand. Good dining options as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great warm waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Any time of day you can get in without “warming up” first. Beautiful clear waters. Nearby restaurants activities snorkeling etc. gentle surf no need to be scared!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach with the Views of the Islands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka’anapali Beach is the best beach around. Water is clear, snorkeling is great. Great views of the other islands.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than all of them
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have visited almost every beach in Maui and this beach is hard to beat. Also a great choice to watch the beautiful Maui sunsets

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really Good Sandy Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Kaanapali beach area is great for a nice all around beach experience. Bring your sunscreen! The clouds can go in and out but there is no pollution here to filter the UV Ray's. The sand is a bit sticky but easy to brush off. The water temperature is really pleasant. The offshore reef area is pretty much dead so there are no colorful coral formations...however snorkeling is fun as there are many species of marine life in the first 50 feet off shore.  I SAW PLENTY OF THE Humuhumu.fish, a couple of adult Moray eels and about 20 more species of Pacific marine life in less than 15 minutes of casual snorkeling. The wind actually helps to keep the hungry flies off you. That makes it nice for just catching some rays.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and fine sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Small beach in its own cove. Napili Shores on one side and Seahouse restaurant on the other. Becoming eroded by reasonable size waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family oriented beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We used the beach every morning between 7-10am. The place is so calm and predictable with gorgeous water color, temperature, and small waves. Perfect for snorkeling or just dipping in and out while you enjoy the sun at the slightly sloped and sandy beach. We also often walked all the way to the black rock which is the end of the beach and back either on the boardwalk or the beach. For couples it could at times get a bit too busy and loud with young children running around or making noise in and near the water. But goin early was the best way to manage that possible conflict for us. OVERALL VERY PEACEFUL AND BEAUTIFUL!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Kaanapali
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our 3rd stay and having explored most of the island now I don’t think I would stay anywhere else. Such a clean uncrowded beach with crystal clear water and snorkeling at black rock. The beach walk takes you past all the resorts, shops, restaurants and bars. Sunsets here are breathtaking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach. We snorkeled and sunbathed and enjoyed the trail behind the beach. Well snorkeling we saw two large sea turtles

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Maui Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved Ka'anapali Beach as it is the epitome of why we went to Maui and you can't say you went to Maui unless you go to this beach for swimming,  sunbathing, and people watching.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped by this beach for an afternoon and are so glad we did! The beach is really wide so even though there are other people, it doesn't feel crowded at all which is great! There's a lot of shopping and restaurants in the area so it would be easy to grab a bite to eat and head to the beach.  The day we were there the waves were a bit rough so I'm not sure if it is like that all the time or just was the time of day we were there.  As with almost everywhere in Hawai'i, the views are beautiful, the water is warm, and the sand is soft and clean! This is a great beach for relaxing and enjoying the Hawaiian sunshine!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gentle surf.  Lots of sand and many activities!!!  Great beach walk for morning exercise!  Lots of dining options too!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved loved this beach and area of Maui. Water was so clear and blue and the waves are crazy big, the beach is in the area of all the large resorts so you can walk around all the resorts and look around. These hotels are beautiful and the beach is huge with soft sand and warm waters

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ok for tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It has a nice concrete walkway to connect hotels which is nice . Pretty beach beach but very crowded . Kind of touristy !! Ok to hang out and use as vase to visitOther beaches .You need a car !Great sunsets from deck of any outdoor restaurant! Or piece of grass or sand !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We take the kids and dogs down to the beach almost daily. It’s one of the finest in the world. Across the street from us. Soft sand and gentle surf make it pleasant. Lots of fun to be had and lots of choices for food and beverages. Go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: had little bit of a hard time finding public parking, but squeezed the car in then walked the beach front trail to enjoy the ocean views and also enjoyed seeing all the resorts pools, gardens and restarants. Water was powerful that day, red flags out - heavy surf, but still able to enjoy it  much.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with many activities.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a great time on Kaanapali Beach. We especially enjoyed its proximity to Whaler's village where you can shop or dine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely stunning beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We traveled by taxi ($17 from Lahaina cruise terminal) to Whalers village and then walked down to the beach. The beach was absolutely gorgeous, the waves were extremely high this day so not the best for small kids or even some adults, but it was absolutely beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We purchased an umbrella at Costco upon arrival as do many others. The sun can be intense. We snorkeled there and just hung out in the water. It’s a beautiful stretch of beach. “North Kannapali” beach is the best and gentle entrance all sand during good weather.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: a hotel strip beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This section of beach is wall to wall condo/hotels... so the narrow sandy beach available to the public is not huge. The hotels have scored their own grass covered knolls for their guests. The current is really strong, so I would never let children just play along the water's edge. The water temperature and color of course are lovely. Best to go w/ some sort of floatie.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All the beaches in West Maui at the resorts are fabulous! Wade, swim, snorkel. Warm clear water where you can see your feet!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long white stretch of sand, beautiful aqua water. Rough tides when I was there, and it did seem like the strip of sand was narrow. Very busy, full of tourists, but really pretty just the same.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, calm and peaceful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent several days at Ka’anapali Beach during our recent Maui visit. Each day, the waves were calm, the water beautiful and I saw green sea turtles each time I snorkeled - right from the beach!There were many different fish species to see, beautiful coral and I even saw an eel or two. We have been to beaches all over the world and this is one of the best! The only challenge can be some sharp rocks and coral near the shore in some places so water shoes may help prevent cuts. But there are plenty of sandy areas if you just walk toward the southern end of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: COULD HAVE BEEN CLEANER
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a nice beach with beautiful views but the sand could have been cleaner. There were bits of plastic and rubbish that someone needs to clean up.  There a significent shelf in the sand to the sea. There's also quite a bit of natural 'rubbish' from palm trees etc but that's fine in my view.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.  Great snorkeling.  Very clean.  Pretty good star gazing (for the amateur).  Westin and Sheraton are nice resorts to stay at.  We stayed at the Westin and were treated like royalty.  The luau at the Sheraton is wonderful and watching the divers at Black Rock was fun.  Great beach for watching sunsets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach.  Not safe to swim for older folks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach. Dangerous surf.  Steep slopes to access water.Vey difficult to get out of water because of breakers on shore

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach if you can find public parking. Any time you want a drink or meal you can hit the hotel any where on this beach or the many restaurants too.The surf can be dangerous if a big swell is happening so be cautious otherwise it is fun snorkeling by Black rock. Bring plenty of sun tan lotion as the sun can be brutal if you do not bring an umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long Walk in great sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kanapali Beach was stunning. Walked from Whalers Village to the Aston.  Beautiful waves, happy faces. Best beach bar is at the Royal Lahaina next door to the golf courses.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking sucks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are not a guest staying at any of the resorts near this Beach the public parking is almost hidden and when you find them the signs for them are tiny.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous Stay on Ka'anapali Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at the Hyatt Regency and thoroughly enjoyed the strolls along the paved boardwalk on Ka'anapali Beach! A crisp morning walk with breathtaking views was a highlight of our stay - best Fitbit steps ever! In the evening, we enjoyed the stroll to Whalers Village with all the tiki torches at many of the properties. Tide was rough and many catamaran cruises that boarded from the beach were cancelled so we avoided swimming at the beach. Plans to return to Ka'anapli Beach with the rest of the family definitely on our radar!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plenty to do.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For those who take a taxi, the drop off is at Whalers Shopping.   There are plenty of places to eat.  The beach is clean.  We were there at a time of high surf and high tide.  Waves could be potentially be as high as 10 feet so watch the kids

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely gorgeous. Great for taking a long walk or swimming. Great views of Molokai and Lanai. Sand is like sugar, water clear and calm when we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand and water not crowded it's such a beautiful place you can stand in the water up to your head look down and see your toes

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach, right by the Westin Resort. You can park for free right by the entrance, there are some restaurants that belong to the resorts/hotels around, as well. It also looks like a good place for snorkeling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach, great area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful views of the ocean (it is a beach) and Molokai. However, at times Molokai can obscure the full grandeur of a sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kaanapali beach walk is a must do when you are in Maui. Lots of shops and fun bars and restaurants .Relaxing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy but Nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were able to find a spot that was not crowded, The break was not good for body surfing when we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach and wonderful area. Beach is long and spacious. Waves can get a little aggressive/big, so be careful! Whaler’s village is also around/behind beach and it’s a nice place to shop around for unique gifts :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hard to get to in the middle of ritzy area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I really wanted to see this beach, but had trouble finding it with all the exclusive rich resorts and hotels around it and roads that led you into parking lots which were hard to get out of. We drove around a while and because it was difficult and we felt we were way out of our price range in this area, we never got to see the beach. VERY disappointing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Contender (again) for best beach in America
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent a fabulous day on Kaanapali beach in September 2019. Perfect weather, perfect waves and just beautiful to sit upon.Highly recommended beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the top 10 beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Snorkel around black rock. Walk the beach for 4 miles. Enjoy the views of Lanai and Molokai. A real treasure. Cost is free. Waves can be amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach area!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach area is expansive.  Good for all water sports like kayaking, stand up paddle boarding, body surfing and even para sailing.  It's where you can rent a lot of these.  Also a tip, there is public parking available at nearby resorts fronting the beach but they are very limited so it fills up quickly.  We tried several spots.  First at the Whaler's village but since it's our first time there, we didn't know how far the trek to the beach will be.  We ditched the place and decided to go try one of the public parking by the resort.  Lot was full.  We then decide to just pay for resort parking coz we didn't want to waste time looking for one.  Once that was settled, you can head for the water, there is usually access (either dirt or paved).  No one will chastise you for being on the resort grounds.  Just be aware that this is an expansive beach.  So if you're lugging beach chairs, umbrella, cooler, tote, children, and then boards (whatever kind), you might want to plan where you pick your spot.  Walking on the sand under the heat of the sun with 1000% humidity will take it's toll on you.  So we carefully chose our spot closest to the path that takes us to our parking lot.  We set up shop and enjoyed the day and the heat :-)  You have a clear view of Lanai and Molokai islands.  There's plenty to do and places to eat if you don't have food packed.  Also, there are outdoor shower stalls where you can rinse off the sand.  The only downside was that, the day and time we went the waves were a bit big so it was not suitable for swimming.  After what seemed like ample time....we decided to head back to Whaler's village and grab some lunch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kaanapali beach - Great location, easy access, free parking!   The water was crystal blue.  Beach comfortably crowded.  Short, shoreline.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We are staying at the Kaanapali beach club which is on the Kaanapali beach we love this beach not crowded and is very clean the water is so clear

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super clean, sheltered, low surf beach with a little secret. Good for a quick stop
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a long flat beach that fronts the Ka'anpali hotel strip. It is sheltered from the wind and the surf action is pretty minimal due to the flat sandy bottom.  I am calling it average because I do not think it is that great for kids as the water does get deep very quickly not allowing for much wading before you are swimming over a sandy bottom with not much to see snorkelling. There is very limited shade area so an umbrella is a must.    Ka'anapali is not where we enjoy Maui, but we do find ourselves nearby occasionally, and the rock at the Sheraton end is fun to go and jump off a few times if you need a cool down.  The hidden secret is the free beach access parking at the Sheraton. Covered and right next to the walkway that is a short walk to the beach. Allegedly all of the resorts on the strip are required to provide 35 free public access spaces but the Sheraton is the ony one I have easily found and it is at the end of the beach with the jumping rock.  If you want to check in on resort scene for a few it is easy to get in and out and the rock jump is fun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Family Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are looking for a beach for your kids to play, this is a good spot. the wife and I were just a short walk to this beach and it was quiet and nice. Good place to snorkel or scuba. Small waves and easy water access.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pristine beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So clean, fine sand and turquoise water.  Not crowded at all at this time of year. Best place to watch the Cliff divers too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, good snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach for long walks and good snorkeling. You can walk the length of the beach or stay above most of the beach on a boardwalk. Water entry is easy and the beach is so long that you never feel crowded by other people. The snorkeling in the reefs just offshore is wonderful, with a great selection of colorful fish, starfish, corals, plant life, etc. We tried snorkeling around Black Rock nearby as a recommendation from others, but found it had a LOT fewer colorful fish and was quite crowded. Going north from Black Rock to the middle of the long beach provided great snorkeling without the crowd. We even saw sea turtles more than once.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is stunningly beautiful! But when we visited the waves were big and the rip current was strong, so I was afraid to let my kids get in too deep. It’s a sunny beach with few shady spots. Try and stop if you are staying on another part of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Public Beach Park!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kahekili Beach Park gets high marks for good free parking, restrooms, covered pavillion with picnic tables and easy beach access. Look for this one in Ka'anapali.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a stunning beach! Not a lot of shade to retreat to, but we saw deals where you can rent an umbrella, a cooler, snorkel gear for two, beach chairs, and boogie boards for the week for a $100. Seems worth it if you plan to beach hop all week!Black Rock snorkelling was excellent along the reef! We saw a turtle!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka’anapali Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was one of our favourite places to go!  You can snorkel here, swim here, it’s family oriented, not over crowded and a lovely way to spend a beach day, the views, the beach, the sand are outstanding!  Loved this beach day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just returned from Maui. The sunsets on Kaanapali Beach are incredible!! We were just out playing in the water in front of our resort and a huge turtle swam by us!! Absolutely beautiful place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean Golden Sands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kaanapali Beach extends North past the Royal Lahaina and South to the Hyatt Regency from Black Rock and the Sheraton Resort. The beach is clean and usually has a mild shore break... it is one of the better beaches on Maui.There are two paved walkways North and South from the Sheraton that are used daily by runners and walkers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach bodies!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesome clean fun. Nice folks all around us. You will not be disappointed!!!  Well worth the visit. Don’t wait!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect, beautiful and serene.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What can you say about the most perfect beach on Earth? It’s beautiful and the ocean is always warm. Clean and quiet, a couples perfect beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The ocean is so gorgeous and the beach too! Went walking and played in the ocean. Just beautiful! It was pretty hot there so we just spent a few hours there but enjoyed! Got to go there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Trilogy Sunset Cruise Departure from Ka’anapali
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We boarded our boat from this beach and enjoyed walking along it before and after our sail. It’s a beautiful, long stretch of flat beach with nice sand and seemingly gentle waves (relative to other spots along the coast). There are many resorts, shopping (Whaler’s Village is there), and restaurants  along this strip and a paved walkway that weaves along the beach as well. It would a great area for an evening sunset stroll (as we enjoyed) and there were many people out with cameras to capture the sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is nice but not enough place to swim or walk in the water before to get rock. We can take a very long walk on the beach. Nice sand with no seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bath water!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is gorgeous. I stayed there at The Westin Ka'anapali Ocean Resort Villas which sits on this beach. The sand is incredibly soft yet sticky; I brought a bunch of it home (unknowingly, LOL) in the top of my bathing suit! It gets EVERYWHERE! Beware however, the current can get very strong. Pay attention to little ones and I'd discourage using rafts as you will seriously get sucked right out! The water is incredibly warm, even I was swimming in it! I'm from San Diego, and I NEVER swim in the ocean because it's just too darn cold! Clean, lovely beach:)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Black rock was my favorite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches are clean calm in the morning and black rock great for snorkeling.  There are divers of Black rock at sunset.  Lots of good eats along the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Outstanding beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world.Miles of wide sand and crystal clear water which is also warm and refreshing.Lovely scenery and near many amenities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach with beautiful resorts lined up for miles!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is paradise at its best.  Good road (when there hasn't been an accident), ample FREE parking at the resorts and plentiful public access points  between resorts, (or just walk through the luxurious lobbies and possibly stop for a drink).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at Kaanapali is beautiful!We snorkeled on the beach here and saw fabulous fish and a turtle!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Black Rock Beach Cliff Jump
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came here solely to do the cliff jump and it was a lot of fun! A little tough getting up on the rocks but it's definitely doable. Stayed at the beach for about an hour. Good stop!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Super clean, beautiful, and easily accessible beach.  We drove all over the island and Kaanapali was easily in the top 3 beaches

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a gorgeous stretch of beach that is not too crowded and it's usually pretty calm water. this is a great place to get an umbrella and sit in the shade and just listen to the sounds of the waves all day as you nap off and on.  There's a walkway for a nice stroll along the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for easy snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach! I only wish someone would provide hammock and drink service. Water is warm, easy to find fish and still feel secure close to the shore if you aren't an "ocean" person.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Strong waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach walk. The waves were very strong that we did not get into the water for the three days that that we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This may be the most beautiful beach on the planet, from the brilliant aquamarine color of the ocean to the nearby islands to the amazing snorkeling opportunities to the immaculate sandy beach, this is a beach you need to spend some time on. If you go in the winter months, there will be whales breaching not too far away.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exploring
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place was a hidden treasure! We were able to see waterfalls on our way and all the greenery of the lush island. The winding roads were a little bit challenging. But all in all, this was absolutely beautiful to experience!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: AMAZING BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large white sand beach on the west side of Maui, Hawaii. You can practice any sport and sunsets are incredible! Walking on the velvet sand is something you won't forget...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach time before dinner
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped at this beach before enjoying a nice dinner. This beach was very active with many people waiting to go out on Sunset cruises  and just enjoying the beautiful scenery. The water was a little rough for those wanting to wade in the water or swim. I would say that this beach is more of a relax in the sand type of place or watching the sunset location. The beach is also located next to a active and diverse outdoor shopping mall.  Would defiantly be back if in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow, just Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Ka'annpapoli, so beautuful! The condo we had was facing the ocean and the 3 pools. The tradewinds helped cool off the heat. The pools were not crowded and the waves were fun at the beach. Beat vacation ever!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful expansive beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Kaanapali Alii resort....enjoyed our days at the beach. It wasn't crowded and there were plenty of areas to lounge at. We especially liked the walk-way along the shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was the last beach we visited. I wish it was the first. Enough parking, gorgeous views, plenty of shade, good facilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach last. I wish we had visited first. Gorgeous beach, plenty of shade, not rough water at all, great facilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but no lifeguards
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful. The water is beautiful. Black rock is right there outside Sheraton. Next door is Kaanapali beach hotel. Snorkeling by the rock was a success, we saw the turtles everyday! My only downfall was there’s no lifeguards at all. Upon entering the ocean the current is strong and drops pretty quick and you can’t touch the bottom. Very dangerous for kids. You’d need to be vigilant   at all times. Not sure why the hotels can’t provide lifeguards or the state itself?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Such a fun and beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my favourite beaches of the many we visited during our 14 days in Hawaii. The waves were so fun to ride close to shore and there was some decent snorkelling too. Our kids (ages 7, 14, 16) all had a great day! Parking was convenient and lots of space to spread out. We loved walking along this beach in both directions.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spent a week based in Ka'anapali and this was our go to beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent a week based in Ka'anapali and this was our go to beach. Good parking availability, perfect beach, Northwest end has good snorkeling at black rock (go around the point and the water is clearer), full range of food from  fast to gourmet. When we were there the current was parallel to the beach. Good shopping selection at whalers village

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great location and walking distance to so many options.   Views are amazing all the time but especially at Sunset

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top 5 beaches in the world !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just visit , the golden sands, amazing weather, amazing sites and amazing places to eat will make you feel the same way .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a beautiful beach.. but the parking is not so great! But I enjoyed our visit here! Need more areas with shade.. I got sun burned here.. but it was my fault! Must visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean sparkly uncrowded white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great views, good snorkeling around Black Rock, wide, expansive soft clean sand beach with easy entry into the ocean both side of. Lack Rock at the Royal Lahaina resort area. Not much to see in the crystal clear water but you won’t stub your toe on anything! Been here many times different months and years, always beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I personally think the beaches at home are much better and when we stayed here there was little or no surf , but it is a lovely beach for walking on and watching the sun go down over the ocean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So beautiful we vacation in Maui every year the view is breathtaking the beach is so clean and serene

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Hawaii !!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is no better place to play in the water; snorkel, swim, or just sit in the sand and enjoy the day.  Clean, soft sand. All the amenities you need and lots more. Family friendly.  Great Snorkeling at black rock.  Simply nothing negative about this location.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic colors!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic colors!!! Beautiful view.  Tricky access though (accessible either by a daily cruise,  or by car on a dirt road).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Swim with turtles for free
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is lots of room on this beach. The water is usually clear except after rain. We were swimming with fish and turtles near the rocks on several occasions. Sand is nice but can get hot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wide sand and georgeous views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Plenty of sand to share with other holiday makers, and gentle waves. Easy access through Whalers Village or many other beach paths.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, big waves, Lots of fun and nice people.i would recommend this beach and would come back again,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went here on our second day in Maui! The sands are white and the water is so clear! It probably depends on the day you go but when we went the water was nice and calm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Skip this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No shade, incredible wind gusts and killer undertow. With so many other beautiful beaches nearby, you can safely skip this one.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach,  but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I know this is a world famous beach, but it definitely isn't the best one on Maui. There are lots af people, a great view, lots to look at.  We prefer space and do not enjoy other people right on top of our space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: woke up to this every morning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Ali'i in an ocean front condo, 9 floors up. The views of this beach (morning noon & night) were postcard perfect. We loved just being able to walk a minute or two, from beach to pool to beach to pool, etc all day long. This part of Ka'anapali Beach was not a snorkeling beach, rather it was just fun to play in the waves and swim. We enjoyed watching the surfers and paddleboarders. The sunsets over this beach were serene and spectacular! The sand was clean, not littered. We shall return!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach ever walk out of your condo rt on the beach clean and very beautiful !! Beautiful sunsets ! Great place to go ! Xoxo

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I’m always on the hunt for turtles- and the morning didn’t disappoint- 5!!  Lazily swimming around.  It’s the highlight of my day!  Looove it!!!  ❤️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stellar Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort (The Westin Ka'anapali Ocean Resort Villas) was just off of this beach so we visited each day. The water was superb, warm and refreshing and the snorkeling was world class, one only needs to venture a few feet from the shores to see an lush reef filled with

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort, the Maui Aston Kaanapali Resort was right on the Kaanapali beach.  It wasn’t overly crowded, not too rough, and not rocky.  You could walk for a long way along it.  We didn’t see the need to go anywhere else, as this beach had everything we needed right there convenient to our resort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on Maui!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went snorkeling here with our grown children and 6 and 7-year-old grandchildren.  It was fabulous!  We swam near sea turtles, stingrays, eels and lots of colorful fish.  It was so amazing!The beach, itself, is lovely, with a wide and deep expanse of sand.  It is easy to rent snorkel equipment here, and there are outdoor restaurants nearby at the Sheraton Maui.  The water is relatively calm here, as opposed to other Maui beaches where the waves are stronger and the undertow stronger. Plus, we enjoyed watching all the daring people jump off of the black rocks that ring one side of the beach.  Fun day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easily one of my favorite beaches.  I am still in awe of how beautiful Maui and the beaches are.  The ocean was very rough and waves were strong, but I read it’s the trade winds, so we went earlier the next visit. This beach wasn’t very crowded and had bathrooms/changing rooms, and a pavilion area. There’s a small Parking lot with limited parking- we were lucky and got great spots.  Definitely worth spending some time here if you’re in Maui

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beaches, picnic tables and seating along the way. Enjoy swimming, snorkling and just looking at beautiful views. The sea turtles come close to shore around 6:00am and 7:00am. Wonderful shopping nearby, with great restuarants Lahaina.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Incredible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In Maui on a cruise, went here and can't say enough about it. Beautiful place. Full family loved it. A must stop.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This beach area has everything you want in a beach resort atmosphere.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, the area has many conveniences, the atmosphere is ideal for leisurely enjoying your time there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice large beach, accessible lagoon
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are a handful of hotels at this lagoon, which adds to the variety. The lagoon is very nice and accessible to all skill levels. Great for swimming or snorkeling or simply chill at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top Rated For A Reason
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I read that this beach was rated as the best beach in Maui and, after vacationing here, I can see why. Beautiful sunsets, beautiful walks and the water is so soothing and warm. When we go out the waves are usually challenging but not dangerous. Be sure to check with the staff of your hotel if the waves will be manageable or dangerous when you want to go out in the water. Just sit back, relax and let this marvelous maui beach work its magic on you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kaanapali Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a beautiful sand beach with sparkling blue water and views of nearby islands. It’s in a high end tourist district surrounded by golf courses and lush landscape. We had a private cabana that was amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were here in 1983. At that time there were few hotels and lots of beach. Now it’s hotel after hotel. The beach is still there, but if you aren’t staying in Kaanapali you need to use one of the small beach access parking lots and walk. Lots of great restaurants, but everything here is pricey!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: DANGEROUS WAVES
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I don't get it... we were here for 7 days and although this beach is beautiful, it is for 2 reasons: 1) the view; and 2) all of the landscaping and restaurants etc along the walkway.  The beach itself is not great.  When we were there, the waves and the current were very strong and not safe for little kids.  At high tide in a lot of areas there is very little sand.  They also don't allow you to play ball on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach Satisfaction
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We are staying at Kaanapali again, steps from the beach, the snorkeling is superb, with turtle sightings, and lots of fish, there are no obvious hazards, the beach is protected from large waves, there is a slight current, but most can outshine that, perfect for families and friends.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s a beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nothing special. Parking terrible. Maybe good for sunset. Don’t know. Lots of other accessible beaches on Maui. I would not go back to this beach. Crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best reef and super family friendly.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for family and younger ones. It’s pretty calm most days with mild waves. The reef is one of the best in the world to snorkel easily with the whole family. Tons of fish and turtles. Beaches are nice with course sand although not very wide in parts. The water is so clear and blue several 100 feet out from shore. Be sure to bring a snorkel mask and a Go Pro to enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach With a Stretch of Hotels
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you end up staying at the Marriot Grand or Hyatt Regency properties, the beach is right there for you to enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but take care
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long expanse of golden sand. Public access with facilities (restrooms)The beach can be deceptive with some strong waves and currents.Sadly on our second visit a tourist disappeared underwater and was eventually dragged from the water by other tourists. There is no life guard!The tourist was eventually treated by emergency services but it didn't look good for their survival.Few beaches on MAUI have life guards so take care.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gentle-to-Powerful Ocean Swells and a Clean Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Shades of turquoise water, roiling waves, and unblemished sand greet those who come to the Ka’anapali Beach in Maui. During our stay, the water tended to be calmer in the mornings, prior to Trade Winds in the afternoon increasing the size of ocean swells, which made it more difficult for me to stay upright as I tried to walk out of the water. Bring snugly-fitted water shoes and effective sunscreen, as the sand on shore can be scorching to walk on, and uncovered skin can burn. Still, we were mesmerized by the swells, the movement freedom in the water, and we spent every day on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is plenty of sand to play, paddle boarding, wake boarding, luaus, restaurants, groceries, parasailing, fun in the sun. It’s a great place to stay or visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: See you at the Black Rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoyed snorkeling at the Black Rock. There were plenty of colorful tropical fish for all ages to observe. The area was shallow and safe enough for children as well. Great time walking on the beach and seeing spectacular sunsets too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not many people! Great! Bus #28 is near $ per person. Nature amazing. Water is clean , warm. Live it!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful & Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand was soft and pretty. The beach was warm, pretty and relaxing. If you are staying at a resort they have umbrella rentals and chairs for rent on the beaches.It wasn't crowded and plenty of places to set up. You just will have to shield yourself from the direct sun. Enjoy it can't get no more perfect than this!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sands are pristine, the ocean is a mix of blue and green. Sea turtles swim right by you so don't get scared if you see them next to you.The water is warm and enjoyable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect Beach for Tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: ‘Secluded’, public, accessible in a naturally protected sandy beach. What more could you ask for? Parking is an issue but easily solved with pay parking at the tennis club across. I think it’s about $10 (2019$).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Review
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka’anapali Beach is beautiful.   Whaler’s Village is a nice shopping center & there are many good restaurants.  Our favorite is Leilanis on the Beach.   We always spend time on this beach and have to jump off Black Rock each time as well.   Great snorkeling off the beach as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful water, rocky bottom
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to this beach with surfboards and boogie boards. There were great waves of different heights. We had a bit of a problem with how shallow the water was because it could get rocky on the bottom and we would kick the rocks. Other than that, a great beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice vibe ... but not a Caribbean beach !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So the good news are they the sand is nice, some palm trees along, good vibe, not overcrowded. You can rent chairs and umbrellas . Water is nice and clean.The not so good news are that you have only 5 to 10 meters in the water with nice sand, before rocks are felt under your feet. This is not only unpleasant but also unsafe for kids and surfers and adults alike.Also the stretch of sand is quite narrow, not a heck of a lot of physical space.Overall a nice beach with a good vibe, nice shopping and lots of bars and restaurants. But the actual beach is far from a Caribbean beach quality.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing and Clean!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect beach to tanning, snorkeling, relaxing and swimming!  Rented umbrellas and chaise lounges from our Westin Villas and it was a perfect way to spend the day.  Sand is clean, the reef is right there and water is clear!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty and large beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: With a backdrop of several hotels it's not the most ideal beach, but it's pretty and has a sandy beach. Unfortunately this area gets very windy at times and the sand can be blown and hurt. On the furthest east side of the beach it backs up to the Sheraton and Black Diving Rock (a 30 foot high rock over the water where you can jump off).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This one of the most beautiful places in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have returned here three times and even flew here by myself.  The rainbows seem to come out daily and the cruises are wonderful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach with bathroom facilities. You need to bring your own chair and anything to eat or drink there's nothing for sale there but the snorkeling is really great there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beachy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The waters are beautiful warm and clear!  Sands are very clean.  I am looking forward to visiting again very soon!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Even though it was spring break time, plenty of space on this beautiful beach. We walked up and down the sidewalk; some hotels were very busy, others were quieter, and those sections of the beach reflected the nearby hotel activity. Walked to the far end to go snorkeling and found some amazing fish.  Whales out in the distance!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One outstanding beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful.  Plenty of sandy beach, water sports rentals, snorkeling, diving, public parking, scuba diving.  Many tours operate in this area so you can reserve other thing to do in Maui.  Plenty of beautiful hotels, condos, shopping, restaurants and activities.  Golf nearby.  World class beach which is free to use.  Just pay for parking. Enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My kids and I enjoyed snorkeling here more than we did at some of the other locations recommended by the snorkel shop. Didn't have to go far from shore and saw good variety of fish and creatures.  A little rocky if you want to swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An Ok beach for those staying at the big hotels there
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a decent beach, but parking is very limited and I found no public showers or restrooms.  I would not put it in the top beaches on Maui, in my opinion it's about average.  Hanakaoo beach around the corner has nearly identical conditions with more parking and easier access for those not staying in the big hotels.  I found the beaches south of Kihei to be far nicer.  Unless you're staying in the big hotels on kanapali beach, I'd skip this place.  Wish I'd gone to Makena instead.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for the family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were at Marriott, Ocean side and its virtually on the beach.Great access to swimming, surfing, beach activities, parasailing and snorkeling

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a beautiful beach a d place to snorkle. Lots of good food around.Lovely to take long walks on the beach and great waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scenic beach, great paved pathway connecting all the resorts along the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very scenic beach, great paved pathway connecting all the resorts along the beach.  Made for a great morning run from Lahaina to up Black Rock.  Not the greatest swimming/surf beach.  Had more of a shore-break than waves I would consider a good surf spot.  There are lots of coral reefs about 75 feet off the shore that are very shallow, so beware if you are going to snorkel.  And please do not stand on the coral like I saw so many people doing.  It was very damaging to the coral.  The sand is picturesque but can become extremely hot in the afternoons.  The water is warm and crystal clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clean beach with a lot of fish to see not far from the shore. Snorkeling was fun and easy as long as you are careful not to get swept out too far from the shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very busy!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a very busy beach. We came in July which is peak season so I can’t speak for off season. I would recommend driving the coast and finding a spot where you see some dirt parking and more locals. There was not good snorkeling and the water was murky with sunscreen and too many people! Either way you’re in Hawaii and Hawaii is beautiful just my thoughts!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach with Everything
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We recently spent 10 days in Maui.  We visited no less than 10 of the islands beaches.  While many are rocky, the water is unbelieveable.  Almost everywhere on the island it is clear and beautiful shades of blue.  What we loved about Ka'anapali beach was that it had a litte of everything.  You could sit in waste to shoulder-high water with nothing but sand at your feet OR you pop on a mask and snorkel and head out into immense "reef" all around the beach.  We saw turtles, tons of different fish, eels, and even an octopus just 100 yards or less from the beach. The only downside is the crowds. However, because the beach is huge, we were always able to find a nice spot to sit and enjoy the sun, ocean, and ocean life all in one visit.  I know people will complain about the rocky nature of many of the beaches, and it did make swimming difficult in many areas of the island, but on this beach, it just enhanced the experience and added more to do.  It was very cool, and a place I would 100% put on my list while in Maui.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Beach is an everyday experience in Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our favorite hotel in Maui is the Sheraton Black Rock which sits atop Ka'anapali Beach.  We've stayed at this hotel at least 8 times and have spent many, many hours on Ka'anapali Beach.  As a beach, it is world class with more soft, white sand than you can explore in a single day.  The beachwalk is a convenient way to move from resorts to shopping and restaurants, if you don't mind going with the flow of tourists who are ever present.  Of all things to do on the beach, my favorite ritual is the morning snorkel around Black Rock.  Entering the water from the beach with flippers in hand, there is enough protection from waves to put on the snorkeling equipment to begin the 45 minute swim.  Snorkeling along Black Rock heading out there are scores of colorful fish to be found feeding on the rock and an occasional sea turtle swims up.  As you reach the other point of Black Rock, the coral and underwater landscape continue to provide great opportunities to see many different tropical fish and plenty of underwater sites to explore.Rounding the point brings you into a small bay which is another haven for sea life.  It's possible to snorkel up to where the water is just 2-3 feet deep and there are often turtles in this area bobbing in the surf.  Continuing the snorkel to completely around Black Rock brings you into much deeper water--easily 75-100 deep.  Here you'll find schools of fish--by the hundreds if not thousands--and I've even seen whales navigating this deeper (west) side of Black Rock.   Turning around and swimming back to the starting point will complete the 45 minute snorkel.  It's a great workout and the experience is different every day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Sunset
