reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful SunsetsNice calm ocean no waves. Not for surfing. Easy to swim Watch out for rocks in the ocean. Long coastline Easy to build up distance if you’re a swimmer and that’s your thing. Just go and check it out. Lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with lots of fun activities - parasailing, jet skiing, surfing lessons, etc.  Also, great restaurants and shopping in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful clean beach, with plenty of activities including snorkling, dining, shopping, picture taking, family enjoying etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Smooth sand right in front of Westin but rocky as you head south
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were looking for decent boogie board waves, and it was pretty calm right in front of our hotel (Westin) so we walked southward down the beach a few minutes where waves were a bit better, but the sea floor was covered in generally smooth rocks and my son got a few small cuts on his foot. Stay northward on Ka'anapali.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is the best in the Island. We loved the concrete walkway in case you don't want to walk a long way on the sand. The whaler mall is excellent with all the restaurants and shops. It was a great Way to take in the sights on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Visiting Maui and Kaanapali Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I traveled to Maui for the First time in January this Year and was really looking forward to the Beaches and the City of LaHaina. My stay at the Hyatt was O.K (Nice Hotel and Restaurants) but they did not warn me that the Beaches were mostly rocky and had Coral a short way off the shoreline.  I was told by a guest to go down the Beash a little ways ant there would be more of a Sandy Area. Well needless to say I did get cut up in very shallow surf and spend much of one day looking for True Sand Beaches that I have Much enjoyed on both the Islands of Kuai and Honolulu.I f You wish to swim and play in the surf, I would not suggest Maui as the Island for that type of Activity although the Island is Beautiful and Had some Great time Shopping, Eating and Drinking in La Haina.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sentimental Value
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful. It was conveniently behind the hotel I stayed at, Eldorado Maui. It will always hold sentimental value since my fiance proposed here.It's truly a beautiful beach in Lahaina. Waves were a bit too much for me but we came right before sunset. Not sure if there's best times to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved this beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went here a few times while visiting last week. Our teen daughters loved it too. Did some snorkeling, relaxed on the beach, and ate at nearby Hula Grill, for lunch. It is a nice beach, not too crowded. There’s a bathroom near the pool at the far end.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches you will ever see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breath taking beauty. I loved this beach, although busy.. but it is miles long (I dont know the actual length), feels like miles and there is plenty of space for everyone. Try to go out during sunset or even late into the night when there isn't any people noise. We just stood there listening to the ocean crash at 10 pm and it is a memory I will keep for life. It is not rocky like other beaches in the area, the sand is beyond soft. A must see!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the nicest beaches in Hawaii
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There's a reason there are so many resorts near here.  Ka'anapali Beach is beautiful, and a great place for families to play in the surf.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, a great deal of tourists come here so the beaches do get crowded! There are many beautiful beaches in Maui, ( its Hawaii, there all beautiful!!)..Maybe take a venture out and see some other beaches like Napili and Kapalua!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous, highly recommend!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can’t look anywhere on Maui without seeing beautiful views and Ka’anapali is no exception. We stayed at the Hyatt right on the water. My husband and son snorkeled all week and saw more fish and turtles off our hotel beach than they did on a catamaran snorkeling trip and at the more well known snorkel bays. We will be back to Ka’anapali!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent an afternoon at Black Rock Beach and it was beautiful. The waves were enough for our teens to play in. Wasnt too crowded and we had lunch at the Sheraton after.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We tried to swim in different beaches each day but this one seems to be most kid friendly and we enjoyed ourselves here!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Black Rock is incredible beach !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is located right in back of the Sheraton and parking is tricky unless you stay at one of the resorts on that stretch of Kaanapali beach (Sheraton, kaanapali Alii, Westin, Marriott, Hyatt Regency). I suggest getting to little parking garage early like by 7:45am that has a sign Beach Access parking right next to Sheraton. It is free but literally only like 20 spots max. Climbed Black Rock and jumped twice ( approx 20-25 ft high) and there is great snorkeling with at the base of Black Rock. Few feet over the water is so clear and good boogie boarding waves. On big swell days surfers can be seen surfing behind the Westin.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This our 3rd time to Ka’anapali Beach. Beach is amazing and not crowded. Tons of activities to do. We have been all over the island and this is our favorite area!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not really for snorkeling but great for body surfing and boogie boards. Beautiful clear water . Rent or buy beach chairs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed on kaanapali beach during our visit to Maui.Great sandy beach, plenty of things to do and places to eat. Rent since snorkeling gear and have fun in the water.Very nice area for families edith kids

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go to North side of Ka’anapali beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, sandy beach! Go to the north side of Black Rock to find the real gem - lots of sand but much less crowds (compared to south of Black Rock).  Ok for snorkelling but water a little cloudy on some days. Great for boogie or body boards. Great for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: surf, sand and sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach area is the best place to relax. The beach area is around four miles long with a boardwalk that ties all the different beaches together. There are everything to high end hotels and condos to private homes and public parks in this area. The beach front is open to everyone and has some areas that are very sandy and others that are rocky. The snorkeling is very good and suprises await just off the beach, my son and granddaughter saw a moray eel swimming around twenty yards from the beach. We have spent many vacations in this area and love the atmosphere and the beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach for Snorkeling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesone surf, but beyond the rocks... a whole coral reef! My family had a blast there and we would easily come again!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girls trip 2019
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The waves were very very high-hard to stand up in the water. Very windy too. But lovely to sit and watch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach...but rough surf
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is long and beautiful. Be extremely careful of the surf. We had heard about the great snorkeling at Ka'anapali beach, but couldn't find it. Some sneaker waves pounded us pretty hard, I would stay in South Maui for calmer seas next time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty but dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed on Ka’anapali beach week of July 4. Group ranged from age 7 to 80. The surf was far too rough for most of our group to even wade along the edge. Beach drops quickly and waves break close to shore. I ventured in twice less than 20 feet from shore and both times was swept off my feet and tumbled. I’ll take the Caribbean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Truly amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches we’ve been to. The part in front of the Westin Ka’anapali ocean resort villas has a reef just a few metres out from the shore with beautiful colourful fish and turtles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family Trip to Hawaii
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful  location, great time with family.So much to do and see,everyone is so friendly in Hawaii. Can't wait to go back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While the surf was mostly calm there were a few rogue waves that caught a few people out.  One young lad was very adept at recovering lost personal items from the surf.  He had recovered 10 pairs of glasses including two prescription eyeglasses a watch and even a pair of dentures! The power of the ocean can be very overwhelming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Ka'anapali Beach Hotel and we could just walk out of our room and across to the beach.  It was very nice and clean and it wasn't crowded.  My husband enjoyed going snorkeling and it was nice to just walk along in the surf.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long, sandy beach - great for a quick dip and relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The surf was high while we were in Maui, so it limited our snorkeling and swimming. We went to this beach twice. It's very long, so plenty of room to get settled to relax. There is a reef right off the beach, so you can snorkel when the conditions are right. There are big hotels along this beach, so it's easy to get something if you need it. Public parking is available (get there early), as well as bathrooms.  Very nice!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful!  Stayed at the Hyatt Regency Resort & Spa and all I had to do was walk outside to get to this beach.  Every inch of it is just paradise and watching the sunset, even better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach for swimming, snorkeling, and other activities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have stayed at this beach twice - for a beach at a hotel with things to do, nice for swimming, and even good snorkeling at a part of it (near black rock), it is a great beach.  You can even see Molokai and Lana'i in the distance!  Just be careful if the surf is high, which happens from time to time (and the first two days of our trip), but most of the time, it is fine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beauty all around
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I decided to stop by on a whim in route to Hana and boy were we surprised.  It was a beautiful scenery all around that we'd highly recommend for some cool pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went on vacation with 4 young adults. We ate at some of the best restaurants around Lahaina, rented snorkeling and surfing equipment on beach. Some beaches busier than others.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good place that could get dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited with my kids (16, 12 and 9). The beach itself is nice, long and sandy. There is plenty of space where to set your stuff. Public parking is a bit difficult though.We visited this beaxh in the afternoon and found the waves to be very turbulent. My oldest kids loved it. my youngest not so much. There were a lot of people surfing. I'd say this is a good place for older kids and younger adults.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of our Favorite Beaches!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Why wife and I had the pleasure of traveling to Maui for the second time. Then Kaanapali Beach is one of our favorites on the island. It is adult and kid friendly with a nice sandy beach area. The water is so beautiful and blue.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand is nice but the beach does not have a lot of depth. Also, once you are in the water there are some rocks so consider some water shoes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue, warm water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spend my retirement celebration here and enjoyed the beauty, sea life, restaurants and sun. Blue, blue water - wading with manta rays, dinner cruise and much, much more,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Perfect Spot!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach is a beautiful beach and the perfect place for a fun vacation. There are lots of activities taking place on the beach for all ages, or you can just sit and relax in your beach chair. The beach walk takes you by all the hotels and Whaler's Village with many shops and restaurants. You could spend your entire time at Ka'anapali Beach and be happy. It is also the perfect location for venturing off to see the other sights in Maui.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Urban Sprawl
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed here one night and glad to leave this huge condominium complex.  The room was very nice but the common areas were crowded with people like rush hour in New York City!  Kids were everywhere and their beach, what little there was, hardly merits a visit.  However get in your car and go around Maui and it’s gorgeous. We moved on to an Air B&B.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful with fun waves to play in
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love this beach! The beach in front of the Sheridan Resort has plenty of beach front and fun waves to play in. We enjoy snorkeling near black rock and our brave teenagers like to jump off of the cliff!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach Peach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach was a peaceful and beautiful.  The walk along the beach path allowed us to see all the beautiful sights

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must-do for Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and well-landscaped path along the beach with views that will melt your heart!  This is the Maui that you'll remember for years.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach and Awesome Time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pictures of the beach do not die the water justice. Is is so clear and amazing blues. Being able to swim and snorkel with turtles is a super bonus!  What a great time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach keeps you from coming back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach.  You can see the white sand on the bottom of the beach.  Turtle swims with you. You can spend the whole day there to enjoy the gentle sea breeze.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Accomodations/hotels are close to the beach! There’s plenty of activities to do! The beach can get busy at certain times of the year, certain times of the day for that matter! Going there before 9 am before the beach crowd can let you settle in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sandy beach with perfect body surfing waves and shopping close by
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So great to have the hotels right on the beaches but open to all. Walkways go from hotel to hotel to shopping and even a nice park with public restrooms and a payphone! Homes also have easy access and still nothing blocking you from strolling along on the walkway. Beautiful golfing and eateries mixed in with lovely flowering trees and plants. We watched sailboats and parasailing off in the distance and heard that there was great snorkeling. Live music can be heard at times as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and quiet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I got married on the beach right outside of the Hyatt Residence Club and it was beautiful and elegant experience. The beach was quiet enough for my guest to hear our nuptials but just the right atmosphere for fun and excitement as well!! A++

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great stretch of beach that offers everything from surfing to snorkeling opportunities. Waves aren’t big, but good for beginners. Black rock is a great place to snorkel but can get a little crowded in the afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Family friendly, clean beach. Close to town, hotels, food, shopping. The sand is soft. The waves aren’t too bad. It was perfect for boogie boarding and sand castles. My kids ages 6 and 3 loved it. The water is so warm. It’s a slice a paradise!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Once you've been here, it just isn't the same going to the beach anywhere else. The water is incredibly clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soft Sand, Great Amenities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach offers over a mile of soft coral sand, generally calm for swimming, and loads of good restaurants and nice hotels. The hotels range from cookie cutter national brands to locally owned, our favorite being the Ka'anapali Beach Hotel. Towards the north end is Pu'u Keka'a or "Black Rock," a small vent crater that provides great snorkeling right off the shore, for free.  Get there early for best visibility and least competition for sand and swimming room.  There is a shopping center, Whaler's Cove, about the middle of the beach which has everything from luxury brand stores to an inevitable ABC general store.  There are also restaurants from walk-ups to somewhat upscale, and surf/snorkel beach shops that carry quality stuff.  This beach is West Maui, meaning the warmer and drier side, so be prepared for lots of sunshine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: family vacation on Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a really great beach.  The black rock at the end of the beach is great for viewing turtles.  There isn't a lot of shade, so if you need some, be sure to get there early and set up on the far right side of the beach closest to black rock.  The beach is soft and the waves are perfect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Honeymoon
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the ka anapali beach for our honeymoon for 8 days and it was beautiful!!! People were friendly and it is in a great location for finding other places and things to do on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, we had plenty of room for our array of stuff, never felt uncomfortable leaving our things when we went to snorkeling. Not much shade and it does get very windy there, would bring a strong beach umbrella, don’t bring a cheap one as it will get destroyed pretty easily.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Favorite vacation location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is my favorite vacation location. Beautiful sunsets, gorgeous beaches and condo Ka’anapali Ali’i right next to Whaler’s village for food and shopping.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rough waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s been 32 years since I was on Kaanapali beach. The waters are pretty and the views amazing but if your a beach lover find another beach. I thought the waters were rough and the beach is small and on a decline. You have many many people and kids making their way up and down the beach so it’s definitely not a sit down and relax kind of beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with little parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach.  Beautiful and great water for my teenage daughters to enjoy boogey-boarding.  Parking is tough, so we went pretty early to be sure we had a spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another great day at Kaanapali
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kaanapali never fails to deliver.  Great beach for the entire family and it has changed very little over the 40 years my family has been enjoying the beach.  Usually protected so the waves are small and safe for the little ones and the beach is surrounded by beautiful hotels and Whalers Village which provide all of the food and amenities a family could ever need.  We were happy to find that the beach was not overcrowded during our stay .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really good family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wide open. Current not too strong. Shade nearby. Clear water. This is a very nice beach to spend the week on.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with waves calm enough to swim and plenty of coral and marine life to check out while snorkeling. Saw three turtles while we were there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Saguaro Football   State Champions
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our families 27th year of vacationing at Kaanapali. We have nine children and  two sons  were married at the Westin, more engagements and life celebrations have been held here. This year we arranged for our twin grandsons and 18 teammates from Saguaro HS, Scottsdale, AZ football program to do a final team bonding before they all left for college.  We were at the Marriott and it was a wonderful week. Kaanapali offered safety while still allowing these young men freedom to wander to Black Rock, walk to the Hyatts Lual where they danced onstage and were fixtures at Whalers Village for Hula Pie at Leilani’s  The boys all went parasailing, paddle boarding and some took surf  lessons from Tyler. One can never go wrong vacationing in Kaanapali.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Ka’anapali beach is amazing and stunning. I could of swim in the ocean for days! My only concern being two people were rushed to the emergency room with me being there only 5 days.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: awesome and fun ...great waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this is 4th trip to kaanapali beach and this time the waves were great. lots of whale sightings and the turtles....snorkle and surf, body surf and swim, shells and coral.. mahalo to the ocean....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Dreamin'
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Between Black Rock and the Honokohau River, this is one of the greatest beaches in the world.  It is manicured by hotels and condos along the beach.  A walk takes you past hedges and flowers as well as restaurants and Whaler's Village commercial centre.  The sand is perfect and fresh water showers dot the entrances to the beach.  Beyond the sands are rolling waves and the islands of Lanai and Molokai float along the horizon.  And the stillness of sunsets are a thing of simple purity against a bald sky or compelling multicolored beauty as the clouds float into darkness.      Occasionally Mr. Bubbles comes along and blows large lasting bubbles for kids to chase and play with in the breezes.  And the evening life starts in restaurants gliding along the path into sweet the night.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a pleasant beach to visit.  It was not crowded when we were there. Our teens enjoyed snorkeling there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can not beat the sunsets. We were staying at the Westin, which was right in the middle of the resort area on the beach. It seems the sun sets right there, right in the middle of the two islands. Amazing views. prob on of the few bright spots about staying on the touristy Ka'anapali resort strip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Decided to visit this famous beach and a wonderfully sunny day. The waves were quite dramatic and it was a bit difficult to swim but the view was beautiful, it wasn’t very crowded, and the golden sand went on forever.  My teenage son absolutely love this beach.  Recent shark attack not far from here so that may be a deterrent.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most crowded beaches on the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach bery crowded, and have very limited places to eat. However, the Monkeypod had amazing Gnocci. Hula grills flat bread is also good. Very few vegetarian options in the area, but the two mentioned was very satisfying. I would stay away from ‘Leilani’s on the beach’, few options and we felt sick after eating here. The Island Vintage Coffee had delish ice coffee. There is a lot of places to rent sunbeds if you are into that, and the beach does not have beds out already, because it’s only allowed to take them out once they are rented. It’s a great place to departure for a day trip on a katamaran, which is really nice. However, I would head somewhere else for more private beaches!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely breathtaking! We have been to many beaches, but this beach has been our favorite so far. The temperature was perfect, and the waves were big enough for boogie boarders and small enough for the little ones to splash in. The sunsets were beautiful too!. Some rocks are hidden in the sand once you get in the water which can hurt depending on where you step and if the waves wash them up. Pictures do this beach no justice, it is truly majestic!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parts of beach is dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The stretch of this beach along the big hotels is popular as it is easy.  Walk out the hotel and you are there.  But I think you will find much better beaches just north of there.What I didn’t like is that the waters here are very murky and there is a strong current, especially around Black Rock.I also noticed jagged structures and steel that was sticking out of the sand, presumably left over from the whaling station or other building that were there before.  Some parts also had a lot of rocks past the beach and because of the drop off, you can have rip tides and other hazards.The day after we left the area, a 51 year old man from California was attacked by a shark and died.  He was a bit further out than most people and was experienced swimmer.We usually head up to Napili, Kapalua or DT Fleming for a nicer beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Boogie Board and Snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We used the public parking at Whaler's Village to visit this beach. Good snorkeling near Black Rock and excellent waves for boogie boarding.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely amazing and the views are just stunning left, center and right! Watch our for the coral as there is a lot of it. You can find areas that don’t have it if you want to swim out farther! Great place to relax and have fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: kaanapali
reviewsWithKeywords.text: very nice beach to visit. many options: snorkeling, swimming, surfing, recreation etc.Many touristy restaurants and shops.Long boardwalk to see the many different things to do and see. This is a great beach to bring families or just yourself.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kaanapali Beach Golden sands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kaanapali beach is a lovely long stretch of golden sand that’s easy to access. Because if it’s length it never feels crowded despite the resorts along it. We often stay at the Westin Kaanapali Villas and can just walk to it from the pool area but there’s public access as well. There’s nice swimming and good snorkeling right off the beach (please wear reef friendly sun screen that’s readily available).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Undertow too strong for enjoyable time.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Do not recommend as your everyday beach.Beach is shortened in many places by the strong currents. There are other options near by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at westin villas so this put us at the north part of the beach. More slope here with less beach but awesome views , gentle surf and great snorkeling

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches on Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a nice wide beach with miles of sand.  You never seem to find it too crowded.   Temperature is pretty constant as the trade winds blow through.   Many access points and worth an afternoon of swimming and snorkeling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Beach by the Hyatt Regency Resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach here was very skinny and quite slanted, making it difficult to enjoy. Also, there was a large divot upon entering the water, where the waves broke and knocked you down. Not a good stretch of beach, but I did notice that further down, by the Marriott Residences and the Westin, it was nice and wide with much level area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved sitting under our umbrella watching the boats and jumpers from Black Rock. Enjoyed a morning walk down the beach walk. The ocean was warm, calm and sparkling clean. Just watch out for the sand on your feet. It is very hot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to stay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you stay in a condo along this beach you have almost everything you would want to do. There is a 3 mile sidewalk that runs down the beach, several restaurants with happy hours, breakfasts, lunches, and dinners, a Starbucks, a mall with an ABC store, snorkel rentals, a snorkel cove (Black Rock), and beautiful sunsets! We also took a sunset cruise that boarded right on this beach in front of Leilani’s restaurant. If you load up at Costco’s on the way in, you really wouldn’t have to leave this area at all!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love Kaanapali beach. Beautiful and, because we are used to Southern California beaches, I feel it’s not crowded, and we’ve visited at every season. The water is clear and warm and the beaches are clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkeling at black rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wasn't a great deal of marine life the day we were there.  The beach is nice. Very convenient showers available. Beach is fairly crowded

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soulless
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although the beach is lovely and the waters are clear. It all feels a little soulless and empty, one of my least favourite parts of Maui because it's not Hawaiian. You could be anywhere; Vegas, Miami beach or anywhere where you can shop in the heat. Lots of hotels and lots of shopping outlets. It amazed me how miserable people looked walking along the pathway that ran behind the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was beautiful. The waves can be strong in the afternoon and evening. Very near black rock and whalers village. You can snorkel or if brave enough, jump on the cliff.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Anniversary Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is outstanding. We were there for 10 days at the end of May 2019. The beach was busy but not crowded. There is a sidewalk that runs parallel to the beach from one end of the beach to the other. Hotels and restaurants line the beach which means tourist sometimes crowd the sidewalk. Ample parking and shopping is available at Whaler's Village, a shopping area. The restaurants provide good service and food but they are expensive compared to other areas on Maui.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely Sunsets but snorkeling can be difficult unless you swim out past the shallows.  Not a surfing beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great surf
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Body surfed from 30 feet off the beach. Awesome, clean beach. Nice breezes all day.  Not crowded at all. Best beach in America.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For a big guy, the sand was tough to walk on but the water is clear with lots to see. Didn't snorkel but everyone we talked to that did, saw a lot without going far.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So relaxing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love hanging out on that beach. Watching the waves, listening to the ocean. Even though we are living here ... we will never get tired of it. The other day we were at the beach in front of the Hyatt. I picked up trash on the beach (as always, there is plenty to be picked up) and I could not find ANY garbage can anywhere to dispose of it. That is a big thumbs down for me. I took it home. And that's ok. But easily accessible garbage cans would help. : )

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We really enjoy just being on the beach and in the area. It is very relaxing and there is a lot to do if you are so inclined. Was a little rough this year with the south swell but you were still able to go relax in the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: If your going to Maui, this is the perfect spot to lay back and relax.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed off of Ka"anapali Beach numerous times in the Whaler and other hotels, it's one of the best beaches in the world and that's not specifically just my opinion it's been voted as such on numerous occasions by the travel industry. Great restaurants in the area and plenty of shopping too.  However this area may be more suited to the +40 age group and doesn't necessarily have the night life of Honolulu.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Okay beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I like the vistas and views but the beach had a lot of rocks.  Also it was very windy during the week we visited and it was rough. This is not the news he’s fault but for me it was okay.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Some beaches are better for swimming than others.  Swim shoes might be good investment.  We loved sitting and watching sunsets and also early morning exploring on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach is simply breathtaking. Love visiting here every year! Been coming here since 2015 and will never stay anywhere else. MAHALO!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hidden Jem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our favorite beach.  Plenty of room, restroom and changing rooms close by.  Seemed to be plenty of parking.  The water is calm enough to swim and snorkel.  There was a shark spotted in the area the day we left...The local safety folks patrolled for a while to make sure it was safe to go back in the water.  The snorkeling in this area was awesome, we swam with  sea turtles. Its our new favorite, we will return.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun in the waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although the beach is washing out on the south end, it is still very nice on the end by the Sheraton.  It may be my imagination but the waves are breaking a bit harder near the shore line than I remembered in previous years.  It is great fun with boogie boards.  We did not snorkel but plenty were by black rock.  Only negative, some in our group were stung by jelly fish the last day.  Idk much about jelly fish but sounds like they just come in a certain time of year for a few days?  Fun beach and we enjoyed.  I may have felt differently if I had been stung!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the exclusive area where you want to stay as a tourist. Private, peaceful, clean, away from locals. It has a great walkway and high end shopping center and restaurants that unites all hotels in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful Beach Stay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a hotel right on Ka'anapali Beach! Safety is the first priority but swimming in the waves was heavenly!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our Favorite Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a wonderful, sand  beach with easy access to the water and a few shaded areas.  Black Rock has superb snorkeling, with usually clear water.  The older kids enjoyed climbing up and jumping off Black Rock.  Parking is difficult, we parked at the Sheraton and paid dearly.  Nonetheless, we did it twice because we love this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited. Fun for teenagers. There were large waves and a strong undertow at times that would be unsafe for small children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jim
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is by far one of our best beaches to go to, clean, friendly tress around, if you like to swim and snorkel this is the place, the bathrooms are nice. Parking can be tuff but  I suggest to park across street in the tennis are and walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful views, clear blue warm water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our 32nd trip to Kaanapali Beach over the last 27 years. We were in the area by The Whaler and Kaanapali Beach Hotel. The views from this beach are remarkable. The water was warm & clear. We spent every single day of our 2 week vacation on this beach. The only downside is the recent erosion of the beach.  The sand has been pulled out to sea and there is so much less to sit on without getting washed out.  We did find a small area to sit that had higher ground and stayed dry for most of the trip. We saw many many people set up their umbrellas & towels on lower levels and they were scrambling to pick up as the waves washed in. Mother Nature always wins.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking is non existant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are not staying in one of the beach side hotels you can forget about parking. There's a few garage parking spaces but they are always full. By small I mean maybe space for 10 cars. Thats it. The beach is a long strip by the hotels so there is always a lot of people here. We visited lots of beaches and this one has the biggest waves and riptides. Dangerous even for adults. I almost lost a kid. Even if you are only at the edge of the sand it can pull you in. You can drown in 2 inches of water. There are so many beautiful and serene beaches, so unless you stay literally next door in one of the hotels, go somewhere else.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Convenient Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great little beach in front of several resorts and also has public access.  Snorkeling is pretty good especially close to Black Rock.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a great time walking along the edge of the beautiful blue waters. Just spending time sitting on the beach on the sand was good fun. We built sand castles, no children with us, we did this because we could and it was good fun. It was just so nice to not have crowds around when we were there, the days were nice and warm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tricky parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach with a lot of resorts behind it. Only negative is if your not staying here parking is limited. All the free spots get taken very quickly so we just parked at Whalers village and got validated at monkeypod. Monkeypod has a great happy hour so it's a no brainer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great family beach with plenty of room....the beach is a few miles long and not overcrowded.   The sand is soft.   There are nice restrooms and showers to rinse off and plenty of parking in a nice parking lot.   We had the spectacular luck of seeing humpback whales jumping and playing offshore the day we went and it was thrilling!!    The entire beach stood up and cheered while watching the whales.    The joy we all felt at seeing these magnificent creatures was amazing!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our Family Trip to Ka’anapali Villas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We booked three condos at Ka’anapali Villas right on the beach. The place was wonderful for our two week stay. We could play in the ocean, use the lovely large pool, eat superb meals in the onsite restaurant. They also had a free trolley to take you over to Whaler’s Village for shopping and the famous Hula Grill. We also took it over to meet our snorkeling catamaran cruise. Very handy. We would do this again and again. The units were clean, spacious, and replete with Hawaiian decor. There was also a second pool on the grounds. What a perfect location!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic fun beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a perfect beach in Maui with crystal blue waters and Sandy beaches. There is no coral or rocks near the edges and so families are able to enjoy the water and beach all the time. We interacted with Green sea turtles every day and it was a perfect experience in a beautiful setting with 80° temperature and 77° water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach in West Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the only beach I could find without the rocky or reef button which kills your feet, trust me.  Soft sand bottom.  Park at Whalers village and get parking for 4 hours free validation with $20 spent which is easy to do here.  Come early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family friendly, quiet, less crowded beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to this beach when we stayed at Sands of Kahana.  The resort sits right on the beach and offers snorkeling equipment and paddle boards for rent which is handy for the family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Relaxing beautiful beach, loved every minute. Lots of beach side restaurants and shopping. Nice paved walking trail.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Naturally Beautiful Setting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A place offering breathtaking view in any clear day.  Not so much of sandy beach for swimming, but worthwhile to stay and relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, rocky around resort area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful, we stayed at Honua Kai and every entrance around the resorts was rocky with various trees in the water - doesn’t seem fully safe with kids and high tides there. There’s a public beach (airport beach to the locals) that is supposed to have better access, but we did not travel there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but popular.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a long stretch nice 1-2 mile walk. Plenty of space. On main drag of Whaler’s, all the hotels. The water was clear and warm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Average beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was not the beach I expected. Parts of the beach were nearly wiped out by the hurricane last year and have not been repaired. Other parts are OK. Of course the Pacific waters are warm and beautiful, but in all honesty, this beach does not hold a candle to Florida, the Jersey shore, or the rest of the east coast. Sorry Maui.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation with family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to spend a day at the beach. Go early to get a parking spot. Black rock great for snorkeling. Not much shade so take a beach umbrella. Water was quite rough when we were there so check before going.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We like the beach because it’s close to places to eat, not overly crowded, great views of Lanai and Molikai. This is not a secluded beach but if you want creature comfort’s this is the one for you

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach for walking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a long beach that ranges from wide and flat to narrow and steep. Along the edge is a nice path that takes you past resorts and some interesting art.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.  Walked from hotel along the shoreline.  Water was great.  We saw people snorkeling and the fire rescue practicing saving people using a board.  There is a boardwalk you can use if you get tired of walking in the sand.  Lots of activity next to the boardwalk like craft show, places to eat and can check out the other hotels for your next visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with lots of resorts on it.  There is also a shopping mall and lots of restaurants and bars to choose from.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beautiful beach is wide, long, and scenic.  It's great for walking or swimming.  Some shade is available.  This area is extremely developed, with high rise hotels, restaurants, timeshare touts, etc. lining the beach.  Normally, that would be a big detraction for me, but they have done an excellent job of preserving public access.  There is a very pleasant public sidewalk that goes along the beach.  There are also several public access points to the beach as well as free parking at these spots.  You have to look carefully to find them, and arriving early is best if you want to find a place to park.  Many people on this site recommend snorkeling at Black Rock, as did a local scuba tout.  I am a very experienced snorkeler.  Perhaps conditions were unusually bad when I went, but the snorkeling I did at Black Rock was very poor.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An amazing beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The cleanest softest sand you could ever ask for. Dark almost navy blue water. An abundance of marine life for the snorkelling enthusiast. Really a treat to spend time there. The only place I shave ever been able swim with sea turtles in the wild!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Surf was kind of high, we loaded a snorkeling cruise from this beach.  But the sand is really soft and there's a wide beach.  Great for playing in the sand or water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: quintessential Maui - picture perfect
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a daily walk for me when in Maui (in part because we stay on it, but also because you can clock an easy 5 miles of exercise while getting an amazing view).I'm fairly confident I left my heart on it, and it is the first and only place in the world that I've seen stars in the sand.   I'm pretty sure from google that these were dinoflagellates, but I've never seen anything like it in my life and would do just about anything to see it again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A very beautiful and long beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a highlight of our trip here to Maui. We do this walk most days because the views and the sand are more than worth it. This beach has plenty of parking that makes it easy to access. Try it out, you won't be disappointed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kaanapali Beach - amazing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a resort right on Kaanapali Beach. Beautiful sunsets every night, and a great place to snorkel! There are many reasons Kaanapali Beach is considered one of the best beaches!!! Absolutely love this place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good snorkeling right off the beach.  Saw some sea turtles and eels.    Very cool beach with some incredible sunsets

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Beach offers it all
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a favorite Beach for good reason.  The beach itself is great for swimming, snorkeling and just soaking up some sun.  A walk way allows access to many restaurants and shopping areas.  Choose your sunscreen wisely - Look for brands that don't have ingredients that will harm the environment (or your body).  The beach area has seen major erosion the last few years and this will be an ongoing threat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing and Not Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water comes up pretty far so make sure to put your things towards the bank. It was not crowded but the people there were very friendly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Take a stroll on the Beachwalk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We didn't know about the Ka'anapali Beachwalk until we got there. What a great amenity at this resort area! We stayed at the Aston Mahana at the north end of the path and walked all the way down to the Ka'anapali Beach Hotel in a leisurely 50 minutes to enjoy their Sunday brunch. A great way to get to the restaurants at different hotels especially if you're going to happy hour so you don't have to drive. A great way to get your daily steps in with gorgeous ocean views. Put your sunscreen on as there's not much shade along the way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach for easy snorkeling, sunbathing and walking around. Fantastic sand. Plenty of room. Bring your sunscreen!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Killer Beach, nice family spot, not too crowded even during spring break
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Killer Beach, nice family spot, not too crowded even during spring break. Wonderful... highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful beach, fun to people watch. Even spotted whales while overlooking the ocean from my room!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Maybe not the best beach in the world... but very close!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In front of our resort the beach area is very nice... 60-70 yards between the beach walkway and the water.  Beautiful, clear water, and a good surf to play in.  As many times as we've been here we have never seen the beach area to be overcrowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been so happy with our accommodations here. The pool area is amazing, the staff fantastic and the drinks are great! Such a beautiful place to vacation.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali beach is amazing and the beach walk was a great perk! Amazing view...we even spotted a whale breaching when whale season was very near the end.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 40th anniversary
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at the Hyatt for 10 days and had an absolute great time.  Hotel was clean, service was great and people extremely friendly.  Only problem we had was over Easter week the pool didn't have enough chairs for all the guests.  If you didn't go down by 8 am to reserve a chair you couldn't find on if you went to the pool after lunch time.  The weekend after Easter the chair problem went away so its evident during holidays and spring break time look out.  Drinks are on the expensive side at the pool.  Otherwise it was great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, the sand soft, the water clear. Portions are good for snorkeling, others for swimming. If you want to walk with bare feet through sand and surf and watch an amazing sunset, there may not be a better spot on all of Maui.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Still just as beautiful as ever...after 37 years of coming.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Enjoy a stroll on the walkway, sit in a hammock, eat , shop to your hearts delight. Beach is great as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach - Concerning Erosion
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've spent a lot of time on Kaanapali Beach over the years and have always loved the location. However, my most recent visit was a bit more concerning. The beach, especially in-front of the more Northern resorts, continues to erode. So much so that some of the beach-fronts are just slivers of what they once were. Hopefully there's something that can be done, but if going, I'd suggest the more Southern Kaanapali Beach locations. You'll find a wider beach and more enjoyable experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Swim with turtles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great family beach that features exceptional snorkeling.  While there, we saw green turtles twice that seem to be oblivious to all the humans close by.  Get there early though since it does get crowded with other families.  There is free public parking at the Sheraton parking garage.  Limited spots but you will easily find one if you get there before 8am. Great place too to see sunsets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent Beach...Postcard Photos!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach multiple times while in Maui and were never disappointed.  It can get crowded but there's always space and you'll end up making new friends by the end of your stay.  Waves are great for swimming, and safe enough for kids.  Sandy bottom with a few rocks/shells so you don't need water shoes to enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Why you come to Hawaii
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, lots of parking and just a fantastic place to sit and recharge.   Nearby amenities for you as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place loved it. We will visit again very nice soft waves you can watch the boats come and right on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Part of the Maui experience!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A clean, quiet beach with wonderful views of neighboring islands. Swimming, snorkeling, sun bathing, sight seeing or just relaxing, you'll enjoy this family friendly beach. DON'T forget you sun block, especially on cloudy days.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best beach on maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Put your chairs in front of Whalers Village or the Westin for amazing views of Lanai.  Stay in the late afternoons when the sail boats return and the surf picks up.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I first experienced Ka’anapali Beach in 2006, again in 2007, and most recently just over a week ago. It’s beautiful - white sand, warm water, gentle waves but strong enough for boogie boarding and some surfing. The walkway that spans the beach makes it easy to get to the stretch you’re looking for (and also to the shops and restaurant at Whaler’s Village). This most recent visit was during our kids’ spring break and I worried that it would be crowded. I needn’t have - it’s more crowded in summer and even then not bad. Probably due to the fact that the beach is lined with resorts and maybe not frequented as much by locals - but even when we drove past other beaches they were all pretty mellow and not crowded. If you’re making plans to stay in a resort at Ka’anapali Beach, the beach will not disappoint!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More sandy beach as you go south.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach really is beautiful and I am so glad we stayed at the Kaʻanapali Beach Hotel, where there is enough beach to sit on the sand and not get hit by the waves of water. The area in front of the Sheraton has less beach and you cannot sit down without the waves reaching you and your stuff! It is also quite crowded at this end because of the snorkelling at Black Rock. There is some shade provided from 2 resort buildings close to the beach (Aston at The Whaler is one of them), otherwise you will need to rent some shaded beach chairs or bake in the sun. There is a lovely walkway along the beach which takes you past beach equipment rentals, restaurants and the Whaler shopping centre. Especially great for morning and evening walks. Lots of resorts here but because the beach is so long, it is not that crowded compared to say, Kamaʻole Beach Park III. During our stay in March, there were lots of water warnings for swimming (big waves) so take care, but plenty of opportunities for boogie boarding and snorkelling too. Highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our last day at Maui, we went to this place, it was beautiful place, we enjoyed the big waves. bery clear water and not rocky beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles and fish and sand oh my
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Westin and love the beach here. Water wasnt overly warm but perfect to cool you off from the sun.Nice sand and lots of amenities close by. Great place to relax, get some Ray's and see some underwater wildlife.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach with beautiful views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice stretch of beach to walk along with lots of restaurants and shopping (whalers village). Good for children to play. Beautiful sunsets and views of other islands. Don’t expect to find shells.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very good beach, very nice to walk on, beautiful sunset views.  The walkway between the beach and hotels is extremely crowded. There were not a lot of people on the beach, probably due to to many people watching from the hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkeling, beach play and more
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Depending on what you want, the beach is fantastic.  Easy access to hotel restaurants and bars (not authentic food and overpriced) but areas in front of the Marriott have long stretches of beach and decent waves while closer to Sheraton and Black Rock are slim stretches of beach, little in the way of waves and a great area to snorkel only 20-30 yards off shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have always wanted to visit Ka’annapali Beach and it did not disappoint.  Clear and beautiful water and soft sand.  It was amazing.  My husband enjoyed snorkeling here as well.  It was a dream come true and we definitely will return.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Enjoyed the beach but it is non-existent at high tide. Especially around the Sheraton/Marriott. Luckily we stayed at Kā’anapali Beach Hotel, where the beach was a little wider and there were plenty of grassy patches to enjoy as well. Snorkelled around Black Rock and saw plenty of beautiful fish and some coral, but we got to swim with two large turtles which was amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Westin Villas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Always a great trip. Beautiful and easy. Good pools great area. Snorkeling fun right off the beach, turtles, octopus, without scheduling a tour or a boat ride.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best thing about Maui is the naturally beautiful things. The beaches, mountains, trees, flowers. This beach is so pretty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of shade trees for a break from the sun, waves can get rowdy so watch the littles for sure. Plenty of places to set up beach chairs and clean bathrooms.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As you move from the Black Rock area of Ka'anapali Beach and the Sheraton to the other end which has the Hyatt, you will find that the beach/sand area gets larger near the Hyatt. There is plenty of beach for everyone. If you're staying at one of the hotels on the beach, you can rent one of their chairs and umbrellas or a cabana but if you just want to swim and enjoy the beach, just grab your own towel and get some sunshine. This place is beautiful! Felt safe here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: great for snorkeling, lots of turtles, clean, gets windy in the afternoon.Beautiful water, beautiful views

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Windy ! Beautiful beach !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Whats there to say, this has to be one of the most beautiful beaches in the world ! If I had to pick a negative was just the amount of constant wind. Would go back in a heart beat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We saw a turtle
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Ka'anapali Beach to practice snorkeling before going on a boat snorkel trip. The beach is easy to access and there is free parking in a small garage attached to the hotel. We saw lots of fish near the coral close to the cliff. And there was a turtle swimming at the surface and it seemed as if he was posing for us. It was great!At sunset, a cliff diver will dive off Black Rock while an announcer tells a story about the tradition of the diver. The sunset was magnificent!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: kaanapali beach from honua kai
reviewsWithKeywords.text: it is terrible there is barely any sand, and barely any shore, and the ocean drops off pretty quickly and doesn't slope off. altogether,horrible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtle swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach - soft sand, clear warm waters, and so lucky to see turtles swimming around. Bar far the best beaches for families, with picnic tables, showers and clean washrooms

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali beach is beautiful and the waters are warm and welcoming. We have been to this beach many times and it is never crowded. Very relaxing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach offers everything from snorkeling to surfing. There are areas great for snorkeling and areasFor body surfing. There are moreSandy areas and less sandy areas. He sandy beaches with areas to spread out your beach gear are mostly in front of the Sheraton, kaanapali beach hotel, the Alli and part of the Marriott. The best snorkeling is in front of black rock at the Sheraton and in front of the Marriott. The best body surfing is in front of the alli and Marriott. The beach at the Sheraton seems to have minimalWaves ( seasonal) and is better for little kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is pristine and glorious. The color of the ocean is a varied blue balanced by muted pink sunsets. The location is central for world class hotels and restaurants. Golfing, surfing and pool lounging abound. Give it a go!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Can shop at the village mall for a parking pass validation. Recommend! Surf and waves friendly for beginner swimmers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely surf, sand, water, and view!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Whats not to like when you have such a beautiful location, soft sand, warm water, sunshine, and a great view! Great place to hang out and get wet, suntan, soak in Maui, roll around in the waves, and snorkel. Very family friendly and lots of places to take a break if you get hungry or thirsty too. We will be back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Hotels & Eateries Nearby
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful, but rocky in some areas. There are numerous hotels fronting it that offer stunning views and great amenities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Reflection and Swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Quiet Beach no matter who or how many people are on it.  The waves are mild and swimming was nice.  The water seemed a bit cold at first but was refreshing after a minute.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but rocky.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed here at the Westin for 10 days. It’s a beautiful spot but not easy for kids. There are huge rocks along the beach and just under the surf. Water shoes would be a great choice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, fun and relaxing, something for everyone!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a lovely day at the beach.  The water was crystal clear and there was some surf for the kids to play around in.  The highlight was jumping off of Black Rock for the teenagers, and we had the perfect view of their adventure from the soft sand!  The shopping area was very convenient for more sunscreen and flip flops, and the beachfront dining was very inviting...something to come back for!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach, soft sand, soft waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great for light snorkeling, swimming in the perfect temperature water, walk along the beach. Sand is nice and soft. Family friendly, lots of hotels behind the beach gives you access to restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Whales and turtles, sunsets, oh, my!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach!    Simply the best!  We parked at the parking garage near Whaler's.  There's fun shopping and happy hour stops near the beach.  The shops will validate for parking.  We walked the trail along this beach and found many places to enjoy the sunsets.  It was one of our favorite beaches during our trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not the best weather
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a group beach day here....rainy & windy majority of the morning. Definitely better beaches in the area. Was told there wasn’t any public restrooms and parking was expensive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful. Its part of a huge resort planned decades ago. the beach is long. however it planned around resorts. do some research and their are spots where you can find publoc access with great views

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Calm water, snorkeling. A board walk from parking and restaurants. We will return several times in the next week. This is also the place to watch the torch lighting ceremony on black rock.  Park at whalers village, buy something at s 15$ value and park for free

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Sunset Ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have visited Maui three times and have stayed on Kaanapali Beach twice. The beach and sunset here is unbeatable and far better than other views. We enjoyed walking on the lighted paved walk path which goes along the shore for quite a ways to all the hotels. When the stars come out the crowds thin out, all is quiet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent the week at a hotel on the Ka’anapali Beach. Beautiful water, lots of nice sand! It seemed like the current was a little intense, and there was kind of a steep drop off, but great beach overall! Would definitely recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful picturesque beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort room with ocean views and watching the waves literally roll in. Beautiful, soft sand and easy to walk on for a good work out or jog. Watch out for the waves, they can catch you off guard if too close and knock you down.  Best beach I have ever seen, cannot wait to go back. Mahalo!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Entire family trip with grown children & grandchildren.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a fantastic family trip. We were so busy we now need a vacation from the vacation!!! Our entire family was so very pleased to find GREAT snorkeling right out in front of the Westin North & South Towers!!! Our four year old granddaughter LOVED the colorful fish, eels, urchins & adorable Sea Turtles!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great for relaxing. Activities available. Fine sand and gentle waves make it a great Beach for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: USER FRIENDLY BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is a mile long and rather wide, when we went in May 2018 the waters were calm so it would be a great place for the kids to swim. There is also a long concrete walk that you can stroll along as you check out the many shops, eats, drinks and amazing sunsets.Caution, Nov. to March the waters are not so calm so always check with the hotel management about water/surf conditions.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We made the decision to spend most of our week vacation enjoying the beach, It was a good decision. Nice open beach with great views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful! I want to go back now!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love Maui! Ka’anpali Beach is a favorite. Great swimming/snorkeling, dining and hotels! I would go back during whale season, take a whale watch cruise. It will change your life!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach and with a view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach where you can go for a nice walk. In addition to the actual beach, there is a really nice boarded path along side the beach where you can run, walk, push a stroller, etc. There are a bunch of hotels and resorts along this beach. I stayed at the Royal Lahaina which was very nice. Some resorts have happy hour specials with food and drinks at a reduced price at their pool/beachside bars - this was the case at the Royal Lahaina so you can check with other resorts and find the same kind of deals. I would definitely go back to this beach and stay in this area. Great view from the beach as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love the gentle waves, perfectly soft sand and ability to get into the water easily. Hotels lining the shore all offer food and drink conveniently. It is the kind of black you see on postcards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My Idea of Heaven!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think Ka;anapali Beach is the most beautiful beach I have ever been to. We were there for 10 days (end of Mar-Beginning of Apr) and the sun shone every day, with temperatures in the high seventies (perfect!) The beach extends for miles, and includes a fabulous snorkeling part near Black Rock (north end), and a "Beach Walk" which leads south and passes all kinds of rental stands for beach and water sports equipment, all kinds of open bars and restaurants (with entertainment and special 'happy hour' drink prices, and a wonderful selection of shops. This beach has everything you could possibly want or need for your whole stay on the island!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sand and beautiful water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Make sure you hit this beach in the morning since the winds can shift in the afternoon, which completely changes the feel of this beach from calm swimming hole to choppy, windy ocean. Right at Whaler's village where you can park under cover and buy something to get your parking validated.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not hard to see how this is rated as one of the world's best beaches.  The view is fantastic and you can see whales in the distance.  Truly a paradise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Water was great and clean beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Westin Maui Resort and we enjoyed the clean beach and lovely clear water. Fairly water calm for me and my 9 year old daughter.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was the best beach I have visited so far! Stunning views and awesome sunset. Very clean and accessible from the hotel where we were staying.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bar none, this beach is THE BEST.  Perfect waves, gorgeous sand, and lots of room to spread out!  I definitely recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: most beautiful beach on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this is the most awesome beach i have ever seen.  in Kaanapali where we stayed there is a walkway two feet up from the beach which allows you to walk comfortably for more than a mile....many huts along the way with jewelry, shirts, drinks, ice cream, hats, etc.  it's just awesome...no words.  we went in March of 2017.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent snorkeling, only place I’ve seen an Eel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I snorkeled 7 different beach/corral areas. This area ranked in the top two for diversity of fish and corral. It helped that we snorkeled in the morning when relatively calm. It also helped that we wore wet suits and stayed in the water much longer than without. First eel of the trip! Not as crowded as a couple of the other places we went. We rank this one even higher than the paid for trip to corral beach - supposed to be Molokini but wind and seas were too rough at destination. We snorkeled here 3 years ago and did not have near as much fun. Calm water and wet suits probably made the difference.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach and so close to many amenities. Lots of restaurants to grab a snack when you take a break from the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: love to walk it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great beach to walk, sit and relax. Great for picnics as well.can get busy on the weekend but overall I love this beach. limited parking as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Maui 2019
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for swimming, boogie boards. Gentle waves. Great location. Only challenge is parking as you need to park at Whalers shopping. If you do not validate they charge you $40 (no joke). But if you spend $15 parking free. But once you are on beach it is great spit with restaurants close by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Memorable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Sheraton ,snorkeling at Black rock was with in my comfort zone (turtles and tropical fish ),waves on beach were perfect,beautiful pool and good nightly Hawaiian entertainment . Lots of whales spotted for the observant,and lots  of delicious food options within walking distance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with nice waves, lots of wildlife-whales and sea turtles right near by. Current and undertow can be strong so just be aware. Good parking as well

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach to vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is our sixth visit to ka’anapali Beach.  We love it as there are a lot of activities for both adults and children as well as family activities.  Many hotels to choose from and many restaurants to eat at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Royal Lahaina Resort in one of their cute cottages and really enjoyed it. The location was just beautiful - you could sit on the beach and see both Lanai and Molokai in the distance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beware the riptides!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is long and covered with a million tourists.About 20 yards out is a vicious riptide. Our family almost lost 3 children to it. Graduation trip to Maui was almost tragic. In my opinion everyone should visit this beach once. Just to let you realize how much you want to stay at another. Ka’anapali and the smell surrounding it is what is wrong with Maui.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Great day for sunburn.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is gorgeous! And as a result; crowded...One of the, if not THE longest beach in Maui; extending from Black Rock at the North West end, to Lahaina in the South. With plenty of room, although this beach is one of the most popular on Maui and crowded on most days, there is always plenty of room to stake out a spot if you can navigate your way through the expansive, maze-like commercial properties and over-priced resorts. One thing to remember is that there is very little opportunity for shade. The sparse trees and wide sand make this beach particularly exposed to the sun, so go early and bring lots of reef safe sunscreen (avoid those nasty spray-on types as the over spray gets blown into the water and kills all kinds of marine life. Not to mention what comes off of your skin...)We spent a good 6 hours at this beach, playing in the surf, which can get rather high at times... A 10 foot roller caught me while body surfing and stripped me of my shorts to my knees and exfoliated everything between there and my waist when it tumble-polished me onto the beach. Never turn your back to the surf...A great day of fun despite our rough treatment, left more than one of us reddened from sun burn and sequestered to the shade for the next few days.Picturesque, warm, sunny and sandy; if you do not mind large swaths of people (with a respectable amount of space between you) then this is THE beach.If you do not like crowds then move another 5 minute drive to the North or 10 minutes South for less crowded conditions.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. We are staying at the Westin and it is right on the beach. Clean with minimal to no rocks or shells. Lots of options to get chairs or pay for activities such as catamarans, surfing or paddle boarding.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at the Westin, I'll come back, pool was so popular with my kids it didnt really seem that they cared about the awesome. Beach out our Lanai

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing if you are in Maui definitely visit.   Black rock is awesome it’s frowned upon but you can jump off the cliff. The surf there is pretty tame but you still have to pay attention to the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful views.  All visitors were happy and pleasant.  A wonderful vibe.  The weather was excellent.  Watching whales was phenomenal.  Can't wait to visit again.  Mahalo.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Miles of blue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my favorite beaches ever!  So much pretty sand and you can see a couple of the other Hawaiin islands as well.  The sunsets here are to die for! Can hardly wait to go back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfectly sandy and fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach we’ve been to. No rocks on shore or in water, great waves for boogie boarding for kids, beginner surfing on south end, snorkeling at Blackrock on north end, not crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great swimming beach, with really nice snorkeling opportunities at the Black Rock in front of the Sheraton.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family friendly beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We hit this beach to watch the sunset and it was beautiful!  You can also head to Duke's restaurant to have dinner and watch the sunset as well.  There is a great walking path for over a mile that is nice to have a beautiful view of the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Catamaran tour and day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took an 8:00am whale watching tour with Trilogy that left right from the beach in front of Kaanapali Beach Hotel. There was a lovely view of a rainbow over the ocean as we waited for the catamaran to arrive. After the tour, we set up on the beach for the day. The sand is soft and fine and the views of Molokai and Lanai gorgeous. There is a sidewalk in front of all the resorts we walked along to go to Whaler's Village, where we did a bit of shopping and Aloha Hour. Great day and great beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a must do.  Beautiful beach with great waves that aren’t too big.  The beach is very busy and not super accessible unless you are staying on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved the beach and the sunsets I can’t recommend it enough. It’s not to crowed the water is warm. You can spot whales off in the distance and walk the length of the beach s great sunset beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a condo right on Kaanapali Beach. It was gorgeous and calm and good for swimming. Walked it everyday. Enjoyed the beach walk (boardwalk) as well which connects the hotels and restaurants.Beautiful sunsets too! One of the nicest on Maui!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun and Sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kaanapali ⛱ Beach is a beautiful sandy beach. Perfect for those morning walks or fun in the sun throughout the day. Caution, the current can be strong the further you swim out. Be safe. Enjoy🌞🌞🌴🌴

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This a very nice beach with public access. You must have water shoes. It has rocks and coral. There is a beautiful view, but not a super beach experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Totally delightful Clean and so nice . The snorkeling here in my opinion is better than black rock . Black rock is over crowded and visibility bad . We have loved every minute here

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We swam, boogie boarded, and snorkeled! Each day the beach was different depending on the weather. One day the snorkeling has low visibility, but the next it was spectacular. One day there were virtually no waves and the next it was perfect for boogie boarding. Great shoreline and lost of shops and restaurants nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a great time here. The beach was clean and we felt safe. Everyone there seemed to be having fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Sandy Beach for Family, Couples or Singles
