reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this beach. Have been coming here for over 15 years and it never disappoints. Beautiful sand, water and the resorts maintain the area from the impact of the tourists. Lots of activity area and the water is safe and warm. Will be back as many times as I can!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue blue water Ka’anapoli Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pleasant beach without the riptides and powerful waves of some of the other Maui beaches. Beautiful water!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Beach on Maui!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous and popular beach on Maui West Coast....loved our stay here, and not too crowded!  Loved it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Humpback extravaganza
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This has to be one of my favourite beaches in the world, not because of the powdery white sandal or crystal clear water… But because of the sheer volume of activity happening in the ocean.On an average day in February, you can see douzens of humpback whales breaching the water and generally frolicking around, slapping their tails and pectoral fins.Snorkelling is pretty good too, the marine life is fairly abundance although near the shallows the coral is almost all but died out. I didn’t see any turtles but many people who snorkelled saw plenty of turtles which is pretty awesome.You certainly have to watch out for the currents and the conditions, it can at times be pretty dangerous however the people in the resort have access to the snorkelling guide and can give you an indication of how safe the conditions are.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great snorkeling nearby: Honolua Bay. (Take tip money for the locals who own this land and allow access to the water; wear shoes, take fins and snorkel gear).Easy to access at Ka'anapali... great walkway on either beach or off the beach path.  Soft sand.  Lots of dining options and hotel options right here.Do NOT order "calamari steak" unless you realize this is NOT beef steak covered with delicious calamari. ;)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful views of the islands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Westin vacation club. The beach isn’t super deep but it’s beautiful and nice for sunbathing or a stroll without crowds. Much more expansive than the beaches we saw in Wailea like at the Four Seasons and Waldorf where the beach is relatively small and separated from other beaches- offering more privacy but you will likely stay by the pool. Ka’anapali was a very nice change from Honolulu’s Waikiki beach which was fun, but crammed with people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, beautiful views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long beautiful beach, and during whale season a high probability of seeing the beach and play all day.  Lots of hotels with great bars right of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very popular area for spending your vacation.  The length of this beach is full of large resorts. ( Sheridan, Kaanapali Beach Resort; The Whaler; Marriot; Hyatt regency, and The Westin)  We've spent many vacations along this beach in a few of the resorts.  Very gorgeous evening sunsets.  Definitely a must!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but too many people   I like a more secluded beach   There are plenty of restaurants and lots of bars

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best swimming beach on Maui
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visit Maui often, and a swim at Kaanapali is something I just have to do. The protected space just to the south of Black Rock has deep water swimming and decent snorkeling along Black Rock, usually a turtle to be seen (don't touch turtles, if you haven't heard, or they'll go awayyy). Most Hawaiian beaches can be rough and dangerous at least in winter, watch for shore-breaking waves here--I saw a guy body surfing dislocate a shoulder and get taken away on a cart.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very crowded on a Saturday, parking is available but not very close. A nice place to visit but I wouldn’t want to have to stay there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali beach March 2019
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just came back from Maui. we stayed at Westin resorts right at the middle of Kaanapali beach. 1. It was very windy and temp around 76 the entire time we stayed there so not beach weather. Very few people were in the water. Apparently windy is normal there and so is the temp this time of the year. KEEP THIS IN MIND. Once inside the water was not bad. So if you are used to Carribean winters and waters---this is not the same.2 Beach is about 1.5 miles long from Hyatt at the southern end to Sheraton at the northern end. It has a nice paved pathway entire distance. Resorts lining the beach are all high rise types. Beach is wide and expansive. The golden sand is soft but not powdery. No seaweed at all--Yay!!3 Water--was very wavy also not unusual for Maui. So clarity was not good with constant big waves. Same with Color--darkish blue not as pretty as the turquoise blue. You can still see your toes so it is not terrible.4 Ambiance---everything closes very early but there are many restaurants lining the strip and all are very efficient. We usually were the last guests in the restaurants at 9 PM. Only the bars in Lahaina Old town open late.  No vendors harassing you.Very clean and polished the entire beach with all the resorts with tropical lush settings.5 Black rock--rocky cove in front of the Sheraton was really cool for Snorkeling. we saw the most quantity and variety of the fish there than anywhere else in western Maui.---------------------------Overall the beach is nice, safe, clean, good sand, no seaweed wide and has a beautiful mountain backdrop. Plenty of restaurants to choose from. But the water does not compare to the Carribean beaches--this one is too windy/wavy/not as pretty color.I would like to go back but the distance from the East coast makes it not worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach with great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Westin right on the beach and never wanted to leave. The kids went back and forth between snorkeling and the pool for hours. So beautiful!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach spoiled by high rise hotels.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach is long and lovely.  Just keep your eyes toward the sea to avoid the jarring view of the line of tall concrete high rises that front it.  Most of the acres of parking are carefully hidden by beautiful bougainvillea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The very reason that we always try to stay at a facility on or near this beach. It is beautiful white sand and clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!! (Insert palm tree emoji here)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kids loved jumping off at Black Rock (part of this beach). Underwater it is crystal clear. The sea life is swimming all over making the snorkeling amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We always stay here! We stay on the hotels that are on this path. Make sure you are between black rock at one end and the Hyatt is the farthest to the other end. This is the best beach strip if you have kids.  The waves are not big so you can actually swim and snorkel in the water. There are great corals that wash up so it’s fun to look for those as well. There is lots of and area to set up your area as well. There are lots of restaurants and hotels along this strip as well. You are right by whalers village. There are lots of catamarans and different stands that you can do activities at. HighlyRecommend this area and this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Learned to surf here with my son!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Outstanding beach! Great activities! Fun to learn to surf. Lots of great places to stay. Black rock beach a must for snorkeling!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect swim beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance. Great beach for boogie boarding and playing in the surf. Black rock is great for snorkeling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The coral is re establishing itself!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a great small beach park. Very good snorkeling on the right side (as you face the ocean. Turtles and fish to swim with. Parking is good if you get there early. Bathrooms and showers are accessible just off the parking lot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After spending 5 days visiting a number of beaches and snorkeling spots on the island today was our day for Ka’anapali and Lahaina. We arrived at Ka’anapali Beach about 10:30 and found the steep, narrow beach to be very crowded. The snorkeling area below black rock was also crowded. Visibility was not good. I swam all the way out and around the point and did see a few fish but not in the numbers seen at many other sites that I have been on this trip on the island. I would not go out of my way to visit this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome Sights
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Must go must see. Bring a jacket in Feb/March and bring binoculars, photo lens with zoom capabilities. Sunset time colors are beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun in the sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are so many beautiful beaches in the Kanapali area of Maui. Try to go to all of them!!! All unique in their own way. Just lovely!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic stretch of pristine beach front that stretches several kilometers across some prime high end resorts and condos.  What a great way to relax, sunbathe, daydream and do whatever water activities you want.  Most of all, the sunsets are phenomenal and one can never get enough of sunrises or sunsets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet and picturesque
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great people watching, quiet, peaceful plenty of space to set up your spot.  We took chairs, umbrella and ice chest from our condo.  Took a picnic lunch and beverages.  Restrooms available at the surrounding hotels. Free parking is pretty much non-existent.  I was surprised that it cost $24 to park for about 5 hours of beach time and shopping.  Stores were willing to validate our parking ticket but we parked in a garage the stores didn’t participate☺️Snorkeling was better than the adventure we paid togo on.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches that I have had the pleasure visiting. The sand was so incredibly fine and soft - the water was a great temperature and not too cold at all for my children. The water did have some rip tide to it, so if you have small children then you will need to be within arms length at all times. Plenty of space on the beach this time of year and the beach was quite long  for a great walk along the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach is disappearing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was horrified when I returned to this beach after a few years absence. The beach was less than 25% in size from what I remember having visited the area last about five years ago. It is now reduced to a strip of sand about 10 metres or 30 feet wide, when it used to be large enough to have loungers and plenty of room for beach games such as frisbee or ball games. Apparently, rising sea levels, higher tides and changing weather and even climate change are all factors. Most west Maui beaches are shrinking. It is very depressing. Also, Maui is becoming very crowded, with traffic problems and parking problems.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEACH EXPERIENCES
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ka'anapali Beach is a series of connected beaches that differ a little in what they offer.  They are all well suited to sunbathing, castle building, wading, surfing lessions and SUP lessons.  Great beaches for fun in the sun and not super crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches on this planet !!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 3+ miles of beautiful sand and the coastline there is sheltered with the Au'au channel between the island of Lanai and the western side of Maui - the Humpback Whales come between November and April (swimming all the way down here from Alaska) to give birth to their young. They are so abundant in the month of February that the waters between Maui and Lanai and Molokai look like "whale soup."It was where the early Hawaiian Kings & Royalty came to vacation and, it's easy to see WHY when you take a look around.  Maui is definitely "no ka oi."

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty but not a walkable beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful but I was surprised how narrow the beach was, esp in front of our hotel. As the beach got closer to Black Rock it widen. I just wasn’t expecting it to be so narrow. Now I know!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Maui's finest!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This sprawling beach has beautiful golden sand, great waves for body surfing, good snorkeling and lava rocks to climb for a dive into the ocean. It's Family Friendly with kiosks to rent loungers, chairs and water equipment. Lots of restaurants and shopping just off the beach make this a destination beach to please everyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the Best on Maui, but Crowded In Winter
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is in front of the hotels and offers a "coastal walk" along the beachfront.   Personally, this is NOT one of my favorite beaches "in the world" as one person listed - but certainly a beautiful beach in Maui - However, it is crowded, commercialized and the hotels seem to make it as inconvenient as possible to enjoy this beach unless you are staying on their properties.  If you aren't with the hotels, park at the nearby shopping center and walk to the beach.  It will cost you, but it is about the only real place to park without staying at the hotels.  A shuttle is provided but seems to mostly run between hotels - check schedule.  This is a  great paddle-boarding beach in winter, and sometimes waves are too large for youngsters so parents beware - what seems to be calm waters can turn quickly into frightening waves for kids.  The sand is a beautiful beige but not the pure white that areas of Florida and Caribbean offer.   I prefer uncrowded beaches without vendors which is why I consider this a beautiful beach but not a favorite.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lets get wet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love this beach its a must go to not crowded every one is nice there. Put the chairs out take your ice chest and just relax and have a good time

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Whales & resorts
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at Ka'anapali Beach both times we were in Maui.  It is lovely with many sites to see.  It is most definitely touristy with large resort properties almost the full side.  Snorkeling is best done by Black Rock & Will's beach.  In winter, the surf is strong so if you are not a strong swimmer, this will be a challenge.  Restaurants are overpriced for the food but the view is lovely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach near our hotel! Saw turtles and whales! Clean beach! Great for a sunrise or sunset walk!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not joking! This beach has been voted numerous times as one of the best in the world. If you can, go to the north part called Black Rock by the Sheraton. Snorkel around there to see amazing fish and when you snorkel around the corner you can see plenty of turtles. Really cool. North of Black Rock are the latest hotels and resorts. No more space for anything else!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach - plenty to do there!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For a serene, peaceful, beautiful view, sit along Ka’anapali Beach, in the sand, in a lounge chair, at an ocean-view restaurant, in the water, on a boat,….  And just soak in the beautiful blue water, the swaying palm trees, the powdery sand, the surrounding islands, and relax.	Ka’anapali Beach is a beautiful beach, lined with hotels, and many activities during the spring, summer, and fall, and quieter, due to the whales migrating during the winter months (they don’t allow jet skiing, parasailing, etc. during whale season to protect the whales)  You can see Lanai and Molokai from Ka’anapali Beach.  Snorkeling is great near the black rocks by the Sheraton Hotel on Ka’anapali, and you can purchase a fairly inexpensive snorkel and mask at an ABC store, and snorkel right off the beach, often seeing large turtles, many fish, etc.  It is a good idea to have water shoes, if swimming in the ocean, as parts of it have some sharp rocks, spiny sea urchins,…  However, it is a much sandier beach than many on Kauai, so you can still get into the ocean if you don’t have shoes, but you may be more limited in some parts of it.  In front of the Hyatt, at least this February, the waves were a bit smaller than further up the beach, but you could only get in to about waist level, as then there was a sharp reef, that some could get past with water shoes, or carefully floating over it, but there were a lot of sharp sea urchins in the area.  It’s worth getting in the water, but you don’t want to injure yourself.  Many of the hotels will rent shaded lounge chairs on the beach.  In front of the Hyatt, they charged $130/day for a cabana lounger for 2.  If it’s winter months, you’ll want to wait until morning before booking them, because the weather can turn on a dime, and if it’s stormy, it will not be a good beach day.  Some spots rent just regular lounge chairs and umbrellas for less.  You can just kick back on the sand, but it can be nice to have a day or two with a more comfortable lounge chair.  Many of the hotels have lounge chairs only around their pools, and sometimes on a lawn before reaching the beach, which means the walkway along the beach will be in front of you, and sometimes also a hedge, which will slightly impede your view.  Some people purchase small beach chairs at Costco or Walmart when they arrive, to have at the beach, and then just leave them behind.  There are also several restaurants along Ka’anapali Beach, with beautiful views overlooking the ocean.  We went this February specifically to see the whales, which is said can be seen right from the shore.  I saw a few very distant puffs, and one fin waving in the distance, but for me, I needed to take a whale boat tour into the water to see them more up close.  The massive amounts of sunscreen getting into the ocean there is killing the reef, so, while you want sun protection, you may want to find as natural a sunscreen as possible, to help the reefs, as well as for your own health.  The water is beautiful, but it can also be turbulent at times.  Many people often have their belongings washed out to sea with the waves, even when putting their things right up by the hedges at the top of the beach, so be aware of the tides and waves.  And, it is a good idea to always have someone with you when in the water, even if an experienced swimmer.  Some parts of the shore can be fairly calm, and at other times can be rough.  There is a beach pathway that runs all along Ka’anapali Beach, and you can easily walk past the many hotels or to Whaler’s Village of shops, or to the Sheraton for snorkeling or to watch the diving off the cliffs at sunset, or to the Hyatt for their Sunday brunch,….  There is also a Ka’anapali trolley that stops at several hotels and Whaler’s Village if you don’t want to walk from one end to the other.  Parking is expensive, if driving and parking there. There is plenty to do along Ka’anapali, but often the best thing to do there is just to sit still, relax, and enjoy the natural beauty of the area.Why not 5 stars?  The beach can be fairly narrow at times, and your things may not be safe along the beach with waves that can creep up at times, and there are some areas with sharp sea urchins or rocks, so you'll want to be careful, and you are gouged by the hotels if you want a beach chair, or to park.... But, overall, it is a wonderful place to be.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach scene
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So easy to relax!  The water is clear and beach is pristine.  Small fun waves to enjoy.  Great opportunity to walk, swim, fly a kite, Boogie boarding, and whale watching.  One day we watched a munk seal rest on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clear water, perfect for snorkeling. The beach was perfect for my boys (8 & 12 years old) to just play in the shore and not get caught in the large waves.  Restaurants and restaurants are nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stayed At Westin condos-lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach...watch the whales.  Lots of available water spots.  Many walking areas.  Very pleased!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Friends and Family Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The number one beach on Maui.  The sunsets are amazing and the view is over the top.  Plenty of areas to just lay out and enjoy the scenery and soak up some sun, but not to much or you will get burned and ruin a couple days of enjoyment on Maui.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just gorgeousWhite sand, clear water, no wavesAll the hotels in area face the beach, where you can hire seats, beach lounges etc.There is a gorgeous walkway/path which is very popular for tourists to do their daily exercise of walking or joggingBlack is a popular snorkeling area at one end of the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Size, quality, support
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I found some of the beaches in Maui very small and Ka'anapali was a good size. We ate at a rooftop restaurant with a beautiful view.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kaanapali beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This incredible beach is so beautiful. It tends to get crowded so get there early!  You can snorkel with turtles just off the beach and there can be good boogie boarding. You can hear the whales singing near black rock if you just put your face down in the water. Wonderful spot

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach...so much to enjoy!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a wonderful day at Kaanapali Beach.  We walked along the water & loved the beautiful sand.  We found a spot to relax & watch surf school...many were able to successfully ride a small wave.  We walked toward the black rocks, and saw people jumping from the rocks.  In the little cove nearby we also saw sea turtles swimming near shore.  We also saw a few whale spouts in the distance.  Watch out for the waves-you will get wet!    The sunset was absolutely spectacular!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Water, the "bluest"!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walk the beachwalk or follow the water's edge to know you are in paradise.  Whales, whales and more whales in Late January and February.You can see them Right-From-The-Shore!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our condo unit was at Papakea which did not provide great access to the beach but a short journey down the road allowed us the enjoyment of this wonderful beach. Sunny skies and clean sand and water makes this one of the best.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: highly rated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: our hotel KBH was right on the beach,  clean sand. clean water.Black Rock was a short walk away.  great spot to snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big waves. Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have been to the Maldives a couple of years ago. The beach there is calm and quiet. Kaanapali Beach clearly has a bigger wave. good for surfing.A bit too crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hotel Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at one of the hotels along this beautiful beach walk. Our particular stretch of beach was not the best for swimming, steep with a sharp undertow, but very beautiful nonetheless, and literally just steps from the hotel. Clean and well kept shoreline.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach but busy.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach, conveniently right beside Whalers Village for shopping, lunch/supper and wash rooms etc. Very busy though. Centre of the beach is good for waves and calmer further towards Black Rock where it’s good for snorkelling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Popular but very nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort was right on this beach, enjoyed long walks along here.  Beautiful, clean shoreline.  Lots of activity with boats comeing & going to pick up passangers for whale tours.  But thatnkfully you can see lots of whales from the beach in this season.  Sand was pretty soft & easy to walk in.  Plenty of restuarnt opportuities along as there are quite a few resorts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Close to lots of shopping
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our first beach we went to after arriving in Maui. I loved the near by shopping. The beach was quiet. The weather was windy and rainy, but you can't complain when you are in Hawaii. :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but busy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want a secluded beach this isn’t the place for you.  However if you are okay with activity and people, this is a wonderful place. We chose to walk along the boardwalk for a while and then moved over to the beach.  There were crowds at the hotel pools but fewer people were on the beach.  We saw a monk seal napping on the beach which isn’t unusual according to some of the people we spoke with.  You should check out the Penguins in the lobby at the Hyatt while in the area. Don’t forget sun screen even if you are just taking a short walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kaanapali Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great sand and a great stop off for a relaxing afternoon.  Needed more time on this beach but of course had other things to do and at this time there was alot of rain so did not go on other days

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkelling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach! Good snorkelling, lots of fish and turtles... hiding in the rocks but you can see them anyway... beach has some public loos on at the entrance. The entrance to the beach is on some slippery, steep sone steps so might not be suitable for people with limited mobility

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful white sand beech to snorkel from and whale watch. Along the more expensive resorts but free beech access and parking if you look for signs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kaanapali beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beautiful beach with our entire family. The older boys 16 and 25 and older loved the large waves. They loved to body surf and boogie board. I would not recommend this beach for children under five as the waves were quite large and riptide strong and my daughters were concerned about their babies. The snorkelling was only average on that day as it was quite windy and the water was a bit murky. But all in all a very fun beautiful beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with some rocks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I really enjoyed this beach, white sand, palm trees, restaurants and some rocks which hurt your feet.I didn't enjoy trying to get out in the water with the rocks, but it is a very nice place to hang out at and walk along. A must see area of Maui in my opinion.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great for sunset & good snorkeling. We saw a whale breaching from the beach! A little hard to find parking and there are a lot of resorts right there, but the beach wasn’t overly crowded. Very nice sand and calm waters when we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girls trip!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I would never get tired of that view!  It was absolutely breathtaking!  And during whale season you could watch nature put on a show!  And then look forward to the beautiful sunset!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Always great!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We’ve been coming here for 15 years.  The beach is beautiful, safe, and during this time of year you can spot whales from shore.  Smaller waves, so good for little kids and wake boarders. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance.  Completely touristy but still beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great parts, “pick your adventure”
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beach that has something for everyone. The southern part was wide and not crowded at all with coral just off the shore (and fish!), fairly calm waves and a chill vibe. A little further north the waves increased in size for surfing and boogie boarding. Further north the beach narrowed and got more crowded but there was more of a “party” vibe and more adjacent restaurants and retail. At the north end near Black Rock the snorkeling is amazing and easily accessible to all. Lots of folks jumping from Black Rock but after seeing what’s under them while snorkeling, I wouldn’t chance it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach with great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, close amenities, rentals, shopping, and dining, and great snorkeling. Nice walkway to take a stroll any time of day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dont miss this
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous long stretch of beach with restaurants and shopping and hotels. Something for everyone. You can spend a couple hours here or an entire day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to walk and people watch! Nice boardwalk!Places to eat shop Parking can be hard to find!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice in places
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely beach in places, especially on the central and north parts.  To the south it is rocky  and not suitable for swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are lucky enough to be on Maui, make sure to visit this gorgeous wide, soft-sand beach with beautiful views of Lanai and Molokai, and- in the winter months- a fantastic place to watch the humpback whales as they frolic in the warm Maui waters before heading back to their feeding grounds in Alaska! Head over to Kahekili (aka Airport Beach) Beach Park on the Ka’anapali Beach for fantastic snorkeling right off the shore! At that beach park there is a beautiful lawn, change house/toilet facilities and beach-shower. Anywhere on Ka’anapali Beach is where you want to be, anytime of the year!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Such a beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach seems to go on for miles and is a beautiful, pristine beach with a wonderful miles-long boardwalk full of restaurants, shops, crafts, etc.  If you happen to have a hotel in Kaanapali you don't even really need a car to enjoy all the beauty of Maui.  The swimming and snorkeling is awesome from this beach, and the area known as Black Rock (a rock promontory out into the water just in front of the Sheraton Hotel) is an excellent snorkeling site. One must beware, though.  I will never go out there again without fins and a boogie board.  Both my husband and I got caught in a mild rip and had to be rescued.  We did not bring our fins that year which was a huge mistake.  I know what they say about getting out of a rip, and it is good advice, but VERY hard to follow!  With fins it would probably not have been a problem.  (We were strong swimmers once, but it's hard to believe that age takes its toll.)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ka'anapali Beach beautiful and hard to leave
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited Ka'anapali Beach in February of 2019. I spent four days here and had a hard time going anywhere else at least when the sun was up. Whales are seen everywhere.  Especially this time of year.  Beach is clean and not overly crowded when I was there.  A few surfers but there are other beaches if you're looking for that.  Overall just a beautiful place to lay in the sun and relax. Wish I was there now.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy, busy, busy Boardwalk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. The boardwalk along the resorts is extremely busy though. If you enjoy a 'Vegas strip' experience, this is the thing to do.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The beach is wonderful for all ages, the waves and undercurrents are not too strong like Makena, and the beach slopes gradually.  There are many restaurants and water excursions to do right there.  Easy Peasy

reviews.title: Perfect place to stay and visit in Maui
reviews.text: We stayed at the Kaanapali beach at Royal Lahina Resort. This is by far most lengthy beach with options to swim, snorkel and see lots of whales right from the beach itself. A lot of tourist visit Big rock which is walking distance from this beach.The sunsets are also amazing and offcourse lots of restaurants to choose from.There is also Kaanapali Troley which can take you to nearby attractions like whalers village for free.

reviews.title: Noteworthy
reviews.text: Can’t go wrong with this beach. It’s not too packed but note that it’s not the widest beach neither. The sand is good but not as good as Atlantic Ocean beaches

reviews.title: Love the Beach AND the Beachwalk!
reviews.text: I’m not really a beach person, but this one is an exception for two reasons: 1) lots of trees along the way providing some natural shade, and 2) there’s nothing like the beach walk, which I took full advantage of in the early morning while getting my steps in and watching the sunrise and in the evening for sunset. It just doesn’t get any better. The trail here is so much nicer than a boardwalk with all the tacky shops.

reviews.title: Turtles!
reviews.text: This is a great beach to snorkel at because it’s gentle with waves and there’s lots to see: turtles, coral, fish… many people climb the black lava rocks in front of the Sheraton and jump/dive into the water. Bring an umbrella for shade and enjoy the long beach walk. Watch the sun set from this beach!

reviews.title: Vacation getaway
reviews.text: We stayed on this beach and it was fantastic. A walkway to visit all the resorts for lots of meal options. Nearby is Whalers Village for shopping. The beach itself is beautiful and very clean. The thrill seekers can jump off Black Rock and there are turtles in the cove. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Great beach.
reviews.text: This is one of the best beaches in Maui. Great places to eat/drink. Near Black Rock for snorkeling and swimming. No shade so bring it rent some. That sun is no joke.

reviews.title: Nice for just hanging out
reviews.text: We stayed right near this beach and enjoyed it. Easy to get to the water and there were even turtles. Bring your snorkel just in case as the ocean is full of sea life.

reviews.title: Beautiful long beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, long but short to land with your towel.The water is beautiful, the view of Lanai and Maloka'i islands makes the moment even better.There are a lot of waves but nothing to surf, just something to have fun with.You can have the chance to swim with turtles and also admire corals and beautiful species of fish.

reviews.title: Nice beach that offers magnificent sunset views.
reviews.text: The Kaanapali Beach connects many hotels and resorts in Maui. The beach has many areas for safe swimming but one has to be very careful with children due to water currents and a sudden incline when swimming. I swam in low tide and the water became deep abruptly after about four or five steps in the water. Children have therefore to be supervised at all times. The Whalers  Village near the Whalers Report is a nice place on the beach to buy breakfast, lunch or dinner along with some necessity shopping. This beach offers a great sunset view without having to take a sunset cruise. I have withheld one star because the beach is not as good as the crystal white beaches in Tanzania including Zanxibar. Munir Daya

reviews.title: We loved it
reviews.text: The resort is amazing. We took a helicopter ride, a tour, and snorkeling. The food was amazing. There were about 5 pools for adults and children.

reviews.title: Beach of dreams
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach, we went in June and was surprised how empty it was! The beach ran in front of our hotel so we were lucky enough to see it every day 🥰

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach- sunsets and cliff jumps
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful with the bonus of cliff jumping. -smooth sand and entrance to water-not rocky at the water entrance- lots of snorkeling-saw a turtle - large beach - stands near hotels where you can tent chairs, umbrellas, etcIt’s a swim to Black Rock where you need to climb up to take the jump. My teen boys could do it- I couldn’t do the climb!! At 6:30, there is a torch lighting a cliff jumping right before sunset. The sunset here is beautiful.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: We enjoyed the Ka'anapali Beach so much from our condo at Aston Ka'anapali Shores and from Whaler's Village. Well maintained beach, clear beautiful water, great for surfing and snorkeling.

reviews.title: The Waikiki of Maui
reviews.text: We have stayed on Kaanapali before, visited it many times. It's a nice, tourist-centric beach. I call it "The Waikiki of Maui" . Kaanapali is where Sharpay and Ryan go to the beach. Great swimming, you can sunbathe steps from your boujee hotel room, people watch infinitely, and burn the crap out of the soles of your feet. Shade is nonexistent, so bring or rent your own. Tons of nice restaurants and upscale watering holes all along the beach. Khaki shorts and Chubbies shirts abound.The $200 sunset cruise on a catamaran is 300 yards away from the shore looking at the same sunset you will see for free, which is usually the best part of the day on Kaanapali. Great sunsets. Seriously. Snorkeling is mid at Black Rock, mostly nonexistent along most of the sandy area.  You have to jump off of Black Rock at least once in your lifetime. You came this far, suck it up and take the leap. You won't regret it. It's a beach on Maui. All stereotypes apply. It's not private, unique or intimate. It's a meat show, but there is saltwater to float in, and sometimes, that's all you really need.

reviews.title: Great Beach Day
reviews.text: We  quite enjoy Ka'anapali Beach. We always go early so we get a great spot away from the crowds. It is a quite nice beach indeed.

reviews.title: Most breathtaking beach I’ve personally seen so far
reviews.text: We had a wonderful trip to Ka’anapoli beach, as that is the resort area we stayed in. The ocean are the most brilliant and beautiful variations of blue and turquoise. It’s simply something I know everyone would love. Maui is beautiful with so many things to do and sightseeing. It saddens me to know Lahaina was burned when the volcano erupted. The road to Lahaina was absolutely stunning! I hope I make it back there one day to see all of the beauty on that island! We were there in 2018 not 2024 - TA wouldn’t let me choose outside of 2024 dates.

reviews.title: Fun Beach Day
reviews.text: The beach was so enjoyable! The sand was soft and the water was a beautiful blue. We brought our own snorkel gear and could snorkel!

reviews.title: A Monk seal turns up everytime im at this beach
reviews.text: I don't care where I stay in Hawaii.I'm coming to this beach every time.It's right next to the hyatt .....it's perfect...and monk seal swim with me everytime i visit..... Sometimes it's busy and sometimes it's not but the water's always perfect.

reviews.title: Great beach..better w fins
reviews.text: Some reef by shore and black rockIs great for snorkeling. I feel better w fins on as there is a pull down the beach and it’s not nothing to swim back in if you go out a ways. I feel more confident w fins . Beautiful clean  Sand bottom and crystal waters .. if you stay under you can hear the whales.several Spots to catch surf lessons or a snorkel/whale watch boat ..closer to whalers village or down by Marriott . Bring your own towels /chairs because the rentsSell out by 8/9am

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with great beach walk
reviews.text: Ka’anapali Beach is my happy place! Beautiful beach wirh a beach walk where you can stroll in front of many beautiful resorts. Always has beautiful sunsets, simply picture perfect.  Areas for beginners to learn how to surf in front of Marriott condos. Love this beach!

reviews.title: A soft sandy beach in Maui with sunset
reviews.text: One of Hawaii’s most beautiful beaches with a miles-long boardwalk between the best hotels and restaurants

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Very nice, sandy beach. Wide area for everyone to stretch out without feeling crowded. Many activities such as whale watching, surfing, paddle boarding etc. can be purchased right from this beach. There is a pretty healthy surf with no lifeguards on duty, so watch your small children. Lots to do and see on the nearby beachwalk and surrounding area. Parking is limited and is not free. Definitely a great beach worth visiting.

reviews.title: Very Developed but Still a Beautiful Beach with Stunning Sunsets and Great Snorkeling
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach along the west coast of Maui.  Terrific snorkeling on the northern end of the beach near Black Rock especially if you swim into the cove just to the right of the rocks. Whales can easily be spotted right from the beach and hotels located here and not far offshore during the season. Even cooler was hearing the whale sounds underwater reverberating off Black Rock when I was snorkeling. This was surreal. Although the beach remains beautiful, it is quite developed with resort hotels and the touristy Whaler's Village shopping and dining complex. Although it is a long beach, it surprisingly isn't very wide, and it certainly gets busy during the day. Nevertheless, it is still beautiful and the sunsets here are stunning.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Beach Maui
reviews.text: Our favorite beach on Maui, especially the stretch north of Black Rock. Fantastic views of Lanai and Molokai and during whale season you can whale watch directly from the beach.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: A very beautiful beach with soft and clean sand. The water is a perfect temp and the wildlife is nice to enjoy when you come across it. Not as crowded as some of the other more famous spots.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Each was amazing,  numerous turtle sightings. Easy to get in and out. Not many people, will want to take water and some food.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Clean and safe. Traveled with other women and always felt safe walking the beach and beach path. We walked mornings to avoid crowds on the beach path. Afternoons were more crowded on the beach, evenings can also be busy during dinner time. Overall one of the prettiest beaches and sunsets I’ve seen

reviews.title: Expansive beach
reviews.text: Great place for a walk. The beach seems to go on forever. Lots of good options nearby for food and drinks as well, but it can be very busy.

reviews.title: November testing
reviews.text: Beautiful places to be visited , I have visited on 21 Nov 2024 and its place to be remembered and surely will go next year as well.

reviews.title: Medallia testing
reviews.text: Medallia Testing - 21st Nov 2024, Great Place to Visit with Family.Recommends to visit this place. Don't Miss.Visit during Later years.

reviews.title: very nice beach
reviews.text: very nice beach. i can swim and relax here all week. so stabilizing and behavioral. very recommended

reviews.title: Very nice Beach in a highly developed part of the island
reviews.text: The beach itself is very nice, perfectly fine sand, with the Black Rock lava formation on one side and various resorts in the back. You can walk to Whalers Village for dining and shopping, again an ice cream and come back to the beach. The water was very warm and inviting, but it gets deep very quickly, so not great for little kids. little snorkeling or wildlife compared to other beaches in Hawaii

reviews.title: Sisters trip. Hotel staff makes you feel like your home. Family friendly atmosphere.
reviews.text: Rooms were spacious, clean and nice. Our room had a walk out to a patio that look out to the ocean (ocean view). Breakfast was included with our rooms and was very delicious. Two onsite restaurant, one for  fine dining and the other for breakfast or to order and go. Hotel staff were very polite and friendly. Very homey atmosphere.  Price was reasonable. Would definitely return.

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach Visit
reviews.text: Enjoyed a sunset walk and then dinner on Ka'anapali Beach. Definitely worth a visit if you're on Maui. Nice wide sand beach with clear water. A popular departure are for may catamaran tour boats. Parking can be a challenge.

reviews.title: Best of the Best
reviews.text: **I went in Jan 2018, but couldn't select a date that far back**Amazing beach. Beautiful. Picturesque. Sets the standard for all other beaches.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach with Something for Everyone
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is a gem! The soft sand and clear water are perfect for swimming, snorkeling, or relaxing. It’s spacious, well-maintained, and the sunsets are breathtaking. With nearby resorts and restaurants, it’s easy to spend the whole day here. A must-visit in Maui!

reviews.title: Must see and explore this beach!!!
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning beach. This beach has so many gorgeous blue colors, stunning fish swimming through the reef below it was so fun snorkeling with the kids. The beach is pretty narrow but shockingly not overcrowded. This is also the beach that works renowned Wayne Dyer frequented.  Now I understand why he spoke so highly about the energy and beauty of this beach.

reviews.title: My new favorite beach 🏖️
reviews.text: We came for the Hawaii Wildlife Discovery Center. I saw this beautiful beach from the 3rd floor where the center is located. So we decided to check it out. 既来之，则安之。Turned out to be one of the best beaches everyone in my family finds the niche they like. My teenagers love riding waves- 🌊, it has the perfect sized waves, not too wild not too tepid, close enough from shore where parents feel kids are within reach if unexpected urgency occurs. The emergency rescue equipment is right there by the beach. Kids had a half day fun there. My husband loves beach and people watching. The hustling sailboats, ⛵️, waves 🌊and kids wife in the water kept him busy 😂I love snorkeling. The long stretches of rocks near the beach attracted variety of fish 🐟 🐠 to float along with. It’s amazing that I’m able to watch kids riding waves 🌊 by the shore while snorkeling not far from them. Put it another way, kids are absolutely safely sandwiched with me watching from ocean side and my husband from beach side 🤩. Now the snorkeling me feel very safe too: there are 6 or 7 sail boats 🛥️ 🚤 further out in the ocean, lol, I can snorkel all I want without worrying about my safety. It’s almost a paradise like situation as I’m not an adventurous traveler such that I do treasure safety while having fun. The peace of mind knowing everyone can safely enjoy the ocean is priceless. Hence it’s now my favorite beach in Hawaii islands.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The beach has beautiful sand and is very clean.  The water is crystal clear and the perfect temperature for July.  We also met many kind people.  We stayed at The Westin and found that area of the beach to have very rough surf.  We also spent time near The Sheraton (which I believe is called Blackrock.  The beach has a much more gradual incline.  The waves weren’t quite as rough.  In the last day of our vacation we visited the area close to the Marriott for dinner.  The beach was less crowded and the surf seemed calmer as well.  Overall the entire beach is beautiful.

reviews.title: Brilliant Bucket List Trip and Every Bit as Good in Reality
reviews.text: What a stunningly beautiful place. A brilliant bucket list trip I've wanted to do for years. Every bit as good in reality. Stunning.  Best beach in the world?

reviews.title: Paradise Found in Maui
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is stunning with clear waters and golden sand. Perfect for swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing. Amazing sunsets and convenient amenities nearby. Highly recommend for a Maui visit!

reviews.title: Perfect beach for families
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that is great for families.  Snorkeling and any other beach activity is possible.  Clean and walkable anytime of day or night.

reviews.title: Building sandcastles and this cute turtle photobombed us!
reviews.text: Family friendly! Great place to bring children of all ages, and let them play in the small waves, make sand castles, and possibly see a turtle.

reviews.title: One of if not nicest beach on Maui
reviews.text: One of the nicest beaches there is on earth.  Great boardwalk that spans a very long area provides by the hotels.  Very nice restrooms. Public parking

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The water is absolutely gorgeous and serene, and the people are wonderful. However, the sunset truly stood out. It made everything worthwhile.

reviews.title: Discovering Paradise
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach embodies paradise. Its golden shores, pristine waters, and breathtaking vistas create an idyllic tropical setting. Whether you're soaking up the sun, exploring vibrant coral reefs while snorkeling, or taking a leisurely walk at sunset, this beach offers a complete experience. Embrace the beauty and tranquility of Ka'anapali Beach—it's an opportunity not to be missed.

reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is absolutely breathtaking! The sandy shores and transparent waters are ideal for swimming and snorkeling. Black Rock offers thrilling cliff-diving opportunities. Convenient facilities and dining options nearby enhance the experience. Spectacular sunsets are the icing on the cake. Strongly recommended!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach on Maui is stunning! The golden sands, clear waters, and vibrant marine life make it perfect for swimming and snorkeling. Black Rock is a highlight for cliff jumping and snorkeling. Convenient amenities and great nearby dining and shopping at Whalers Village. Gorgeous sunsets cap off an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Clean
reviews.text: Clean beach with soft sand. Small areas to gather. Nice area to snorkel. A family of turtles. No beach chairs - bring your own.

reviews.title: Nice beach, but crowded on the day we went
reviews.text: We love Hawaii, but this beach was a bit crowded and not our favorite in the area.  That said, there were some amazing views and the water was clear and beautiful.

reviews.title: Tourists still welcome on Kaanapali?
reviews.text: Have come to Kaanapali beach yearly in April for 5 or more years.  This year we were disappointed in the tent community on the beach in front of whalers village protesting short term rentals in Maui.  Seems there could be more pressing fire related issues that might warrant tents on the beach...short term rentals affect housing world wide.  Although perhaps Maui after the fire is more unique and would be better off if tourists did not come here so much to give the locals more space on their island.

reviews.title: Beautiful Island & people
reviews.text: My dad talked about Hawaii & and its people. After he passed, I wanted to visit some places he talked about. It was more than I ever expected. The people are lovely, and the island is spectacular.

reviews.title: Excellent.
reviews.text: The ambiance is trendy yet comfortable, making it ideal for intimate dinners and lively gatherings. This restaurant exceeded all my expectations.

reviews.title: Great beach - bring snorkel gear
reviews.text: It’s a great beach. Lots of sand and awesome sunsets- however this is a snorkeling beach.  Lots and lots of coral reef- it’s not a place for boogie boards - etc.

reviews.title: Breathtaking beach
reviews.text: Surfed, swam, walked and watched whales from the beach. Beautiful and very well maintained. Great effort by everyone to keep this beach clean and free of litter.

reviews.title: So beautiful, but dangerous
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Silky soft sand and calm blue water. My only issue is the coral. You need to really watch your step when swimming. Unfortunately, i stepped on one, and my foot still hasn’t completely healed yet. I mean, i went there 9 months ago! Other than that, very nice.

reviews.title: Clean beach and sea
reviews.text: A beautiful, wide beach. Pure. Fine sand, beautiful clear sea. However, it is a tourist place with lots of hotels and resorts. It does not disturb the beach itself. Toilets, showers all at hand. Refreshment. Markets with local souvenirs. In the evening you can watch the sunset. Whales can be spotted between February and March.

reviews.title: GREAT EXPERIENCE.
reviews.text: Everything was great! So clean and tidy. Large room and bathroom. Comfy bed. Perfect location, right on a calm and peaceful beach. As soon as you walk out of the accommodation, you see this wonderful beach.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: No one mention the homeless people that are taking over the beach and all the garbage they leave. Great job, governor and Mayor

reviews.title: I would stay here again
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach…golden and soft sand.High presence of surfers.Accessible to all as it is public.When we were there, the sea wasn't exactly calm so I can't tell you if you have to walk a lot to get to where the high water is.If you go by car, be aware that there is only one car park which costs $10/h but does not exceed $50 per day so if you spend more than 5 hours you will always pay $50.There are many luxury hotels overlooking the beach so you can either bring your own lunch or have lunch there.

reviews.title: Still a nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beach, there were protest on the beach...I agree with the locals, locals need a place to live when they lost their homes due to the Lahaina Fires.  I pray for Maui and Lahaina.

reviews.title: How can we rate one of the most beautiful beaches a 4/5?
reviews.text: We love this beach. We were unable to get out in the water for a couple days due to high surf, but today it was gorgeous and the whales were giving a spectacular show. You can hear them talking under the water by ducking your head under the water. So why not rate this beach 100%? It’s not the water, the sand, the whales or obnoxious beach goers. It’s the Hawaiians themselves who have let half the most beautiful beaches in the world become places for vagrants to live in giant piles of trash.  We left Oahu hoping to get away from this scourge which brings a sore on the landscape everywhere.  It’s not as bad on Maui, but definitely the government fails to make this a concern throughout the islands. The water is beautiful,  you don’t need wet shoes, the place is gorgeous; come and enjoy and try not to look behind you at the locals disrespect for the environment.

reviews.title: Assaulted in Ka'anapali.
reviews.text: The weather was not ideal, the seas were rough, precluding snorkeling and the tour boats were not booking. One evening on a walk with my husband, I was assaulted by a group of Hawaiian youths. They came up behind us,  yelling profanities and one youth threw a full glass of iced soft drink at my head... We filed a police report. This was our worst experience in Hawaii after many years of coming for two weeks in mid January. I would not recommend Maui any more as it has changed so much, and not for the better. I am very agitated by this encounter. I no longer feel safe here.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Walking Path
reviews.text: This review is written from a night trip along the trail that runs in front of the hotels.  Kaanapali Walking pathThe path is nice and well kept.  However, at night it is dark and you should take a flashlight.  Also, there is a colony of cats along the hedges.  There are lots of cats and they are not afraid of humans. We used the trail at night to walk along the resorts.

reviews.title: Does not disapoint!
reviews.text: Now is the time to go! Just got back from Maui and this beach was definitely a highlight of our trip :) It says 2-3 hours, but if you want to really enjoy it...4 hours is not wasted time: snorkeling along the rocks, the beach was expansive and not overly crowded (mid-beach find a palm tree to lie under - so peaceful!), the weather was near perfect, and the food was pretty tasty beachside with live Hawaiian music! Stock up on sunblock and water shoes (for the rocks if snorkeling). As beautiful as this area is...the contrast driving there was heartbreaking as you can't miss the utter loss and damage of the recent fires. When you see it you will realize that these words are a gross understatement and the people who live and work here are amazing. The service, hospitality we received here couldn't be beat and such a beautiful place to visit!

reviews.title: Maui works
reviews.text: While it’s true you have to drive by the remains of Lahaina on your way to Kaanapali, the county has done a good job of walling off most of the damage from prying eyes. But this is definitely the time to go back, because Kaanapali is happening the way it always did. We just got in but the beach is amazing, the resorts are running well and these good people of Maui need our financial support. You won’t go wrong up here; the Safeway at the cannery mall is remodeled into the biggest, nicest, cleanest grocery store we’ve seen, and we live close to a Whole Foods and a big HEB. The tourist count is way off, so there’s no 30-40 minute wait in line for anything. We’ve always loved Maui and Maui is—if anything—easier to love, so show them your support. You willbe glad you did…

reviews.title: Beautiful sunsets on Kaanapali Beach
reviews.text: Stayed at Hyatt Residence Club on Beach.  Absolutely gorgeous, clean beach.  Not wide due to erosion.  Direct view of Lanai for sunsets.  Never really crowded, whale spouts in evidence this time of year.  Very relaxing

reviews.title: Outstanding beach and a must see on Maui
reviews.text: The beach and the views are amazing and we love the island of Maui. We were two couples who stayed in Kihei for a week. We loved the Kihei area as very nice beaches and more affordable condos, stores and entertainment. We drove to Kaanapali beach for the day and it took about 45 minutes with a cool drive along the coastline. We had lunch/drinks at one of the restaurants on the beach and walked the beach. It had been about 10 years since we visited Hawaii and we can see why Maui is paradise. We need to go back before 10 years passes again.

reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.text: The beach in Ka'anapali seems to have partially disappeared, at least there wasn't much beach left in front of some of the resorts. Further north it was much better, but not as outstanding as we expected. If this is the most beautiful beach on Maui, well, so be it.

reviews.title: Nice beach. Good place to go. There is free parking though there are not a lot of spots
reviews.text: Nice beach. Good place to go. There is free parking available but it is limited. Will recommend the place

reviews.title: dream beach
reviews.text: The most transparent water I have ever seen. With fish and turtles. Marvelous. Very clean beach and the environment prepared to be very entertaining all day

reviews.title: Beauty Beach
reviews.text: Loved Kaanapali Beach north of Black Rock. The beach was quieter and swimming and snorkelling were still good. We stayed at the Maui Eldorado so spent a few days at this beach. Without even snorkelling, saw turtles swim by every day as well as a monk seal. The water was warm and clear and the sand soft; beach was clean. Nice views. There was enough wave action most days for body surfing or boogie boarding. It did get deep quickly and even in gentle waves they would take you out a bit so you couldn’t touch bottom. My teens were fine but keep a close eye on small children here.

reviews.title: Wonderful, full of renowned chain hotels 👍
reviews.text: Long beach for walking, spectacular sea for swimming and with several pleasant restaurants in Beira Mar, including a MALL

reviews.title: such a great beach, 10 ft away from tropical fish
reviews.text: We spent a few days here on this beach, so clean, not rocky (no need to wear water shoes) and 10 ft away from tropical fish, great to go snorkeling here! This beach was conveniently located right by our resort, such a pretty place, lots of families come here. I got a floatie to use and that was awesome just floating around.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach and waters.  Not too many rocks to make walking/swimming in the ocean uncomfortable.  Very enjoyable.

reviews.title: Beachy Bestest Beach on Maui
reviews.text: Love this beach on Maui- our fav at hotel where we always stay and play - gorgeous views - soft warm sand and just the best beach

reviews.title: Kaanapoli Beach is awesome
reviews.text: Actually visited during June through August of 2020.  Just locals, I was fortunate to spend the summer here with my adult kids.  No tourists was interesting experience and since I’m from Central Florida it was an awesome break.Great to experience this beach as it was, not many people on the beach.  Everyone kept to their own group.Lovely place to visit and swim, maybe jump off a rock into the ocean.

reviews.title: Beautiful water and clean beach
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely beautiful.  The sand is clean and the water is turquoise and clear.  It was a bit crowded but we found an area closer to the Sheraton that was pretty open.  I imagine the snorkeling is amazing.

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean beach
reviews.text: Very beautiful and clean beach. Not very crowded despite being Mid-June. Great location near resorts, hotels, restaurants and shopping. Lacks more public parking.

reviews.title: Honeymooners
reviews.text: Great beach with amazing natural living coral and plenty of wildlife to view from snorkel gear. We decided this was our favorite beach on west Maui

reviews.title: Relax and enjoy
reviews.text: Lovely beach in late May / early June. We stayed at the Royal Lahaina Resort so access was easy. Not crowded at all. It was fun watching the efoilers on the water. Water was clear and plenty of beach to enjoy.

reviews.title: Great Spot for Snorkeling and Relaxing
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and great snorkeling near Black Rock! We saw lots of types of fish and sea turtles! Can get a little crowded with hotel guests.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Probably one of the best beaches in the United States. Beautiful views from the beach. The reason we came to Maui was to see the beaches.  The snorkeling was great too.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beach is clean. The water is clear, blue and beautiful! The sand is fine and silky. Many gorgeous palms everywhere and was not over crowded.

reviews.title: Go for the snorkelling, if you can find parking
reviews.text: Am I the only person that didn’t love this beach? Maui is amazing, and I read so many blogs recommending kaanapali beach, butttt it’s touristy, full of high rise hotels, and the parking is terrible. Ok, so snorkelling at black rock was pretty epic, but there are sooo many more authentic beaches to go to on the island.

reviews.title: A slice of paradise
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is undoubtedly one of the best beaches West Maui has to offer. Gorgeous aquamarine water with long stretches of white powdery sand beaches against  the backdrop of Molokai island is as idyllic as it can get. The only downside is that it can get a bit commercial with many resorts and restaurants along the beachfront. The Black Rock at the end of the beach is famous for snorkeling and the daily cliff diving ceremony at sunset. You can also take a sunset cruise if you fancy. There's also plenty of shopping at the Whalers Village if you enjoy retail therapy. One of my favorite beaches in Maui for sure, despite the crowds.

reviews.title: Just Another Day in Paradise
reviews.text: Ka’anapali Beach was absolutely gorgeous with large areas of soft sand, warm water, beautiful scenery and waves that were fun for children and adults to play in!

reviews.title: Beach Review
reviews.text: Beautiful stretch of beach.  Clean, calm water, beautiful views.  We love that it’s never too crowded. Black Rock is a short walk away and it’s fun to see people jump from it!!!!   Snorkeling is great. The sunsets are to die for !!!!    Go.   Now!!!!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach on the north side of the island. We had a great day walking around and enjoying the water.

reviews.title: Hawaii!
reviews.text: Great experiences with all our grandchildren and our 3 children.  hope we can all come back again sometime soon.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Water is wonderfully clear. Fantastic snorkeling at Black rock.Turtles will sometimes swim right past you. The beach itself can be crowded so that is the one downfall.

reviews.title: Good snorkeling
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with bathrooms. Good snorkeling. Lots of cool fish. Restaurants nearby. Nice boardwalk down the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach with stunning views. Definitely can get crowded in the afternoons but that's the same with most beaches. I enjoyed walking along it in the early morning and at sunset

reviews.title: KBH IS Paradise!
reviews.text: We love this beach. Nicest In  the world in our opinion. We feel like a different people when walking the beach,sand in my toes, Maui air in my lungs and Aloha in my heart. Do it. You will for ever be changed like we were and we will never forget it. Kaanapali, till we meet again. Mahalo.

reviews.title: Heavy breakwater
reviews.text: Strong undertow. Hard to get in and out of the water without getting slammed to the ground. (But we are older). Great beach walking. Water clear. Beautiful sunsets. Not too crowded.

reviews.title: Best beach walk
reviews.text: You can walk on the paved path or on the sand  (we did both) and have a wonderful experience seeing all the resorts and natural beauty.  Sand bottom drops off quickly once you're in the ocean.

reviews.title: Truly lives up to their claim to be the most Hawaiian hotel.
reviews.text: This was an amazing hotel. The service was excellent and we stayed in one of their pre-refurbished rooms which was clean tidy and comfortable. The staff were really kind and friendly lots of Aloha.Should have way more than just 3 stars.

reviews.title: Ka’anapali and Maui are Amazing!
reviews.text: We love Maui. This was our second time to stay in Ka”anapali. It is a wonderful location about an hour from the airport and about an hour from Wailea. We spent 10 days there on this trip. The waves were unusually large for that time of year, it is usually much calmer during May. We were able to go out snorkeling and enjoyed a few days at the beach. One of our favorite finds was Pa’ako Beach. The waterfalls and hike at Haiku are a must! I highly recommend a vacation here.

reviews.title: Enjoyed seeing the whales and turtles close to the beach.
reviews.text: Kaanapali Beach is wonderful. About 1 hour from the airport.  Lots of hotels and condos to choose from. Also, near Whaler Village for shopping, restaurants and activities.

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful, long, fun beach.  We loved watching the boats come in and the sunset.  The sidewalk in front of the hotels and condos is busy. But the beach had plenty of room to walk.

reviews.title: Paradise!!!
reviews.text: Rainbows and sunsets, non-stop! This location was perfect for our style. Thank you Maui Kaanapali Villas!!

reviews.title: Pure Heaven
reviews.text: Pure heaven, fabulous views and delicious waters with unreal sunsets! It was one of our best beach experience ever. In fact, this year we will be back again even if we are coming from very far away, from Switzerland:)

reviews.title: Awesome Beach
reviews.text: Beach was never too crowded, turtles swimming by, perfect water temperature, clean.  Easy to get too.

reviews.title: Best beach on Maui!
reviews.text: The whale watching is incredible!  Beautiful beaches that aren't crowded.  The perfect choice for a stay in Maui!

reviews.title: Windy but relaxing
reviews.text: Spent the afternoon lunching and nature watching. Several whale breeches, a bird that looked like a roadrunner (probably a plover). numerous roosters and hens scratching around the picnic tables. This was a wayside park that was on the beach. Very high winds that day. Watched windsurfers and wave surfers.

reviews.title: Best beach in this area.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach!  It is long and has lots of high end restaurants.  Great for kids.  We parked in the ramp at Whalers Village, walked the beach and ate at Hula Grill where we got parking validated.

reviews.title: Fantastic way to spend a day
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach, turquoise water and amazing whale watching at this time of year (February). Gorgeous sunsets as well.

reviews.title: Nice area of beach by the Sheraton
reviews.text: Best area is in front of the Sheraton. You can valet park for $5 if you eat or drink at the resort. Also stay for the cliff diver at sunset!

reviews.title: Customer Service
reviews.text: HEADS UP, FOLKS.  Never book a stay at Ka'anapali Beach Hotel.  We were just screwed out of our first night there at a cost of $500 all because our flight from the mainland was cancelled. The hotel manager was not in the least bit concerned that we were not able to arrive on time.

reviews.title: Great beach for walking!
reviews.text: We spent a couple of afternoons at Ka'anapali beach during our recent trip to Maui.We enjoyed walking the beach and wave jumping. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.

reviews.title: Tropical fish, turtles, and whales… ocean waves and the best of Sunsets.
reviews.text: This is such a beautiful beach… there is ample sand and grass to sit on and really great snorkeling… there is one downside, getting in and out of the water to go snorkeling is very difficult. The waves on shore will toss you like a rag if you don’t watch for the right moment. The fish and turtles are plentiful… it feels really safe to go out far.  The whales jumping in the distance is a wonderful way to just sit on shore and relax.  Parking can be tricky, this beach is nestled between two hotels and they don’t offer many beach parking spots. Overall, this is my favorite beach in the area.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful walkable beach with gentle waves and soft sand. We stayed at a resort on the beach for 2 nights. Safe area for families.

reviews.title: Escape to paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with stunning sunsets, whale watching in the winter and plentiful beach bars with live music. Food and beverages are a bit more speedy but that is the price of paradise

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: The beach is stunning and perfect for snorkeling. Make sure to bring sunscreen because if you don’t have an umbrella, there is no other shade. We spent most the time in the water. Kids of all ages were enjoying the waves.

reviews.title: Ka’anapali beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sunset! This beach is perfect to watch the sunset! There it isn’t as far from the shore to the water as some of the other beaches and the waves don’t seem as wild. It’s connected to black rock beach which is also fun! Parking can be tricky but there are multiple lots!

reviews.title: Very good stay if you don't mind so many people
reviews.text: Amazing beach and easy access if you stay around. It is always busy because it is so convenient to access. The beach itself is amazing.

reviews.title: Great beach. Amazing views. Sunset!!! Things to do.
reviews.text: Such an amazing beach. Great views of Lanai and Molokai. One of the best places to see the sunset.  While it can get crowded, the beach is really wide so you can find enough room for a spot to put down your blankets. There’s lots to do. Whalers village, shops and restaurants. Can rent gear. Snorkeling and rock jumping at Black Rock. Water is warm year round. Some boat excursions pick up from here right on the beach. I’d recommend staying at one of the hotels or resorts right on the beach. They say parking is really hard to find and expensive.

reviews.title: Would stay here every time I visit Maui. There is no place like home……except here. Thank you KBH for a wonderful time.
reviews.text: If we should come back to Maui 100 motet I es I would stay no where expect here. The staff is so friendly they make you feel like you are at home. The greatest so beautiful and immaculately kept. Rooms so clean and serviced daily  I just love it here. This is actually our 2nd time here

reviews.title: No beach now....crowded
reviews.text: Resort row. Lots of people. Beach completely washed away due to storm. Would head north to Kapalua...better beaches less people.

reviews.title: Stunning views are just the Beginning !
reviews.text: We spent a whole day on the beach.  We got lounge chairs, snorkeling eqpt, and fins and were just estatic.  The views are amazing and the water is so clear.  The beaches are clean and the people were so friendly.  I even got burnt up. HA HA.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This was one of our favorite beaches to visit.  It was beautiful, with soft sand!Downsides: Not where I would pick to snorkel, lots of people because of all the resorts.Tip: All resorts in Kihei are required to supply a certain number (about 10 from what we saw) free beach parking spots so, drive down to the resorts and look around for "Beach Parking" to hopefully snag a spot. Start early!

reviews.title: A perfect beach experience
reviews.text: We visited Ka’anapali Beach in December, the weather was perfect ( mid 80s ). We utilized several of the many free access parking areas where it was a short walk to access the beach. The sand was perfect and the beach was incredibly clean and large enough for folks to spread out giving you the feel that you had the beach to yourself at times. The water was very clear for snorkeling and checking out the many corral combinations, we swam with the sea turtles everyday. Ka’anapali beach was a daily stop for us - a must do on any trip to Maui. Remember to bring some swimming shoes or flippers as the corral can be very sharp

reviews.title: Terrific place
reviews.text: Time share there.  zip lines over beautiful plantations, even the kids can do it, horseback riding to the most beautiful places with terrific guides. even the ride from the airport along the water past little private beaches.

reviews.title: OK if you are a resort person
reviews.text: Unbelievable seafront resorts the entire length. Much better and quieter beaches towards the south and north. Would not choose to stay on this beach again.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in America
reviews.text: This is a great beach. Other than a section that was washed out during a big storm in Sept there is a fantastic walkway that goes for miles.  This area is beautiful.  Many restaurants and shops as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: A lovely beach to visit - water is clear.  We loved our stay in Ka'anapali and enjoyed our time on the beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: We stayed in a location overlooking Ka'anapali Beach and thoroughly enjoyed walking the beach and watching sea turtles feeding.

reviews.title: Dreamy Deep Blue Sea
reviews.text: Ka’anapali Beach is fabulous. Easy access, beautiful white sands,  pristine waters with lots of sea life. It’s a must see.

reviews.title: Amazing snorkeling, with convenient amenities
reviews.text: A quick walk from many hotel options, the beach at Ka'anapali (old airport beach in particular) is an amazing attraction for first time snorkelers. We saw multiple sea turtles, octopi, eels and an amazing array of tropical fish.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Great beach, easy access to hotels and restaurants, and Whalers Village. great place to watch the sunset!

reviews.title: Love to swim in the ocean!
reviews.text: One of the most spectacular beaches!  And not at all crowded.  The water temperature was about 70 degrees, waves were gentle and easy to swim.  There’s also a lovely paved beach walk you can do with restaurants and hotels.

reviews.title: It's a different beach
reviews.text: The beach is not what we remember.  Evidently a large swell in May or June took out a big portion of the beach.  Upended boat remains in the front of the Marriott property.  No longer the nice sidewalk that went from Hyatt to Black Rock.  Walk on the sand or back up through the hotels to the street.  There was also a fire in the West Maui Mountain raining ash into Lahaina. Nature is relentless.

reviews.title: Shopping, Eating, Beach Time all in one spot
reviews.text: We always visit Whaler Village when vacationing on Maui. Great shopping and dining. And the beach has plenty of showers if you plan on going for a dip.

reviews.title: Always, Always beautiful!
reviews.text: We were staying north of Balck Rock at the Westin Villas and though it was much more crowded with umbrellas and people than usual for October there was still plenty of beautiful ocean, beach, and plenty of walking and snorkeling room!  Always, our place to find our peace!

reviews.title: West coast of Maui is my go to place
reviews.text: Didn't go in the water on this beach this trip-walking along the beach to different hotels and Whaler's village really nice.  Recent storms washed away parts of beach by Hyatt Resort and roped off so there you go.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Clean, with plenty of room, and a lovely calm ocean perfect for relaxing or snorkeling. There's also free parking!

reviews.title: I loved it!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I've ever seen! I'm in love with Maui. Loves whalers mall two hotels away!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This is another gorgeous beach on Maui that is certainly worth taking the time to visit. So many choices but this is a beautiful one. Clean and pleasant and worthy of its excellent reviews.

reviews.title: Manicured beach fun week plus trip here
reviews.text: Pure sand and waves perfect for families. It felt like the beach had been combed. It was just perfect. We stayed a hundred yards off the beach and we were there every day. We saw Turtles most days. Waves were great to ride and boogie board. Chairs and some trees provide some sun relief. Loved staying here.

reviews.title: Swam with green turtles
reviews.text: This beach lived up to the ratings I had read about prior.We originally parked our butts down on the sand a few hundred metres from the black tock cliffs and had a great time. However, not many fish to see though as no rock or coral in the area. But seeing how many swimmers and snorkellers their were by the cliffs, we decided to venture that way and glad we did. Once there, I donned my mask and snorkel and decided to check out the area by the cliffs where the majority of snorkeling was happening. My decision to move down the beach proved wise as there were all kinds of fish to look at. And better yet, a turtle swims into my area, about five feet below me. And then while I am  (and many others are) watching this one turtle, a second one joins the first. What an Incredible sight and even if I am never so lucky to experience it again, this will be one I will never forget.
