reviews.text: One of the best places on Maui to go to the beach - we traveled all around the island and should have stayed at our own hotel beach.The best part was sunset tiki torch lighting at black rock, a glass of wine, and whales breaching right out from where we were.Surf conditions were rough and it was so windy we got sand blasted (winter in Maui) but loved it.

reviews.title: One of the Best Beaches on the Island
reviews.text: This beach has it all - great sand, surf, and nearby snorkeling, great dining options nearby, and clear water.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: This is a great place to stay, play and snorkel at.  We stayed at the beach hotel, enjoyed the luau they have and also went snorkeling. It was all amazing.

reviews.title: The best beach in west Maui
reviews.text: The beach goes on forever and ever. It is just a wonderful sandy beach with tons of room; it’s never crowded.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Kaanapali Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches on Maui.  A variety of activity options are available on this long and lovely beach.  In addition to the beach itself, the walking path paralleling the beach is also very enjoyable for leisurely walk or for exercise.  A not to be missed beach in Maui.

reviews.title: Beautiful Long Beach 🏖
reviews.text: Beautiful beach for walking or swimming. Neither undertow nor currents the day we were there. At north end of beach is Black Rock which is a great snorkeling spot! I know you’ll think I’m greatly exaggerating but we swam in a school of hundreds and hundreds of wrasses! Many eat in or take out restaurants at Whalers Village.

reviews.title: 50th Anniversary
reviews.text: This beach is just perfect!  Beautiful sand, clean, lots of activities, such as surfing, kayaking, paddle boarding, and cafes.

reviews.title: Best in Maui
reviews.text: Exactly the beach you dream of when traveling to Maui.  Gorgeous sunsets and not too crowded. Lots of whale watching from the shoreline and nice walking path.

reviews.title: Great location and beach
reviews.text: Great location and beach. Near enough to restaurants and things to do while being a great location to relax and enjoy the surf and sun. Have been here before adnbhioe to come back.

reviews.title: Our favourite beach this side of the island.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with a GORGEOUS sunset! The ocean was a bit rough but not intimidating at all. There’s a lot nearby too. If you’re on this side of Maui I highly recommend taking some time to enjoy this beach.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Long stretch of beach!  Not a calm beach but very clean and nice!  Fun to walk the path along this beach, you can sit anywhere along the beach off the path!  Its connected to Whalers Village which is nice too, grab some treats do some shopping!  Lots of good restaurants along the beach too!  My suggestion go to those early less busy!!  Over all really like Kaanapali Beach!!

reviews.title: Long stretch of sandy beach
reviews.text: This long stretch of sand runs for a couple miles along west Maui shores north of Lahaina. You can access the southern end of it at Kahekili Beach park which has decent snorkeling. There is also good snorkeling at Pu'u Keka'a (Black Rock) in front of the Sheraton on the beach and north of Whaler's Village. The beach extends even further to the north to Ka'anapali Point, where a reef in front of the Marriott offers some decent snorkeling as well. It is possible to park at hotel lots and pay the hotel for parking or park at Whaler's Village and stop by there to eat and shop at the end of your day. The businesses can validate your parking for up to 4 hours so you are responsible for the rest. Pay at the machines before you exit.

reviews.title: Beuitifull beach
reviews.text: Kaanapali beach is rated the most beuitifull beach in the world an now after visiting there for a week I see why . It’s definitely the nicest cleanest beach we’ve visited!!

reviews.title: Kaanapali No Ka Oi
reviews.text: We love Kaanapali Beach, great views, walks, snorkeling and kayaking.  Not a great surf spot though.  In the winter can be windy, but you can see whales right from the beach! More family oriented than other parts of Maui and Lahaina is close!Best sunsets, IMHO, especially in the summer when it happens between Lanai and Molokai

reviews.title: World Class Beach
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is one of the best beaches in the world!  This is THE beach on Maui and I would definitely recommend!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, clear water, soft sand
reviews.text: This is one of our favorite beaches!  First time to this beach. We have visited other Hawaiian beaches as well as some beaches in Caribbean.  This is tied as a favorite.  Here’s why: 1) the sand is soft on your feet, you don’t need water shoes to enjoy2) crystal blue water was clear as can be so you feel safe 3) family friendly beach, but not overcrowded4) in February we could sit beachside and watch the whales putting on a show easily - don’t even need to go on a cruise5) very clean6) gentle waves

reviews.title: Clean but $$$
reviews.text: The beach is open but if you check into one of these hotels you'll be spending big bucks. Access to beaches is generally open but all the good spots are taken by the hotels.

reviews.title: Great Snorkeling Spot
reviews.text: What a treat if you are staying on Ka'anapali Beach.  You don't have to get in a vehicle to enjoy some of the best snorkeling with colorful fish and turtles.  Easy beach to enter the ocean with low waves.  Nice long beach for a stroll.  You can rent chairs and umbrellas if you wish or bring your own.  Plenty of spots for everyone.  With luck you'll also be able to watch whales near by.

reviews.title: Adventurebuddies42 goes to Ka’anapali beach
reviews.text: Every time we go to Maui we either stay or definitely visit this beach. It has everything from a beautiful beach, many hotels, restaurants and activities. You can surf, go on catamarans, kayak, paddleboard... so many options. Even if you just want to sit on the beach and relax. Highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach and the sunsets are beautiful and breathtaking! I will be back next year for sure to relax more as this year is done. February is the perfect time because of whale birthing and mating season you see the whales all day.

reviews.title: Perfect beach day
reviews.text: Ka'anapali beach is perfect for relaxing in the sun with family and friends.  We were here in February during the whale season in which over ten thousand whales visit the bay between Maui and the neighboring two islands.  It was wonderful to drink the morning coffee while watching the whales in the distance.  It is highly recommended that you bring a binocular for a closer view.  The water is not as clear for snorkeling as some other beaches, but it is still possible to see a good variety of fish here.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Small intimate beach which in February is great from water activities, whale watching, sea turtle activity or just baking in the sun!

reviews.title: Nice day out
reviews.text: Kanapali beach is very pretty with big hotels. It is the older area with big hotels , we visited two of them 34 years ago, when there were only two. Now the Wailea area with the big new hotels is nicer than Kanapali Beach. Beach is great , white soft sand and public for everyone to use. You can eat at any of the hotels on Kanapali as they have nice terraces overlooking the beach. Fun day out there.

reviews.title: A week with friends.
reviews.text: Fantastic location for a relaxing and enjoyable holiday getaway with friends. Lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance and the beaches are fabulous. There is also a wonderful golf course right by the beach.

reviews.title: mesmerizing
reviews.text: beautiful  sand beach that is so thick you can wade in it   easy entry to the sea without a lot of lava rock

reviews.title: Best whale watching from shore
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to relax and enjoy. So fun to see whale activity from shore. Lots of breaches.  People stopping to watch.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach!
reviews.text: Long stretch of beautiful beach; plenty of room so you're not on top of each other. Plenty of vendors if you want or need to rent any beach equipment. Snorkeling at Black Rock was so-so compared to other places.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach facing Lanai and Molikai.
reviews.text: Great way to spend the day, sitting on Kaanapali Beach. Snorkeling is terrific. Turtles, eels, and lots of fish!

reviews.title: Afternoon Beach visit
reviews.text: We come to this beach every year we stay on Maui.  It is very clean, has picnic tables and a area attached to the bathrooms that you can host a family function.  I would caution you to wear aqua socks if you're going in because there is coral outcroppings in the sand that will cut bare feet and give you a possible infection.  It is very pleasant and relaxing.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: My wife and I rode scooters out of Lahaina to Ka'anapali Beach. The scooter ride was fun...the beach break was awesome. Blue sky, warm temps, calm waters, soft sand. What more could a person ask for? Plus, there were crystal clear views of Lana'i and Moloka'i. Well worth a visit if you are on Maui.

reviews.title: Beyond Beautiful
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Hyatt Regency on Ka’anapali Beach. It’s simply breathtaking. The water is crystal clear, the sand is the softest I’ve ever felt, and the views of the nearby islands is just lovely.

reviews.title: Nice-looking Beach hard to swim
reviews.text: We were here in September and red flag warnings were out. The waves were pretty high and you had a hard time waiting out in the ocean. Went up to Black Rock to do some snorkeling but once again the waves would knock you over. I think if I was to go there again I would go to Honolua Bay instead.

reviews.title: Not ALL of Ka’anapali Beach is great
reviews.text: We walked the entirety of Kaanapali & Kahekili (North Kaanapali) Beaches, and swam and snorkeled in many spots. In my opinion, only the northern part of Kaanapali (Kaanapali Alii to Black Rock) and southern part of Kahekili (Black Rock to Maui Kaanapali Villas) are excellent, particularly if you prefer frolicking barefoot. In the other areas, rocks and coral present hazards. Guard against foot injuries by wearing water shoes. I saw a guy limping out of the water with a bloody foot near the Hyatt.

reviews.title: Amazing views, but be safe in the water
reviews.text: Amazing beach with tremendous views in every direction.  The water depends on the season.  We have experienced some really rough surf in the winter months, which is to be expected.  That said, if it is too dangerous to swim or play in the water, all is not lost.  Maybe we have just been very fortunate, but it seems like a trend that when the water is rough, the view is not.  Witnessing the pure force of Mother Nature is more than enough, but we have noticed an added bonus that has been our experience at the very least; the beautiful humpbacks like to frolic and play in the rough water.  We seem to have more sightings when the weather isn’t perfect.  We love Ka’anapali.

reviews.title: Nice beach! Parking somewhat limited. Great view and walkway
reviews.text: Really nice beach. Well maintained. Next to two other beaches. Need to get there early for best parking.

reviews.title: Waves for days.
reviews.text: Best beach I have ever been to. We had a blast playing in the waves. My little guy played in the sand for 2 hours. Wife lost her sunglasses in ocean so she was not as enthusiastic as I was but I did warn her before she went in. You could hear the whales in the nearby waters of you put your head down to listen.

reviews.title: Great Spot on Maui
reviews.text: It's got everything you might want to do on the Islands. Lots of transportation options. On a 3 week stay we rented a car only 2 days. Flew in to Kapalua Airport

reviews.title: A perennialfavourite
reviews.text: What is not to like about a broad white sand beach with gentle surf and coral close to shore! Ka’anapali Beach has it ALL! You can walk on a boardwalk, snorkel, build sandcastles and enjoy the beach park amenities (picnic, showers, change/toilet facilities, grassy area) of the Airport Beach Park (Kahekili Beach Park.) This is a favourite place for visitors and locals!

reviews.title: Relaxing & Snorkeling
reviews.text: Many days for the 10 we were in Maui were spent on this very relaxing beach! Relaxing and snorkeling, relaxing and snorkeling, relaxing ... You get the gist.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world
reviews.text: this is an excellent beach.  It is great for swimming, snorkeling and just watching the waves.  In winter you can also see whales breaching right from the beach.  Great sunsets.  A boardwalk that goes for miles and has many good restaurants.

reviews.title: A day at the beach
reviews.text: What a lovely beach it is. It is pretty long which makes it a great place to go for a walk and half way through there is a great place to just off the lava rocks into the water. The surf on kaanapali can be a little strong in places so it is best to keep a close eye on younger kids.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Beach is beautiful and surprisingly clean. It's steep, and the wave action can be a little rough, so watch the kiddos if they're in the water. However, we saw turtles, humpback whales and lolos (little flying fish) just by sitting on the dry sand. The sunsets were incredible, night after night, with surprising colors.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Kaanapali Beach is incredible! From snorkeling at Black Rock (near Sheraton) to boogie board & SUP (Stand Up Paddle Board)

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Awesome beach. Incredible views. Manageable waves and beautiful sand. Whales are bouncing around. Pretty awesome.

reviews.title: Gorgeous great water and whales
reviews.text: We love the beach the atmosphere the relaxation. Never disappointed and our go to beach for walking or ocean dipping.

reviews.title: Pretty But Not Easy Swimming
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach with a fantastic view.  There is a path/ sidewalk stretching most of the beach. It’s fun to walk and look at all the hotel properties. The bad thing is there is very little beach, and it is quite slanted. This is not a great beach for swimming. Non the less, Kaanapali Beach is the place to be.

reviews.title: Our favorite beach.
reviews.text: By far our favorite beach on the island. We have been coming for 10 years straight. We visit this beach the majority of our trip.

reviews.title: Fine Clean Sand
reviews.text: Peaceful in the early morning but many tourists enjoying the beach later.  Warm water but strong tide pull.  Went snorkeling near Black Rock and saw a variety of fish.  Easy to rent gear for 1-2 hours.

reviews.title: We loved this side of Maui.
reviews.text: We loved this side of Maui. The beach was beautiful and we went snorkeling 5 times and loved the fish and the reef. The waves were calm enough for us to have our twin 7-year-olds out with us. Such a beautiful area!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Picnic tables, restrooms, changing facilities, palm trees, walkway, shaded parking, FREE. Easy access and very well kept up. Great people watching.

reviews.title: Lovely place for lunch and a stroll.
reviews.text: Great place to sit on the sand or stroll along the paved walkway in front of hotels....especially in the evening before sunset when the torches are lit.

reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach and loved whalers village. Fantastic hotels to stay at at ka'napali and woukd definitely go back again.

reviews.title: love this beach!
reviews.text: passed a few days on these beaches.nice and clean with lots of room. they are never crowded. the water is beautiful and the sun is intense. can not go wrong !

reviews.title: Lovely beach in a great area!
reviews.text: Loved Kaanapai Beach! So much to see and do in the area. Loved walking along the beach and ain’t the boardwalk to whalers village to get a break from the sun when needed. The beach is beautiful and the water was no nice. Waves got crazy big while we were there too!

reviews.title: Beautiful walk on the boardwalk or the beach
reviews.text: My husband and I arrived into Lahaina on a very stormy day.  As such, our surfing lessons had been cancelled, so we decided to go to Kaanapali for a walk, and it did not dissapoint! First of all, Ka'anapali is only a five minute drive from Lahaina.  We parked in the public beach access point just before reaching Ka'anali, and walked the boardwalk from there.  This is a very well kept and clean walk with beautiful views of the ocean.  On the way back we decided to walk on the water.  The nice part about Ka'anapli Beach is it is a continuous stretch of sand (unlike Wailea) so you can walk the whole thing via the beach if you want.  There are also a number of stops you can make, like visiting the hotels, Ululani shaved ice, or Hula Grill.  An easy but beautiful walk that I highly recommend if weather is not allowing for ocean time.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Plenty of room on this beach which goes on for miles. Easy access and plenty of parking if you are willing to look for it.

reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful.
reviews.text: Every beach we drove to see, we had a nice time but wanted to get back to "our" beach. Ka'anapali! The sand is soft, the ocean is kind, lots of room, great for snorkeling.

reviews.title: 25 years since I have been
reviews.text: Without a doubt loved this beach, we are staying West Lahaina very nice but not in the same league as Kaanapali Beach.My wife loved it and said why did you not stay here.Next time we will

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches on the planet
reviews.text: The views of Lana’i and Molokai, the gentle waves, the abundance of whales, surfers and boogie boarders, turtles feeding in the shallow surf and the miles of warm, soft sand make this one of our favorite beaches anywhere. This beach has something for everyone.

reviews.title: Beautiful; Best of Maui
reviews.text: One of our favorite beaches in the world. Walk for three miles on soft sand. Snorkel at Black Rock. Visit hotel pool bars. Rent gear. Boogie board when waves pick up. Spot whales during migration season (Dec - Mar) and listen for their song underwater.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Lots of room to spread out. Waves are not too rough to swim in. If you get bored, you can go and shop in Whaler’s Village. Nice restaurants on the beach to eat at. Have the nachos at Leilani’s!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: I have visited a number of beaches around the world and this remains one of my favourites.Take the opportunity to explore this truly wonderful waterfront on one of the most beautiful Islands in the world.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, great views, we even saw whales in the water. The beach is clean and not too busy, great spot!

reviews.title: Crowded beach with big waves and very strong undertow!
reviews.text: Grown adults were having difficulties at this beach getting into and out of the water when we were there in December/January.  Insanely big waves for a "relaxing beach".  The parking is almost impossible if you arrive after about 10AM.  Very busy beach ... the whale watches and tours take off right from this beach, so there is a constant flow of boats coming in and out and people walking through the beach to get to their excursions.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Royal Lahaina Resort which is on this beach and it was amazing! Such a beautiful place. I definitely recommend going here :)

reviews.title: Nice stretch of the beach, Easy access to restaurants and shops, busy
reviews.text: We stayed one of the resorts on the beach. It’s perfect location to walk, lots of beach sports to offer - it seems it’s good place for beginner surfers as waves are calmer than other locations in Maui. You can find plenty restaurants/shops to choose from at Whalers. I may not choose this to relax as there were so many people, but if you are looking for the location that is convenient to eat/clean up after swimming in the ocean, this is really nice place to go. We saw lots of youth jumping from Black Rock beach - it looked fun, but again it’s super crowded.

reviews.title: Nice beach, complicated logistic
reviews.text: I like this beach, tan sand, beautiful blue water. However it was a little crowded, there are a lot of resorts around and for us was very difficult to find a public parking lot -the one we found had around 20 spots. It doesn’t have public showers, restrooms or changing rooms, so if you are not staying in one of the resorts around will be difficult to hang out in here for the day.

reviews.title: Awesome Beach!
reviews.text: Snorkeling just off the beach was amazing with lots of colorful fish and sea turtles! Clean and not too crowed! No sand fleas...at least when we were there.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach, with turtles!
reviews.text: Swam and snorkelled here. Safe and fun for swimming, and we also snorkelled, and saw loads of reef fish and several sea turtles.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Beach
reviews.text: The beach is very beautiful and if you are lucky you get to see whales. Great for relaxing and enjoying the sun.

reviews.title: Clam
reviews.text: This is a nice beach to relax on or play in the water. The views are very good and there are two other islands to looks at.

reviews.title: A great beach
reviews.text: Go NOW!!!!!!!!!!!!! This is a great area for you and the family. Strongly recommend the WESTIN North Ka'anapali villa as a respit for you and family too.Arch

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: This was our favorite beach near the Lahaina area! We went by the mall entrance, would highly recommend

reviews.title: Airport Beach has great snorkeling
reviews.text: This Beach has great reefs, coral and lots of fish to see. Located near the Westin villas and Royal Lahaina Resort.

reviews.title: Snorkeling
reviews.text: Great beach for snorkeling and people watching. Greatestsunsets.  Near golf, tennis, shopping, spas and greatrestaurants.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Although very busy, this is a beautiful beach to visit and you can also walk along the beach boardwalk and visit many restaurants.  At the far right, they have a place for people to jump in off cliffs!

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: By far the Best Beach at that end of the island. Great Shopping at Whaler's Village which backs the beach.

reviews.title: Great Beach for Snorkelling
reviews.text: Came here multiple times during our stay. Beaches aren’t too crowded. Large parking lot close to the beach with washrooms and change rooms on site. Sand is great and the tides aren’t too strong which made it great for swimming and snorkelling.

reviews.title: Amazing beach with black rock
reviews.text: This beach is very beautiful and busy because of black rock which is used a lot for cliff jumping and snorkeling.Water has an under tow so be carefel. Lots of people in december/ january. Close to lots of shops and stores.Recommend it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but go early!
reviews.text: My husband and I are early risers so I feel that we get the best of Maui beach is before the crowds! This is a lovely stretch of beach and very easy for those less confident in the water as the entire Bay provides a Sandy entrance. Far over to the right is Black rock, some very basic snorkelling snorkelling. And when I say basic, I mean people who are snorkeling for the first time, have little to no snorkeling etiquette, and tend to flail around with their fans getting close to the one turtle they are attempting to chase. Hence, why we go early. If you do want to have a relaxing snorkel out around the point definitely try and get there between 830 and nine. By 10 AM the entire beach is full. The Sheraton on the far right does have public washrooms, and area to rinse off, and snorkel rentals if you don’t have  your own. They also have the beachfront overpriced cocktails that come in a small plastic glass for you to take back to your beach chair. I lovely beach but if you are like us and don’t want the crowds, go early!

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Nice beach to spend the day. There are nice restaurants around in Whalers Village. Bit expensive but is decent. Sunset was nice. But note that the sunset will not be directly into the ocean eventhough it is west coast. There are mountains right around. Still it is beautiful to catch the glimpse of sunset sitting in the beach restaurants. Decent place to spend a day

reviews.title: Manufactured Mother Nature with golf course
reviews.text: Too many people with no aloha spirit. Other guests are in their own bubbles. Bad architecture and definitely geared to make money on everything. Food places pretty good! But amenities were disappointing and overbooked and underwhelming. What mother did was beautiful but faux waterfalls and tropical gardens not very tropical are not my scene especially crammed in between concrete to hide the concrete! Plus all the palm trees like it’s california on rodeo drive , it’s sad. And the need for grass on the beach is silly! But if boring hotel rooms with views and lack luster condos with plastic flowers is your idea of paradise-come on down...please don’t forget the HOA fees for that. I know low maintenance and modern like 1970’s please feel to come to bland suburbia in paradise just take a drive to Lahaina and see real paradise!

reviews.title: great sand, great surf
reviews.text: this is one of the nicest beaches on the island with great sand, waves and lots of amenites close by.

reviews.title: This review is for the Ka'anapali Beach Walk
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach lies primarily between the Canoe Club (by the 1800's plantation workers' cemetery) to the large parking lot by the old Embassy Suites which is now a Diamond Timeshare property (look for the pink pyramid).  In between this walk along the beach is the Sheraton Black Rock.  Go through the hotel lobby to circumvent the rock; walk until you get to the beach end of the golf course and resume the walk.  This entire walk, start to finish, will be about 2 1/2 to 3 miles of a most delightful walk.The path will vary from flagstone, concrete, and wooden boards; it will wind its way along the beautiful coastline.  A large grassy public park lies close to the Diamond timeshare terminus with picnic tables, a restroom/shower, and grills.  There will probably be a craft fair set up somewhere along this stretch  The various hotels and resort cafes & shops (and also Whalers Village) provide for side trips along the route. More of the activity and rental kiosks lie on the stretch of beach walk between the Hyatt and the Westin hotel complexes.   Along our walk, we watched outrigger canoes ply the waves, catamarans go out on snorkel/whale watching excursions, and loads of beginner surfers and boogie board enthusiasts making their own memories.  Sometimes it becomes necessary to walk single-file in narrow parts of the path (which is likely to be the vast majority of the walk way).Always be on the lookout for the unexpected: beautiful birds, a little still life made from lost toys, an amazingly vibrant hued lizard, sea turtles (especially if the surf is calm) eating moss on the rocks, and sparkling sand welcoming the ocean's clear turquoise waters.  This is our favorite place on Maui (Ka'anapali Beach) and nearly everything we want can be found along this beach walk.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, nice and peaceful. Clean, pretty sand. Some surfers when there are waves so they are fun to watch.

reviews.title: Great place but limited parking
reviews.text: This beach is one of the best... shower located close to beach.  Snorkeling is decent.  Turtles usually around the south shore.  Fairly protected from waves and wind.  The beach sand is fantastic so great for kids.

reviews.title: Relaxing vacation!!!
reviews.text: This place is amazing, has a lot to offer , no matter if you are with family or not can fit you!! , Furthermore the food is marvelous!!

reviews.title: Few word of advice - save $$$
reviews.text: A. Bring your Costco card wit you or get one specially for this trip, gasoline at the pump is $3.80 to over $4 VS Costco gas at $3.10 right there is $10-20 each time to fill up.B. Do you or the kids like Acai ? So a small size bowl on any of the islands is $9 to $11 or more - crazy ? Yes ! But it's only $4.99 at the Costco cafeteria

reviews.title: Beautiful Maui Beach
reviews.text: Calm water, sandy beach.  One of the top beaches on the island. Various access points and hotels are on this beach.

reviews.title: Nice sand and snorkeling but very crowded
reviews.text: This is a great, sandy beach with good, mild snorkeling. The downside is the small beach that is very crowded. It's a good beach if you don't mind strangers being on top of you.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach and water. Waves can get a bit rough for the keiki (kids).  Sand is gold and soft.  Absolutely beautiful. Note- can be a bit crowded since all the resorts line the beach.

reviews.title: The best beach to visit
reviews.text: The clear and show water on this beach will let you see the ocean floor at about 6 feet. If you go a little bit inside to the ocean with snorkeling gear, you could swim with the sea turtles for free.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This beach is a great beach but can get very crowded! You definitely want to get there early to avoid all of the crowds and find a good spot!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but getting overused
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach but Black Rock snorkeling is getting way overused. The turtles rarely even come in that area anymore because there are so many people. Granted this is December which is a very popular time of year. Lots of jumpers at black rock cliff diving. My prediction unfortunately is it that will soon be closed off and the snorkeling will have to be restricted for environmental reasons. This is a gem the speech and I hope that it is looked after and protected

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, snorkeling and fun
reviews.text: On days when the currents or waves are less, it is a brilliant snorkel! Swam with 2 turtles, some fish next to the black rock

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Nice resort area that had great swimming and snorkeling, along with other places to go and things to do.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Amazing!!😍 Clean, nice store front, shops places to eat and get drinks. Everyone is very kind and sweet. So many places to stop at with beautiful views.

reviews.title: Just had to stop.
reviews.text: I was out for an early morning run when the moon was setting.  This is one of those views that takes your breath away.  I just wish I had been there to catch a sunset.

reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.text: There is a trail going along the beach for about 2 miles. Nice morning or evening walk. The beach is very nice, clean. Be careful of sudden waves and currents!

reviews.title: Family visit
reviews.text: Excellent spot  so much care is taken to keep everything pristine and tidy and there pride taken in it golden sands on Pacific Ocean safe enough to swim but exercise caution

reviews.title: Great for snorkelling and swimming
reviews.text: The water is crystal clear and great for snorkeling and swimming. Beautiful blue Ayer and loads of fish and if your lucky turtles. Take the go pro for underwater photos. Not a lot of shade

reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text: Very clean with shower and restroom. Big wave and too deep for young children...It is really American style vacation...

reviews.title: Relaxing Beachside
reviews.text: Stayed at Westin Ocean Villas with access to this beach spent a day or two here waters were very clean, warm, and was not overly crowded except for sunset time did pick up. Recommend wearing water shoes if you are not snorkeling as there are rocks and coral around. Great spot for every day snorkel even a turtle or two will visit. Waters were not too crazy and easy to swim. Excellent beach!

reviews.title: Great beach!
reviews.text: A big and beautiful beach with plenty of room, great spots to snorkel. The Black Rock is a must-do for first-timers.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: There are several public areas, but some of the beach is private or restricted access with hotels on the north end. I highly recommend staying at one if those hotels from the Sheraton north to The Aston. No sea shell to pick up. Great sand. If you go to the public beach, take chairs. There is a grocery store across from the Aston that sells chairs (and vodka). A must go to is “Java Jazz” for a drink or great food. There is a coffee bar but the food is wonderful so don’t be fooled by the name.

reviews.title: Too many aggressive sales people.
reviews.text: The actual beach is awesome. The waves can seem really scary for little kids, as my kid was totally intimidated. My only complaint is how aggressive the sales people are. The people at the ‘excursion deals’ desks were really annoying and really aggressive. They are trying to recruit people to ‘take a look’ at a timeshare unit. I started dreading doing the walk to Whaler’s Village.

reviews.title: Honua Kai Resort
reviews.text: Was very nice! We would stay again. Couldn’t check in until 4, lobby store/coffee didn’t open always on time

reviews.title: Great beach and snorkeling
reviews.text: Find the covered public parking and walk to beach access.  Great swimming and sunning beach and snorkeling on right side at black Rock

reviews.title: Just plain beautiful!
reviews.text: The beach was so close to our hotel that it was unfair! We walked there every day and loved the softness of the sand and the whole beach in general.

reviews.title: Maui Trip
reviews.text: So beautiful.  Stayed at the Royal Lahaina.  Can’t wait to go back!  Perfect vacation. Lots of activities for kids; lots of relaxing for adults

reviews.title: Windy beach on the west Maui
reviews.text: Arriving here by ATR-72-500, shaked by the wind before landing,I found this beach is one of the best place for surfing ,strong wind, high tides,less precipitation, always sunshine.However, the resorts and hotels in this area are so bloody expensive, for water activities lovers,Don"t miss this beach.it's easily connected with Lahaina and Kahului by public buses or private car on the veru wide laned highway.

reviews.title: Beach time
reviews.text: Ka'anapali beach is beautiful. Just be aware the surf can be pretty rough depending on the time of year. It is not a super large sandy beach in areas. Gorgeous sunsets. They had a nice craft fair while we were there. The area is undergoing some remodeling. You can walk to Whalers village and Black rock.

reviews.title: Lovely Beach by Black Rock
reviews.text: We wanted to visit Ka’anapali Beach & do some snorkeling there. We weren’t staying in the area so we needed to hunt down the free parking lots in the area. It took a while of searching & waiting but we snagged a spot. It was quite the walk with chairs, backpacks with snorkel gear to get to our snorkeling destination. We walked the path & had some nice views of the beautiful beach along with eateries & hotels. The sand is soft & the water is pretty calm & warm. There were plenty of fish & turtles to see as we snorkeled.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We stayed on this beach and it was beautiful.  Water was so clear, highly recommend it.  And the sunsets - WOW

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Love Ka'anapali Beach!  We stayed at the Sheraton Maui on Ka'anapali beach and loved it too!  Black Rock rocks!

reviews.title: Black Rock was our best snorkel
reviews.text: Turtles at Black Rock was absolutely our highlight snorkel of the trip (remember to stay at least 5ft from them, don't harass protected wildlife). Go early to avoid crowds and watch out for people jumping off the rock into the sea. Also there is very little public parking.

reviews.title: Stunning & easiest way to get my 10,000 steps in!
reviews.text: You can walk on the beach or a walkway.  There are hotels, water activities & restaurants along the way &, in the morning, yoga.  At the Sheraton end, you can bring your snorkeling equipment & swim with the sea turtles along the black rock.    There's also the delightful Whalers Village to explore along the way.

reviews.title: The Beach
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach was right there in front of our Kaanapali Ali beach resort and pool.  The beach was so sandy and went forever.  I and others were all old farts that are crowding 70.  I just had two new hips put in and i went down a 10 ft sand bank to get wet.  I wanted to walk out from where the beach sand is being pulled out.  12 waves went by and I felt confident.  It was that 13 wave that was bigger than me and slammed me down under and pulled me out to sea.  It was strange I still had my Army Jungle hat still on.  I seen a RED FLAG flying on shore.  oooops that means conditions are right for under tows.  Care Takers of resorts are always watching and made sure I was alright as young beach goes laughed.  Hips were woke up and had more respect for Flags on the beach after that.  Fun all up and down the beach.

reviews.title: Beach of Dreams
reviews.text: You know there are places that you’ve never been to before and as soon you hear about them you know you’re going to love them and you hope they end up being as good as the picture you’ve cooked up inside your head? This beach is that good, everything you’ve been dreaming about. Exceptionally pretty, just big enough, not too crowded. Things that make you say “Ahhhhhhhh!!!”

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach
reviews.text: Warm water, easily one can spent 4-5 hours, lot of water activities to do, rental stores located in beach, one can get all sort of fun at one place.

reviews.title: Great Sandy Beach
reviews.text: Great sandy beach with clear blue water. Good snorkeling at Black Rock. Can get really windy & sand will blow in your face & eyes, so better in the morning. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Went here whilst in the area, its a lovely beach to sit and people watch also very clean too. I would recommend and return here

reviews.title: As Beautiful As it Looks!
reviews.text: The places located at Ka'anapali Beach are as beautiful as you may have seen or heard. My number one choice on the island. I recently stayed at a place north of Ka'anapali and was not very happy. I was hoping when I booked it that it was better but this location is so hard to beat.

reviews.title: Nice beach, no facilities
reviews.text: Tough to find the public entrance, but the beach path for the public is directly next to the Hyatt where there is a small free public parking. Not too crowded but couldn't find any public bathroom facilities.

reviews.title: Hotel was on this beach
reviews.text: Beautiful strip of beach in front of our hotel.  A short walk to the water, so not to big of a beach.  But oh what sunsets!!  Absolutely spectacular.

reviews.title: Sea Turtles
reviews.text: I took my daughter here for her 16th birthday, we did may things. She loved this beach best. We parked at the Sheraton. Which is the only way to do it. Unless there is another hidden way. But if u get lucky. There is free parking right by Sheraton. Like the next turn on your right.  Maybe 100 feet. But there is only 15 parking spots or so. It was weird walking through the Sheraton,  but we couldn't  find any other way. The beach was clean, the waves weren't huge. And we saw a sea Turtle and tons of fish. Right by the black rock. We rented snorkel gear, on the beach by Sheraton. And ate lunch there as well. It was amazing. Would  recommend

reviews.title: Perfect in Every way
reviews.text: Amazing spot for a sunset. Clouds, mountains, palm trees.Perfectly Hawaii. Great spot for a picnic, relaxing in the shade at sunset, wading, swimming, or surfing

reviews.title: great beach
reviews.text: This is a gem for swimming, snorkeling, whale watching-during humpback season, great lodging-esp. the Westin Ka'anapali ocean resort villas , outstanding dining, excellent craft shows and great people watching.

reviews.title: beautiful  beach with astounding views
reviews.text: wow what can i say?  this is the best beach location in the world with crystal blue sea and beautiful views of Lanai and Molokai.  So clean and water was 78 degrees so like a bath.  Word of warning though, the sea is really inviting but dangerous as the are strong currents.  We stay here every year and we have seen some really strong waves coming in at times, and unexpected soaking sunbathers and sweeping away belongings.  Fun to enjoy and warm too but be careful and heed red flags when out

reviews.title: Best beach anywhere?
reviews.text: The beach at Kaanapali is always perfect.Not too busy, not too rough, but some fun waves.Frequented mostly by the resort crowd from the Sheraton, the Whaler, the Weston etc. The beach has a gradual drop off and a favourite of kids.

reviews.title: Wonderful beaches and terrific board walk!
reviews.text: There is a lovely board walk from Mahana to the Black Rock and Whaler’s Village and there are wonderful beaches at public parks in Kaanapali.

reviews.title: One of best beaches
reviews.text: Kaanapali has great beaches but i still prefer wailea because closer to airport—road from Kahului to Ka’anapali is always troublesome—one can spend an hour getting to Lāhainā.tennis is best on island in Ka’anapali

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: Bring towels. Very clean area. Felt safe. Also be sure to bring lawn chairs if you need them. Family friendly.

reviews.title: It's a beach!
reviews.text: We do not spend time on the beach because we prefer the pool but it was great hearing the crashing waves.

reviews.title: Super fun trip
reviews.text: Scuba lahaina Kaanapali in2scuba rocks!Lots of restaurants to choose from.The beach is endlessLove the shopsTiki torches at night were beautiful

reviews.title: Good family place
reviews.text: The hotel rooms could really stand to be updated, but it is clean, friendly and a good value. They are on the beach and have a pool.too. You are also within walking distance from Whalers village and a short drive to Lahaina with lots of restaurants and shops

reviews.title: Major disappointment in this highly anticipated beach
reviews.text: I think this beach gets good reviews due to tourists that stay at one of the many condos lining it. If you are staying there, then I'm sure it's a good one for you. But, we drove there based on great reviews. First, couldn't figure out how to get to the beach. Ended up in serval condo parking lots and by accident found a public parking lot with one spot left. Took a bush lined walking path to beach. Beach is long and wide swath of sand. The sand was deep and hot, hot, hot. Had to wear flip flops to make it near the water. Then, crazy is there was a sandy ledge then you drop down a couple feet to get to another  sandy area that gradually went into the water. Remember, you have to climb back up it. Mistakenly, that's a key word, we found a spot near this ledge and got comfortable. Yikes, we got attacked by a giant wave that came up and over that ledge and totally engulfed us in salt water and sand. Someday I may laugh about it, but that day hasn't come yet. All I could say was that's it, I'm done. Oh, and add to that there were too many people, the view was condos on one side and on the other wasn't even endless ocean views. No shade on beach. I swear the condo's landscape so shade just covers their property and the boardwalk. Should have stopped along the road where the locals were parked and enjoying the beach.

reviews.title: Absolutely stunning beach with one of a kind views!
reviews.text: Ka’anapali Beach is gorgeous for its soft and inviting sands alone, but what makes it truly special is is location between other neighboring islands that paints a beautiful landscape. The way the nearby island‘s clouds form at the peek of Lanai with rays of sunlight piercing through create a picturesque view be in the morning glory or whilst watching a warm sunset. In the morning, the waters are calm and like glass, in the afternoon and around dusk the waves start to barrel nicely making this a fun destination for boogie boarding but the water no matter the time of day is crystal clear and purified by volcanic sediment over millennia. Have fun and happy beach going my friends 😎🤙🏼

reviews.title: Nice beach by high rise hotels
reviews.text: I took a snorkeling trip which initiated on this beach. Shops and hotels butt up against it, and it wasn't too crowded in October. The water was warm and waves not too high to swim. The beach was clean.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Amazing beach! Had a great time with Mother and sister staying at the Mana Kai in September 2019. I will be returning in Dec to check out another location ( Sugar Beach Resort). Hope it is as nice as Mana Kai.

reviews.title: Beautiful but lots of other people
reviews.text: Kaapanapali isn’t Waikiki, but I’m afraid it’s headed that way. Too much tourism, too many high end shops, not enough parking, it’s just too much. Still, beautiful, but....  we will see what it’s like in another five years.

reviews.title: Ka’anapali beach
reviews.text: It was beautiful! The water was blue and you can snorkel to see tropical fish.the sand is coarse, not sugary. Paradise!

reviews.title: Favorite Beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous views, beautiful water, sand is soft and you can snorkel right off the beach in places.  I cannot wait to return.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world!
reviews.text: My second favorite beach in the world!  I Love the walk along the beach!  Lots of sand and soft areas.  Cliff jumping, all activities and very nice people!  Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Great for snorkeling
reviews.text: We stayed at a resort on Ka'anapali beach and loved being able to snorkel without having to drive and fight for parking space somewhere else. We did try quite a few of the other beaches and there are some great ones, but when it came down to it, we saw beautiful fish, sea turtles, etc, right there, making it our favorite place to snorkel.

reviews.title: We Loved This Beach (Black Rock Area)
reviews.text: We stayed at the Sheraton Maui Resort and Spa, which is directly on Kaanapali Beach, at Black Rock.  Therefore, we hit up this portion of the beach each day during our visit.•It’s a clean, wide beach with lots of space and plenty of beautiful blue water and sandy bottom.  It goes for about three miles I believe.  Black Rock seems to provide a bit of a barrier from the waves where we swam.  It was always pretty calm in this area.   Although, if you venture out to the point where Black Rock ends, the currents really picked up.•Even at peak times (at least in October), the beach never seemed overcrowded.•We would snorkel each morning at Black Rock.  Pretty amazing and it’s free!  There was always colorful fish and at least one sea turtle (usually there was a full family of turtles).•Based on our experience, I would suggest visiting the area early for snorkeling.  It gets pretty crowded as the days goes on (as far as the amount of snorklers).  We would go each morning from say 8 – 10 and it was perfect.•People also cliff jump off of Black Rock.  We did several times, and it was a blast!  From the water, it does not look that tall, but it sure does when you are up at the top ready to jump.   Seemed pretty safe, and never saw anyone have any issue.•I will also note that TripAdvisor lists this beach as being in Lahaina, but I think that’s wrong.  It’s actually in Kaanapali, at least the part we hung out at.  Lahaina was a 10 – 15 minute drive from our resort, so this seems wrong to me.We visited many beaches on our visit, and this was one of our two favorites (the other being in Hana).  I am sure part of the attraction to us was we walked right out of our hotel to it, but I think even if we would have traveled to it we would have felt the same.  It just was a great relaxing spot with good swimming and snorkeling.  Love this beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: My only regret is not bringing my snorkeling mask to swim around the rocks on black beach.We came 9-noonish before it was blazing hot and the water temperature was lovely. The tide was going out so the wave were pulling a little strong but you could swim a few feet in and be in calm water. Picture perfect views.

reviews.title: Lovely uncrowded beach
reviews.text: We traveled off season, so the beach was never crowded. It stretches a long way, so even with all the hotels located on this beach, there was plenty of sand (and water) for everyone. The sand is smooth with almost no rocks or trash. One strange thing - it's very steep both on the shore and underwater. The drop-off is pretty quick, so we couldn't wade very far before we stopped being able to touch. Makes sense, since Maui is a volcano!

reviews.title: Spectacular!!
reviews.text: Loved the layout of the beach.  Watching the catamarans come in & is watch the sunset.  Super clean beach and accessible bathrooms. 👍👍

reviews.title: Black Rock is awesome!
reviews.text: Snorkeling is awesome near black rock! Saw two turtles and awesome colorful fish. The Beach is beautiful. We parked at a hotel with beach parking- the Marriott maybe? Get there no later than 9:30am for a spot!

reviews.title: Where is the postcard beach?
reviews.text: If you are a millionaire staying at one of the resorts that chopped up the beach into private parts, you might enjoy it. We came here with a car, traffic everywhere, nowhere to park, no obvious public access... really sad that this is the prime swimming area in Hawaii. Left disappointed.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling!
reviews.text: This is the prettiest beach on the island.  Mellow, clear warm water, near restaurants and shops, clean beaches and no wind.  There are a couple spots for boogie boarding but it's not really known for it's surfing.  More relaxing, snorkeling and jumping off black rock!  I dive, but sometimes it's nice to go snorkeling.  I've never snorkeled here and not seen one or more turtles.  They love the area, especially close to the black rock.

reviews.title: Honeymoon Vacation
reviews.text: The beach was absolutely amazing. The clarity and colors  of the water was astounding. Soft sand and cool/warm water made the visit relaxing.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: We spent the majority of our trip on this beach. It was clean and everyone was respectful, it is great for families!!

reviews.title: Great for snorkeling
reviews.text: We stayed in a resort on this beach, has a nice boardwalk and beautiful water that is great for snorkeling right off the beach.

reviews.title: Beaches are memorable!
reviews.text: The sand on the beach is different, very fine.  The water is warm, it was great to swim in and very clear, not matter what beach you go to, we had a lot of fun!!  Also saw some Sea Turtles that was awesome!!!

reviews.title: Always Beauitful
reviews.text: Sunshine kissed, cool trade breezes, water sports galore and stunning beaches, what more could you ask for.... wait, it’s there too, a short walk to whalers village gets you shopping, dining and more. P.S. Macy’s in the Hyatt is perfect for resort wear and things forgotten for a trip.

reviews.title: Black Rock
reviews.text: The best section of the Kaanapali Beach is right in front of the Sheraton Hotel. That beach is bounded by large lava ridge known as Black Rock. Snorkeling there is fine. Youngsters and some oldsters leap from the top of Black Rock into the water making for a pretty good photo opportunity. Enjoy your stay on Black Rock Beach and don't hesitate to snorkel there as turtles are almost always in evidence.

reviews.title: Lovely waters
reviews.text: We walked the boardwalk and ended up staying and playing on kaanapali beach.  The water was perfect.  Super clear not too rough.  There is access to a lot of hotels , restaurants shops etc along the beach which is also great!

reviews.title: Huge sandy beach near black rock
reviews.text: this is a great beach.  Mild surf and plenty of sand.  At the end near black rock is a great location to snorkel.

reviews.title: Fun beach
reviews.text: I went here with a group of 6 for a morning and we had a blast. The beach/sand was a huge area so we had no issues finding a spot to lay out. The snorkel gear  was good quality and inexpensive - and we  saw lots of fish. The cliff jumping was so much fun. And the swimming was great.  Excellent spot.

reviews.title: Parking complicated but nice beach
reviews.text: Was there yesterday (Oct 22) around noon and it was surprisingly not crowded like we thought it was going to be. Beach is beautiful and plenty of space to sunbathe. PARKING: impossible to find a space at free public parking. However, there is a way to park fres. Park at Whalers Village shopping mall paid parking garage. This parking spot is right by the beach and you can get your ticket validated by the stores there if you purchase something. For example, we went to a coffee shop (sorry, forgot name) on the ground level and they said they could validate our parking ticket if we purchase $15 or more. It was fair as we wanted coffee anyway. They put a bad code over our parking ticket and we exited the parking lot without paying !

reviews.title: Beautiful but Popular
reviews.text: Early morning was an awesome time to visit this beach- between 6a-10a. Past that it was too crowded for our liking. The water is refreshing but a bit tougher than some others nearby.

reviews.title: Great swimming, great snorkeling, great FUN!
reviews.text: We’ve been coming back to this beach for 8 years.  I wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else.  Lots of turtles near black rock but one also swam by me way up by the Westin.  Perfect waves for floating and still fun for boogie boarding with the kids.  This is my all time favorite beach!

reviews.title: go on the boardwalk that follows the beach
reviews.text: you don't have to stay in one of the hotels or condos. Thankfully ALL beaches are open to the public. Stroll from the Hyatt to the Sheraton on the board walk. If you have enough energy you can keep going beyond that all the way to the Aston Mahana. Along the way you can stop at many different restaurants, watch people (which can be most interesting), take lots of pictures, get your feet wet, take a swim, or do some jogging (best done in the AM). It's an iconic beach, however, keep going. There are many more glorious beaches on this island and often less crowded with free parking.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beach but waves are strong and dangerous undertow. We found out after that there is other beach's in the area with calmer waters.

reviews.title: Very Nice Beach With Crystal Clear Water
reviews.text: The section of this beach that was in front of where we stayed was very nice and never very crowded. The sand was a little coarser than at some other beaches we've been to, but the water was crystal clear. The water was a little colder than many beaches in the Caribbean, but not too terribly cold. The best way to get acclimated to it was to just dive right in and then stay in the water up to your neck. The surf can get a little rough around high tide but not anywhere near as rough as on the north shore of the island.

reviews.title: Ka’anapali Beach
reviews.text: Our resort (Marriott Maui Ocean Club) was tight on this beach so we spent quite a bit of time on this beach.  It is massive, with many busy resorts backing on to it.  That said, the beach never felt crowded and there was always plenty of room to spread out.  Decent snorkelling at Black Rock but not as good as other places.  Really pretty beach with great weather and fun waves.  Overall, really great area to stay or to visit.

reviews.title: Beach shopping
reviews.text: I enjoy walking along the beach walking path and going in the variety of shops. I have visited many beach towns along the way. From Kapalua, Kahuna, Napili, Honokawai,  all the way to Lahaina.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We loved our vacation.   Everything was perfect!!  We would go back again and do it all over again.  It was perfect!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Soft sand and good snorkeling. Love this stretch of Maui. Second year in a row coming here.  Enjoy the beach.

reviews.title: Best beach in Maui
reviews.text: Expansive beaches, warm water, surfing, boogie boarding, parasailing, sunset cruises, body surfing and more. What’s not to love?

reviews.title: Sunny Beach
reviews.text: If you want a great beach, this is it. Mostly used by hotel guests. Parking at the Whalers Village and other hidden areas. Wide sandy beach. Very family oriented. I come to Maui for this beach.

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: Great snorkeling at the black rock, clear blue water, and beautiful sand. Good dining options as well.

reviews.title: Great warm waters
reviews.text: Any time of day you can get in without “warming up” first. Beautiful clear waters. Nearby restaurants activities snorkeling etc. gentle surf no need to be scared!

reviews.title: Best Beach with the Views of the Islands
reviews.text: Ka’anapali Beach is the best beach around. Water is clear, snorkeling is great. Great views of the other islands.

reviews.title: Nice beach but commercialized
reviews.text: Certainly an attractive beach which is why multiple hotels are there.  That is also a little bad news since I wouldn't suggest this area if you are a beachcomber.  LOL!

reviews.title: Better than all of them
reviews.text: We have visited almost every beach in Maui and this beach is hard to beat. Also a great choice to watch the beautiful Maui sunsets

reviews.title: Really Good Sandy Beach
reviews.text: The Kaanapali beach area is great for a nice all around beach experience. Bring your sunscreen! The clouds can go in and out but there is no pollution here to filter the UV Ray's. The sand is a bit sticky but easy to brush off. The water temperature is really pleasant. The offshore reef area is pretty much dead so there are no colorful coral formations...however snorkeling is fun as there are many species of marine life in the first 50 feet off shore.  I SAW PLENTY OF THE Humuhumu.fish, a couple of adult Moray eels and about 20 more species of Pacific marine life in less than 15 minutes of casual snorkeling. The wind actually helps to keep the hungry flies off you. That makes it nice for just catching some rays.

reviews.title: Clean and fine sand
reviews.text: Small beach in its own cove. Napili Shores on one side and Seahouse restaurant on the other. Becoming eroded by reasonable size waves.

reviews.title: Family oriented beach
reviews.text: We used the beach every morning between 7-10am. The place is so calm and predictable with gorgeous water color, temperature, and small waves. Perfect for snorkeling or just dipping in and out while you enjoy the sun at the slightly sloped and sandy beach. We also often walked all the way to the black rock which is the end of the beach and back either on the boardwalk or the beach. For couples it could at times get a bit too busy and loud with young children running around or making noise in and near the water. But goin early was the best way to manage that possible conflict for us. OVERALL VERY PEACEFUL AND BEAUTIFUL!

reviews.title: Beautiful Kaanapali
reviews.text: This was our 3rd stay and having explored most of the island now I don’t think I would stay anywhere else. Such a clean uncrowded beach with crystal clear water and snorkeling at black rock. The beach walk takes you past all the resorts, shops, restaurants and bars. Sunsets here are breathtaking.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Stunning beach. We snorkeled and sunbathed and enjoyed the trail behind the beach. Well snorkeling we saw two large sea turtles

reviews.title: Best Maui Beach
reviews.text: Loved Ka'anapali Beach as it is the epitome of why we went to Maui and you can't say you went to Maui unless you go to this beach for swimming,  sunbathing, and people watching.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We stopped by this beach for an afternoon and are so glad we did! The beach is really wide so even though there are other people, it doesn't feel crowded at all which is great! There's a lot of shopping and restaurants in the area so it would be easy to grab a bite to eat and head to the beach.  The day we were there the waves were a bit rough so I'm not sure if it is like that all the time or just was the time of day we were there.  As with almost everywhere in Hawai'i, the views are beautiful, the water is warm, and the sand is soft and clean! This is a great beach for relaxing and enjoying the Hawaiian sunshine!

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Gentle surf.  Lots of sand and many activities!!!  Great beach walk for morning exercise!  Lots of dining options too!!

reviews.title: Big beautiful beach
reviews.text: Loved loved this beach and area of Maui. Water was so clear and blue and the waves are crazy big, the beach is in the area of all the large resorts so you can walk around all the resorts and look around. These hotels are beautiful and the beach is huge with soft sand and warm waters

reviews.title: Ok for tourists
reviews.text: It has a nice concrete walkway to connect hotels which is nice . Pretty beach beach but very crowded . Kind of touristy !! Ok to hang out and use as vase to visitOther beaches .You need a car !Great sunsets from deck of any outdoor restaurant! Or piece of grass or sand !

reviews.title: A day at the beach
reviews.text: We take the kids and dogs down to the beach almost daily. It’s one of the finest in the world. Across the street from us. Soft sand and gentle surf make it pleasant. Lots of fun to be had and lots of choices for food and beverages. Go.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: I always enjoy this beach when I am in Maui.  The West side of Maui has the best beaches.  Great ones from Kiehi to the North past Ka'anapali.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: had little bit of a hard time finding public parking, but squeezed the car in then walked the beach front trail to enjoy the ocean views and also enjoyed seeing all the resorts pools, gardens and restarants. Water was powerful that day, red flags out - heavy surf, but still able to enjoy it  much.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with many activities.
reviews.text: We had a great time on Kaanapali Beach. We especially enjoyed its proximity to Whaler's village where you can shop or dine.

reviews.title: Absolutely stunning beach!!
reviews.text: We traveled by taxi ($17 from Lahaina cruise terminal) to Whalers village and then walked down to the beach. The beach was absolutely gorgeous, the waves were extremely high this day so not the best for small kids or even some adults, but it was absolutely beautiful.

reviews.title: Clean and beautiful
reviews.text: We purchased an umbrella at Costco upon arrival as do many others. The sun can be intense. We snorkeled there and just hung out in the water. It’s a beautiful stretch of beach. “North Kannapali” beach is the best and gentle entrance all sand during good weather.

reviews.title: a hotel strip beach
reviews.text: This section of beach is wall to wall condo/hotels... so the narrow sandy beach available to the public is not huge. The hotels have scored their own grass covered knolls for their guests. The current is really strong, so I would never let children just play along the water's edge. The water temperature and color of course are lovely. Best to go w/ some sort of floatie.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: All the beaches in West Maui at the resorts are fabulous! Wade, swim, snorkel. Warm clear water where you can see your feet!

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Long white stretch of sand, beautiful aqua water. Rough tides when I was there, and it did seem like the strip of sand was narrow. Very busy, full of tourists, but really pretty just the same.

reviews.title: Beautiful, calm and peaceful!
reviews.text: Spent several days at Ka’anapali Beach during our recent Maui visit. Each day, the waves were calm, the water beautiful and I saw green sea turtles each time I snorkeled - right from the beach!There were many different fish species to see, beautiful coral and I even saw an eel or two. We have been to beaches all over the world and this is one of the best! The only challenge can be some sharp rocks and coral near the shore in some places so water shoes may help prevent cuts. But there are plenty of sandy areas if you just walk toward the southern end of the beach.

reviews.title: Perfect Place
reviews.text: We have been there for honeymoon. We stay at Hyatt Regency for one week. Ka’anapali beach is an area with a lot of resorts and great view of the Pacific Ocean. You can take the path near the beach and enjoy a walk down of the Phoenixes.

reviews.title: COULD HAVE BEEN CLEANER
reviews.text: This is a nice beach with beautiful views but the sand could have been cleaner. There were bits of plastic and rubbish that someone needs to clean up.  There a significent shelf in the sand to the sea. There's also quite a bit of natural 'rubbish' from palm trees etc but that's fine in my view.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.  Great snorkeling.  Very clean.  Pretty good star gazing (for the amateur).  Westin and Sheraton are nice resorts to stay at.  We stayed at the Westin and were treated like royalty.  The luau at the Sheraton is wonderful and watching the divers at Black Rock was fun.  Great beach for watching sunsets.

reviews.title: Lovely beach.  Not safe to swim for older folks
reviews.text: Lovely beach. Dangerous surf.  Steep slopes to access water.Vey difficult to get out of water because of breakers on shore

reviews.title: Fun spot
reviews.text: This is a great beach if you can find public parking. Any time you want a drink or meal you can hit the hotel any where on this beach or the many restaurants too.The surf can be dangerous if a big swell is happening so be cautious otherwise it is fun snorkeling by Black rock. Bring plenty of sun tan lotion as the sun can be brutal if you do not bring an umbrella.

reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: Great location. See my review for Maui scuba mike.     We had a great time doing a beach dive in kannapali

reviews.title: Long Walk in great sand
reviews.text: Kanapali Beach was stunning. Walked from Whalers Village to the Aston.  Beautiful waves, happy faces. Best beach bar is at the Royal Lahaina next door to the golf courses.

reviews.title: Parking sucks
reviews.text: If you are not a guest staying at any of the resorts near this Beach the public parking is almost hidden and when you find them the signs for them are tiny.

reviews.title: Fabulous Stay on Ka'anapali Beach!
reviews.text: Stayed at the Hyatt Regency and thoroughly enjoyed the strolls along the paved boardwalk on Ka'anapali Beach! A crisp morning walk with breathtaking views was a highlight of our stay - best Fitbit steps ever! In the evening, we enjoyed the stroll to Whalers Village with all the tiki torches at many of the properties. Tide was rough and many catamaran cruises that boarded from the beach were cancelled so we avoided swimming at the beach. Plans to return to Ka'anapli Beach with the rest of the family definitely on our radar!

reviews.title: Plenty to do.
reviews.text: For those who take a taxi, the drop off is at Whalers Shopping.   There are plenty of places to eat.  The beach is clean.  We were there at a time of high surf and high tide.  Waves could be potentially be as high as 10 feet so watch the kids

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely gorgeous. Great for taking a long walk or swimming. Great views of Molokai and Lanai. Sand is like sugar, water clear and calm when we were there.

reviews.title: Beach!!
reviews.text: Beautiful sand and water not crowded it's such a beautiful place you can stand in the water up to your head look down and see your toes

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach, right by the Westin Resort. You can park for free right by the entrance, there are some restaurants that belong to the resorts/hotels around, as well. It also looks like a good place for snorkeling.

reviews.title: Lovely beach, great area.
reviews.text: Beautiful views of the ocean (it is a beach) and Molokai. However, at times Molokai can obscure the full grandeur of a sunset.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Just check it out if you’re in the area, there are a million access points between the resorts and such.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Kaanapali beach walk is a must do when you are in Maui. Lots of shops and fun bars and restaurants .Relaxing

reviews.title: Busy but Nice
reviews.text: We were able to find a spot that was not crowded, The break was not good for body surfing when we were there.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and wonderful area. Beach is long and spacious. Waves can get a little aggressive/big, so be careful! Whaler’s village is also around/behind beach and it’s a nice place to shop around for unique gifts :)

reviews.title: Hard to get to in the middle of ritzy area
reviews.text: I really wanted to see this beach, but had trouble finding it with all the exclusive rich resorts and hotels around it and roads that led you into parking lots which were hard to get out of. We drove around a while and because it was difficult and we felt we were way out of our price range in this area, we never got to see the beach. VERY disappointing.

reviews.title: Contender (again) for best beach in America
reviews.text: We spent a fabulous day on Kaanapali beach in September 2019. Perfect weather, perfect waves and just beautiful to sit upon.Highly recommended beach!

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Pailolo bar the best. Terrific shout out to Johnny, Angela,Chewy,  and Jamie They r fun, professional,and always make you  feel welcome.

reviews.title: One of the top 10 beaches in the world
reviews.text: Snorkel around black rock. Walk the beach for 4 miles. Enjoy the views of Lanai and Molokai. A real treasure. Cost is free. Waves can be amazing.

reviews.title: Nice beach area!
reviews.text: This beach area is expansive.  Good for all water sports like kayaking, stand up paddle boarding, body surfing and even para sailing.  It's where you can rent a lot of these.  Also a tip, there is public parking available at nearby resorts fronting the beach but they are very limited so it fills up quickly.  We tried several spots.  First at the Whaler's village but since it's our first time there, we didn't know how far the trek to the beach will be.  We ditched the place and decided to go try one of the public parking by the resort.  Lot was full.  We then decide to just pay for resort parking coz we didn't want to waste time looking for one.  Once that was settled, you can head for the water, there is usually access (either dirt or paved).  No one will chastise you for being on the resort grounds.  Just be aware that this is an expansive beach.  So if you're lugging beach chairs, umbrella, cooler, tote, children, and then boards (whatever kind), you might want to plan where you pick your spot.  Walking on the sand under the heat of the sun with 1000% humidity will take it's toll on you.  So we carefully chose our spot closest to the path that takes us to our parking lot.  We set up shop and enjoyed the day and the heat :-)  You have a clear view of Lanai and Molokai islands.  There's plenty to do and places to eat if you don't have food packed.  Also, there are outdoor shower stalls where you can rinse off the sand.  The only downside was that, the day and time we went the waves were a bit big so it was not suitable for swimming.  After what seemed like ample time....we decided to head back to Whaler's village and grab some lunch.

reviews.title: Day at the beach
reviews.text: Kaanapali beach - Great location, easy access, free parking!   The water was crystal blue.  Beach comfortably crowded.  Short, shoreline.

reviews.title: Great clean beach
reviews.text: We are staying at the Kaanapali beach club which is on the Kaanapali beach we love this beach not crowded and is very clean the water is so clear

reviews.title: Super clean, sheltered, low surf beach with a little secret. Good for a quick stop
reviews.text: This is a long flat beach that fronts the Ka'anpali hotel strip. It is sheltered from the wind and the surf action is pretty minimal due to the flat sandy bottom.  I am calling it average because I do not think it is that great for kids as the water does get deep very quickly not allowing for much wading before you are swimming over a sandy bottom with not much to see snorkelling. There is very limited shade area so an umbrella is a must.    Ka'anapali is not where we enjoy Maui, but we do find ourselves nearby occasionally, and the rock at the Sheraton end is fun to go and jump off a few times if you need a cool down.  The hidden secret is the free beach access parking at the Sheraton. Covered and right next to the walkway that is a short walk to the beach. Allegedly all of the resorts on the strip are required to provide 35 free public access spaces but the Sheraton is the ony one I have easily found and it is at the end of the beach with the jumping rock.  If you want to check in on resort scene for a few it is easy to get in and out and the rock jump is fun

reviews.title: Great Family Beach
reviews.text: If you are looking for a beach for your kids to play, this is a good spot. the wife and I were just a short walk to this beach and it was quiet and nice. Good place to snorkel or scuba. Small waves and easy water access.

reviews.title: Pristine beach
reviews.text: So clean, fine sand and turquoise water.  Not crowded at all at this time of year. Best place to watch the Cliff divers too.

reviews.title: Great beach, good snorkeling
reviews.text: This is a great beach for long walks and good snorkeling. You can walk the length of the beach or stay above most of the beach on a boardwalk. Water entry is easy and the beach is so long that you never feel crowded by other people. The snorkeling in the reefs just offshore is wonderful, with a great selection of colorful fish, starfish, corals, plant life, etc. We tried snorkeling around Black Rock nearby as a recommendation from others, but found it had a LOT fewer colorful fish and was quite crowded. Going north from Black Rock to the middle of the long beach provided great snorkeling without the crowd. We even saw sea turtles more than once.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is stunningly beautiful! But when we visited the waves were big and the rip current was strong, so I was afraid to let my kids get in too deep. It’s a sunny beach with few shady spots. Try and stop if you are staying on another part of the island.

reviews.title: Great Public Beach Park!
reviews.text: Kahekili Beach Park gets high marks for good free parking, restrooms, covered pavillion with picnic tables and easy beach access. Look for this one in Ka'anapali.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Such a stunning beach! Not a lot of shade to retreat to, but we saw deals where you can rent an umbrella, a cooler, snorkel gear for two, beach chairs, and boogie boards for the week for a $100. Seems worth it if you plan to beach hop all week!Black Rock snorkelling was excellent along the reef! We saw a turtle!

reviews.title: Ka’anapali Beach
reviews.text: This beach was one of our favourite places to go!  You can snorkel here, swim here, it’s family oriented, not over crowded and a lovely way to spend a beach day, the views, the beach, the sand are outstanding!  Loved this beach day!

reviews.title: Amazing Sunsets
reviews.text: Just returned from Maui. The sunsets on Kaanapali Beach are incredible!! We were just out playing in the water in front of our resort and a huge turtle swam by us!! Absolutely beautiful place!

reviews.title: Clean Golden Sands
reviews.text: Kaanapali Beach extends North past the Royal Lahaina and South to the Hyatt Regency from Black Rock and the Sheraton Resort. The beach is clean and usually has a mild shore break... it is one of the better beaches on Maui.There are two paved walkways North and South from the Sheraton that are used daily by runners and walkers.

reviews.title: Beach bodies!
reviews.text: Awesome clean fun. Nice folks all around us. You will not be disappointed!!!  Well worth the visit. Don’t wait!!

reviews.title: Perfect, beautiful and serene.
reviews.text: What can you say about the most perfect beach on Earth? It’s beautiful and the ocean is always warm. Clean and quiet, a couples perfect beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: The ocean is so gorgeous and the beach too! Went walking and played in the ocean. Just beautiful! It was pretty hot there so we just spent a few hours there but enjoyed! Got to go there.

reviews.title: Trilogy Sunset Cruise Departure from Ka’anapali
reviews.text: We boarded our boat from this beach and enjoyed walking along it before and after our sail. It’s a beautiful, long stretch of flat beach with nice sand and seemingly gentle waves (relative to other spots along the coast). There are many resorts, shopping (Whaler’s Village is there), and restaurants  along this strip and a paved walkway that weaves along the beach as well. It would a great area for an evening sunset stroll (as we enjoyed) and there were many people out with cameras to capture the sunset.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This is where most of the resorts are located. Nice area.  The beaches here are very scenic and waters are so colorful, unlike the murky waters of Atlantic ocean on the us east coastline (Nj, De, Md)

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: This beach is nice but not enough place to swim or walk in the water before to get rock. We can take a very long walk on the beach. Nice sand with no seaweed.

reviews.title: Bath water!
reviews.text: This beach is gorgeous. I stayed there at The Westin Ka'anapali Ocean Resort Villas which sits on this beach. The sand is incredibly soft yet sticky; I brought a bunch of it home (unknowingly, LOL) in the top of my bathing suit! It gets EVERYWHERE! Beware however, the current can get very strong. Pay attention to little ones and I'd discourage using rafts as you will seriously get sucked right out! The water is incredibly warm, even I was swimming in it! I'm from San Diego, and I NEVER swim in the ocean because it's just too darn cold! Clean, lovely beach:)

reviews.title: Black rock was my favorite
reviews.text: The beaches are clean calm in the morning and black rock great for snorkeling.  There are divers of Black rock at sunset.  Lots of good eats along the beach.

reviews.title: Outstanding beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world.Miles of wide sand and crystal clear water which is also warm and refreshing.Lovely scenery and near many amenities.
