reviews.title: Great beach with beautiful resorts lined up for miles!
reviews.text: This is paradise at its best.  Good road (when there hasn't been an accident), ample FREE parking at the resorts and plentiful public access points  between resorts, (or just walk through the luxurious lobbies and possibly stop for a drink).

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The beach at Kaanapali is beautiful!We snorkeled on the beach here and saw fabulous fish and a turtle!

reviews.title: Black Rock Beach Cliff Jump
reviews.text: We came here solely to do the cliff jump and it was a lot of fun! A little tough getting up on the rocks but it's definitely doable. Stayed at the beach for about an hour. Good stop!

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: Super clean, beautiful, and easily accessible beach.  We drove all over the island and Kaanapali was easily in the top 3 beaches

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: This is a gorgeous stretch of beach that is not too crowded and it's usually pretty calm water. this is a great place to get an umbrella and sit in the shade and just listen to the sounds of the waves all day as you nap off and on.  There's a walkway for a nice stroll along the beach.

reviews.title: Great beach for easy snorkeling
reviews.text: Love this beach! I only wish someone would provide hammock and drink service. Water is warm, easy to find fish and still feel secure close to the shore if you aren't an "ocean" person.

reviews.title: Strong waves
reviews.text: Great beach walk. The waves were very strong that we did not get into the water for the three days that that we were there.

reviews.title: Just Beautiful!
reviews.text: This may be the most beautiful beach on the planet, from the brilliant aquamarine color of the ocean to the nearby islands to the amazing snorkeling opportunities to the immaculate sandy beach, this is a beach you need to spend some time on. If you go in the winter months, there will be whales breaching not too far away.

reviews.title: Magical
reviews.text: Avoid cruises time and you'll love this beach. You'll need to bring your own towels, drinks and chairs for sitting if you plan on spending a few hours

reviews.title: Exploring
reviews.text: This place was a hidden treasure! We were able to see waterfalls on our way and all the greenery of the lush island. The winding roads were a little bit challenging. But all in all, this was absolutely beautiful to experience!

reviews.title: AMAZING BEACH
reviews.text: Large white sand beach on the west side of Maui, Hawaii. You can practice any sport and sunsets are incredible! Walking on the velvet sand is something you won't forget...

reviews.title: Beach time before dinner
reviews.text: We stopped at this beach before enjoying a nice dinner. This beach was very active with many people waiting to go out on Sunset cruises  and just enjoying the beautiful scenery. The water was a little rough for those wanting to wade in the water or swim. I would say that this beach is more of a relax in the sand type of place or watching the sunset location. The beach is also located next to a active and diverse outdoor shopping mall.  Would defiantly be back if in the area.

reviews.title: Wow, just Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at the Ka'annpapoli, so beautuful! The condo we had was facing the ocean and the 3 pools. The tradewinds helped cool off the heat. The pools were not crowded and the waves were fun at the beach. Beat vacation ever!

reviews.title: Beautiful expansive beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Kaanapali Alii resort....enjoyed our days at the beach. It wasn't crowded and there were plenty of areas to lounge at. We especially liked the walk-way along the shore.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This was the last beach we visited. I wish it was the first. Enough parking, gorgeous views, plenty of shade, good facilities.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: We visited this beach last. I wish we had visited first. Gorgeous beach, plenty of shade, not rough water at all, great facilities.

reviews.title: Beautiful but no lifeguards
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful. The water is beautiful. Black rock is right there outside Sheraton. Next door is Kaanapali beach hotel. Snorkeling by the rock was a success, we saw the turtles everyday! My only downfall was there’s no lifeguards at all. Upon entering the ocean the current is strong and drops pretty quick and you can’t touch the bottom. Very dangerous for kids. You’d need to be vigilant   at all times. Not sure why the hotels can’t provide lifeguards or the state itself?

reviews.title: Such a fun and beautiful beach
reviews.text: One of my favourite beaches of the many we visited during our 14 days in Hawaii. The waves were so fun to ride close to shore and there was some decent snorkelling too. Our kids (ages 7, 14, 16) all had a great day! Parking was convenient and lots of space to spread out. We loved walking along this beach in both directions.

reviews.title: Spent a week based in Ka'anapali and this was our go to beach.
reviews.text: Spent a week based in Ka'anapali and this was our go to beach. Good parking availability, perfect beach, Northwest end has good snorkeling at black rock (go around the point and the water is clearer), full range of food from  fast to gourmet. When we were there the current was parallel to the beach. Good shopping selection at whalers village

reviews.title: Amazing Location
reviews.text: Great location and walking distance to so many options.   Views are amazing all the time but especially at Sunset

reviews.title: Top 5 beaches in the world !
reviews.text: Just visit , the golden sands, amazing weather, amazing sites and amazing places to eat will make you feel the same way .

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!!
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful beach.. but the parking is not so great! But I enjoyed our visit here! Need more areas with shade.. I got sun burned here.. but it was my fault! Must visit!

reviews.title: Clean sparkly uncrowded white sand beach
reviews.text: Great views, good snorkeling around Black Rock, wide, expansive soft clean sand beach with easy entry into the ocean both side of. Lack Rock at the Royal Lahaina resort area. Not much to see in the crystal clear water but you won’t stub your toe on anything! Been here many times different months and years, always beautiful

reviews.title: Lovely Beach.
reviews.text: We stayed at a hotel on this beach.  It is quite lovely and there is nothing prettier than the sunsets from this beach.  I was disappointed that there is so much erosion in certain parts.  There is a great "beach walk" paved path that runs 1 1/2 miles each way.  It goes past hotels and leads to black rock and lots of great shops.  The beach is widest at the Sheraton and black rock and gets smaller the further south you go.

reviews.title: Beautiful sunsets
reviews.text: I personally think the beaches at home are much better and when we stayed here there was little or no surf , but it is a lovely beach for walking on and watching the sun go down over the ocean

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: So beautiful we vacation in Maui every year the view is breathtaking the beach is so clean and serene

reviews.title: Best Beach in Hawaii !!
reviews.text: There is no better place to play in the water; snorkel, swim, or just sit in the sand and enjoy the day.  Clean, soft sand. All the amenities you need and lots more. Family friendly.  Great Snorkeling at black rock.  Simply nothing negative about this location.

reviews.title: Fantastic colors!!!
reviews.text: Fantastic colors!!! Beautiful view.  Tricky access though (accessible either by a daily cruise,  or by car on a dirt road).

reviews.title: Swim with turtles for free
reviews.text: There is lots of room on this beach. The water is usually clear except after rain. We were swimming with fish and turtles near the rocks on several occasions. Sand is nice but can get hot.

reviews.title: Wide sand and georgeous views
reviews.text: Plenty of sand to share with other holiday makers, and gentle waves. Easy access through Whalers Village or many other beach paths.

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Great beach, big waves, Lots of fun and nice people.i would recommend this beach and would come back again,

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We went here on our second day in Maui! The sands are white and the water is so clear! It probably depends on the day you go but when we went the water was nice and calm.

reviews.title: Skip this beach
reviews.text: No shade, incredible wind gusts and killer undertow. With so many other beautiful beaches nearby, you can safely skip this one.

reviews.title: Nice beach,  but crowded
reviews.text: I know this is a world famous beach, but it definitely isn't the best one on Maui. There are lots af people, a great view, lots to look at.  We prefer space and do not enjoy other people right on top of our space.

reviews.title: Maui traffic sucks for Kaanapali lovers
reviews.text: I loved Kaanapali and enjoyed the ambience, the beaches and the sunset.However the traffic to get into south or east Maui is horrendous at best!If you are planning to visit Haleakalea volcano or road to Hana, you have to get past traffic on a two lane highway which is the only connector between Kaanapali/Napali and the rest of the island.Let me tell you the traffic is terrible. We got back from sunset on the volcano by 9pm and then were stuck in traffic for 1.5 hours at this connecting road before we got back to kaanapali. In order to get to the airport from kaanapali it took us 3 hours on a Thursday evening.Next time I will stay at Kihei or nearby to avoid this terrible terrible traiifc. Better still I'm headin to Kauai or the big island where traffic is a lot easier.I love Maui but I came here to escape the traffic!

reviews.title: woke up to this every morning!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Ali'i in an ocean front condo, 9 floors up. The views of this beach (morning noon & night) were postcard perfect. We loved just being able to walk a minute or two, from beach to pool to beach to pool, etc all day long. This part of Ka'anapali Beach was not a snorkeling beach, rather it was just fun to play in the waves and swim. We enjoyed watching the surfers and paddleboarders. The sunsets over this beach were serene and spectacular! The sand was clean, not littered. We shall return!

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Best beach ever walk out of your condo rt on the beach clean and very beautiful !! Beautiful sunsets ! Great place to go ! Xoxo

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: I’m always on the hunt for turtles- and the morning didn’t disappoint- 5!!  Lazily swimming around.  It’s the highlight of my day!  Looove it!!!  ❤️

reviews.title: Stellar Beach
reviews.text: Our resort (The Westin Ka'anapali Ocean Resort Villas) was just off of this beach so we visited each day. The water was superb, warm and refreshing and the snorkeling was world class, one only needs to venture a few feet from the shores to see an lush reef filled with

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: Our resort, the Maui Aston Kaanapali Resort was right on the Kaanapali beach.  It wasn’t overly crowded, not too rough, and not rocky.  You could walk for a long way along it.  We didn’t see the need to go anywhere else, as this beach had everything we needed right there convenient to our resort.

reviews.title: Whales
reviews.text: What a great place to snorkel, and see whales from the beach, also a great place to check out the stars at night

reviews.title: Best beach on Maui!
reviews.text: We went snorkeling here with our grown children and 6 and 7-year-old grandchildren.  It was fabulous!  We swam near sea turtles, stingrays, eels and lots of colorful fish.  It was so amazing!The beach, itself, is lovely, with a wide and deep expanse of sand.  It is easy to rent snorkel equipment here, and there are outdoor restaurants nearby at the Sheraton Maui.  The water is relatively calm here, as opposed to other Maui beaches where the waves are stronger and the undertow stronger. Plus, we enjoyed watching all the daring people jump off of the black rocks that ring one side of the beach.  Fun day!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Easily one of my favorite beaches.  I am still in awe of how beautiful Maui and the beaches are.  The ocean was very rough and waves were strong, but I read it’s the trade winds, so we went earlier the next visit. This beach wasn’t very crowded and had bathrooms/changing rooms, and a pavilion area. There’s a small Parking lot with limited parking- we were lucky and got great spots.  Definitely worth spending some time here if you’re in Maui

reviews.title: Beautiful breathtaking
reviews.text: Beautiful beaches, picnic tables and seating along the way. Enjoy swimming, snorkling and just looking at beautiful views. The sea turtles come close to shore around 6:00am and 7:00am. Wonderful shopping nearby, with great restuarants Lahaina.

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: In Maui on a cruise, went here and can't say enough about it. Beautiful place. Full family loved it. A must stop.

reviews.title: This beach area has everything you want in a beach resort atmosphere.
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, the area has many conveniences, the atmosphere is ideal for leisurely enjoying your time there.

reviews.title: Nice large beach, accessible lagoon
reviews.text: There are a handful of hotels at this lagoon, which adds to the variety. The lagoon is very nice and accessible to all skill levels. Great for swimming or snorkeling or simply chill at the beach.

reviews.title: Top Rated For A Reason
reviews.text: I read that this beach was rated as the best beach in Maui and, after vacationing here, I can see why. Beautiful sunsets, beautiful walks and the water is so soothing and warm. When we go out the waves are usually challenging but not dangerous. Be sure to check with the staff of your hotel if the waves will be manageable or dangerous when you want to go out in the water. Just sit back, relax and let this marvelous maui beach work its magic on you.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Beach
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful sand beach with sparkling blue water and views of nearby islands. It’s in a high end tourist district surrounded by golf courses and lush landscape. We had a private cabana that was amazing.

reviews.title: Crowded
reviews.text: We were here in 1983. At that time there were few hotels and lots of beach. Now it’s hotel after hotel. The beach is still there, but if you aren’t staying in Kaanapali you need to use one of the small beach access parking lots and walk. Lots of great restaurants, but everything here is pricey!

reviews.title: DANGEROUS WAVES
reviews.text: I don't get it... we were here for 7 days and although this beach is beautiful, it is for 2 reasons: 1) the view; and 2) all of the landscaping and restaurants etc along the walkway.  The beach itself is not great.  When we were there, the waves and the current were very strong and not safe for little kids.  At high tide in a lot of areas there is very little sand.  They also don't allow you to play ball on the beach.

reviews.title: Beach Satisfaction
reviews.text: We are staying at Kaanapali again, steps from the beach, the snorkeling is superb, with turtle sightings, and lots of fish, there are no obvious hazards, the beach is protected from large waves, there is a slight current, but most can outshine that, perfect for families and friends.

reviews.title: It’s a beach
reviews.text: Nothing special. Parking terrible. Maybe good for sunset. Don’t know. Lots of other accessible beaches on Maui. I would not go back to this beach. Crowded.

reviews.title: Best reef and super family friendly.
reviews.text: Great beach for family and younger ones. It’s pretty calm most days with mild waves. The reef is one of the best in the world to snorkel easily with the whole family. Tons of fish and turtles. Beaches are nice with course sand although not very wide in parts. The water is so clear and blue several 100 feet out from shore. Be sure to bring a snorkel mask and a Go Pro to enjoy.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach With a Stretch of Hotels
reviews.text: If you end up staying at the Marriot Grand or Hyatt Regency properties, the beach is right there for you to enjoy.

reviews.title: Beautiful but take care
reviews.text: Long expanse of golden sand. Public access with facilities (restrooms)The beach can be deceptive with some strong waves and currents.Sadly on our second visit a tourist disappeared underwater and was eventually dragged from the water by other tourists. There is no life guard!The tourist was eventually treated by emergency services but it didn't look good for their survival.Few beaches on MAUI have life guards so take care.

reviews.title: Gentle-to-Powerful Ocean Swells and a Clean Beach
reviews.text: Shades of turquoise water, roiling waves, and unblemished sand greet those who come to the Ka’anapali Beach in Maui. During our stay, the water tended to be calmer in the mornings, prior to Trade Winds in the afternoon increasing the size of ocean swells, which made it more difficult for me to stay upright as I tried to walk out of the water. Bring snugly-fitted water shoes and effective sunscreen, as the sand on shore can be scorching to walk on, and uncovered skin can burn. Still, we were mesmerized by the swells, the movement freedom in the water, and we spent every day on the beach.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: There is plenty of sand to play, paddle boarding, wake boarding, luaus, restaurants, groceries, parasailing, fun in the sun. It’s a great place to stay or visit.

reviews.title: See you at the Black Rock
reviews.text: We enjoyed snorkeling at the Black Rock. There were plenty of colorful tropical fish for all ages to observe. The area was shallow and safe enough for children as well. Great time walking on the beach and seeing spectacular sunsets too.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Not many people! Great! Bus #28 is near $ per person. Nature amazing. Water is clean , warm. Live it!!!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful & Relaxing
reviews.text: The sand was soft and pretty. The beach was warm, pretty and relaxing. If you are staying at a resort they have umbrella rentals and chairs for rent on the beaches.It wasn't crowded and plenty of places to set up. You just will have to shield yourself from the direct sun. Enjoy it can't get no more perfect than this!!

reviews.title: Beaches
reviews.text: The sands are pristine, the ocean is a mix of blue and green. Sea turtles swim right by you so don't get scared if you see them next to you.The water is warm and enjoyable.

reviews.title: Perfect Beach for Tourists
reviews.text: ‘Secluded’, public, accessible in a naturally protected sandy beach. What more could you ask for? Parking is an issue but easily solved with pay parking at the tennis club across. I think it’s about $10 (2019$).

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Ka’anapali Beach is beautiful.   Whaler’s Village is a nice shopping center & there are many good restaurants.  Our favorite is Leilanis on the Beach.   We always spend time on this beach and have to jump off Black Rock each time as well.   Great snorkeling off the beach as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful water, rocky bottom
reviews.text: We went to this beach with surfboards and boogie boards. There were great waves of different heights. We had a bit of a problem with how shallow the water was because it could get rocky on the bottom and we would kick the rocks. Other than that, a great beach.

reviews.title: omg best place , will never forget our trip in 2003 with my mom and my daughter for cheer Houla Bowl.
reviews.text: if you are looking for different and away from the norm, this is truely the place to visit. lol and i thought pineapples grew in trees.

reviews.title: Nice vibe ... but not a Caribbean beach !
reviews.text: So the good news are they the sand is nice, some palm trees along, good vibe, not overcrowded. You can rent chairs and umbrellas . Water is nice and clean.The not so good news are that you have only 5 to 10 meters in the water with nice sand, before rocks are felt under your feet. This is not only unpleasant but also unsafe for kids and surfers and adults alike.Also the stretch of sand is quite narrow, not a heck of a lot of physical space.Overall a nice beach with a good vibe, nice shopping and lots of bars and restaurants. But the actual beach is far from a Caribbean beach quality.

reviews.title: Relaxing and Clean!
reviews.text: Perfect beach to tanning, snorkeling, relaxing and swimming!  Rented umbrellas and chaise lounges from our Westin Villas and it was a perfect way to spend the day.  Sand is clean, the reef is right there and water is clear!

reviews.title: Pretty and large beach
reviews.text: With a backdrop of several hotels it's not the most ideal beach, but it's pretty and has a sandy beach. Unfortunately this area gets very windy at times and the sand can be blown and hurt. On the furthest east side of the beach it backs up to the Sheraton and Black Diving Rock (a 30 foot high rock over the water where you can jump off).

reviews.title: This one of the most beautiful places in the world
reviews.text: I have returned here three times and even flew here by myself.  The rainbows seem to come out daily and the cruises are wonderful

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach with bathroom facilities. You need to bring your own chair and anything to eat or drink there's nothing for sale there but the snorkeling is really great there.

reviews.title: Beachy
reviews.text: The waters are beautiful warm and clear!  Sands are very clean.  I am looking forward to visiting again very soon!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Even though it was spring break time, plenty of space on this beautiful beach. We walked up and down the sidewalk; some hotels were very busy, others were quieter, and those sections of the beach reflected the nearby hotel activity. Walked to the far end to go snorkeling and found some amazing fish.  Whales out in the distance!

reviews.title: One outstanding beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful.  Plenty of sandy beach, water sports rentals, snorkeling, diving, public parking, scuba diving.  Many tours operate in this area so you can reserve other thing to do in Maui.  Plenty of beautiful hotels, condos, shopping, restaurants and activities.  Golf nearby.  World class beach which is free to use.  Just pay for parking. Enjoy.

reviews.title: Good snorkeling
reviews.text: My kids and I enjoyed snorkeling here more than we did at some of the other locations recommended by the snorkel shop. Didn't have to go far from shore and saw good variety of fish and creatures.  A little rocky if you want to swim.

reviews.title: An Ok beach for those staying at the big hotels there
reviews.text: This is a decent beach, but parking is very limited and I found no public showers or restrooms.  I would not put it in the top beaches on Maui, in my opinion it's about average.  Hanakaoo beach around the corner has nearly identical conditions with more parking and easier access for those not staying in the big hotels.  I found the beaches south of Kihei to be far nicer.  Unless you're staying in the big hotels on kanapali beach, I'd skip this place.  Wish I'd gone to Makena instead.

reviews.title: Great beach for the family
reviews.text: We were at Marriott, Ocean side and its virtually on the beach.Great access to swimming, surfing, beach activities, parasailing and snorkeling

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach a d place to snorkle. Lots of good food around.Lovely to take long walks on the beach and great waves.

reviews.title: Scenic beach, great paved pathway connecting all the resorts along the beach
reviews.text: Very scenic beach, great paved pathway connecting all the resorts along the beach.  Made for a great morning run from Lahaina to up Black Rock.  Not the greatest swimming/surf beach.  Had more of a shore-break than waves I would consider a good surf spot.  There are lots of coral reefs about 75 feet off the shore that are very shallow, so beware if you are going to snorkel.  And please do not stand on the coral like I saw so many people doing.  It was very damaging to the coral.  The sand is picturesque but can become extremely hot in the afternoons.  The water is warm and crystal clear.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Nice clean beach with a lot of fish to see not far from the shore. Snorkeling was fun and easy as long as you are careful not to get swept out too far from the shore.

reviews.title: Very busy!
reviews.text: This was a very busy beach. We came in July which is peak season so I can’t speak for off season. I would recommend driving the coast and finding a spot where you see some dirt parking and more locals. There was not good snorkeling and the water was murky with sunscreen and too many people! Either way you’re in Hawaii and Hawaii is beautiful just my thoughts!

reviews.title: Beach with Everything
reviews.text: We recently spent 10 days in Maui.  We visited no less than 10 of the islands beaches.  While many are rocky, the water is unbelieveable.  Almost everywhere on the island it is clear and beautiful shades of blue.  What we loved about Ka'anapali beach was that it had a litte of everything.  You could sit in waste to shoulder-high water with nothing but sand at your feet OR you pop on a mask and snorkel and head out into immense "reef" all around the beach.  We saw turtles, tons of different fish, eels, and even an octopus just 100 yards or less from the beach. The only downside is the crowds. However, because the beach is huge, we were always able to find a nice spot to sit and enjoy the sun, ocean, and ocean life all in one visit.  I know people will complain about the rocky nature of many of the beaches, and it did make swimming difficult in many areas of the island, but on this beach, it just enhanced the experience and added more to do.  It was very cool, and a place I would 100% put on my list while in Maui.

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach is an everyday experience in Maui
reviews.text: Our favorite hotel in Maui is the Sheraton Black Rock which sits atop Ka'anapali Beach.  We've stayed at this hotel at least 8 times and have spent many, many hours on Ka'anapali Beach.  As a beach, it is world class with more soft, white sand than you can explore in a single day.  The beachwalk is a convenient way to move from resorts to shopping and restaurants, if you don't mind going with the flow of tourists who are ever present.  Of all things to do on the beach, my favorite ritual is the morning snorkel around Black Rock.  Entering the water from the beach with flippers in hand, there is enough protection from waves to put on the snorkeling equipment to begin the 45 minute swim.  Snorkeling along Black Rock heading out there are scores of colorful fish to be found feeding on the rock and an occasional sea turtle swims up.  As you reach the other point of Black Rock, the coral and underwater landscape continue to provide great opportunities to see many different tropical fish and plenty of underwater sites to explore.Rounding the point brings you into a small bay which is another haven for sea life.  It's possible to snorkel up to where the water is just 2-3 feet deep and there are often turtles in this area bobbing in the surf.  Continuing the snorkel to completely around Black Rock brings you into much deeper water--easily 75-100 deep.  Here you'll find schools of fish--by the hundreds if not thousands--and I've even seen whales navigating this deeper (west) side of Black Rock.   Turning around and swimming back to the starting point will complete the 45 minute snorkel.  It's a great workout and the experience is different every day.

reviews.title: Beautiful Sunset
reviews.text: Beautiful SunsetsNice calm ocean no waves. Not for surfing. Easy to swim Watch out for rocks in the ocean. Long coastline Easy to build up distance if you’re a swimmer and that’s your thing. Just go and check it out. Lovely

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with lots of fun activities - parasailing, jet skiing, surfing lessons, etc.  Also, great restaurants and shopping in the area.

reviews.title: Best beach on Maui
reviews.text: Wonderful clean beach, with plenty of activities including snorkling, dining, shopping, picture taking, family enjoying etc.

reviews.title: Smooth sand right in front of Westin but rocky as you head south
reviews.text: We were looking for decent boogie board waves, and it was pretty calm right in front of our hotel (Westin) so we walked southward down the beach a few minutes where waves were a bit better, but the sea floor was covered in generally smooth rocks and my son got a few small cuts on his foot. Stay northward on Ka'anapali.

reviews.title: The best beach
reviews.text: This beach is the best in the Island. We loved the concrete walkway in case you don't want to walk a long way on the sand. The whaler mall is excellent with all the restaurants and shops. It was a great Way to take in the sights on the beach.

reviews.title: Visiting Maui and Kaanapali Beaches
reviews.text: I traveled to Maui for the First time in January this Year and was really looking forward to the Beaches and the City of LaHaina. My stay at the Hyatt was O.K (Nice Hotel and Restaurants) but they did not warn me that the Beaches were mostly rocky and had Coral a short way off the shoreline.  I was told by a guest to go down the Beash a little ways ant there would be more of a Sandy Area. Well needless to say I did get cut up in very shallow surf and spend much of one day looking for True Sand Beaches that I have Much enjoyed on both the Islands of Kuai and Honolulu.I f You wish to swim and play in the surf, I would not suggest Maui as the Island for that type of Activity although the Island is Beautiful and Had some Great time Shopping, Eating and Drinking in La Haina.

reviews.title: Sentimental Value
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful. It was conveniently behind the hotel I stayed at, Eldorado Maui. It will always hold sentimental value since my fiance proposed here.It's truly a beautiful beach in Lahaina. Waves were a bit too much for me but we came right before sunset. Not sure if there's best times to visit.

reviews.title: Loved this beautiful beach
reviews.text: We went here a few times while visiting last week. Our teen daughters loved it too. Did some snorkeling, relaxed on the beach, and ate at nearby Hula Grill, for lunch. It is a nice beach, not too crowded. There’s a bathroom near the pool at the far end.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches you will ever see
reviews.text: Breath taking beauty. I loved this beach, although busy.. but it is miles long (I dont know the actual length), feels like miles and there is plenty of space for everyone. Try to go out during sunset or even late into the night when there isn't any people noise. We just stood there listening to the ocean crash at 10 pm and it is a memory I will keep for life. It is not rocky like other beaches in the area, the sand is beyond soft. A must see!

reviews.title: One of the nicest beaches in Hawaii
reviews.text: There's a reason there are so many resorts near here.  Ka'anapali Beach is beautiful, and a great place for families to play in the surf.

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, a great deal of tourists come here so the beaches do get crowded! There are many beautiful beaches in Maui, ( its Hawaii, there all beautiful!!)..Maybe take a venture out and see some other beaches like Napili and Kapalua!

reviews.title: Gorgeous, highly recommend!
reviews.text: You can’t look anywhere on Maui without seeing beautiful views and Ka’anapali is no exception. We stayed at the Hyatt right on the water. My husband and son snorkeled all week and saw more fish and turtles off our hotel beach than they did on a catamaran snorkeling trip and at the more well known snorkel bays. We will be back to Ka’anapali!!

reviews.title: Great location - saw turtles
reviews.text: Lovely beach with great snorkelling. Still think one of the best places to stay on island. Snorkelling at black rock is a must

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We spent an afternoon at Black Rock Beach and it was beautiful. The waves were enough for our teens to play in. Wasnt too crowded and we had lunch at the Sheraton after.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We tried to swim in different beaches each day but this one seems to be most kid friendly and we enjoyed ourselves here!

reviews.title: Black Rock is incredible beach !
reviews.text: This beach is located right in back of the Sheraton and parking is tricky unless you stay at one of the resorts on that stretch of Kaanapali beach (Sheraton, kaanapali Alii, Westin, Marriott, Hyatt Regency). I suggest getting to little parking garage early like by 7:45am that has a sign Beach Access parking right next to Sheraton. It is free but literally only like 20 spots max. Climbed Black Rock and jumped twice ( approx 20-25 ft high) and there is great snorkeling with at the base of Black Rock. Few feet over the water is so clear and good boogie boarding waves. On big swell days surfers can be seen surfing behind the Westin.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: This our 3rd time to Ka’anapali Beach. Beach is amazing and not crowded. Tons of activities to do. We have been all over the island and this is our favorite area!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Not really for snorkeling but great for body surfing and boogie boards. Beautiful clear water . Rent or buy beach chairs

reviews.title: The 1.5 mile Kaanapali Beachwalk is a must do!
reviews.text: The Beachwalk is a wonderful way to see the shoreline.  As for the beach, it is best to go during low tide before the water rises.

reviews.title: Great area.
reviews.text: We stayed on kaanapali beach during our visit to Maui.Great sandy beach, plenty of things to do and places to eat. Rent since snorkeling gear and have fun in the water.Very nice area for families edith kids

reviews.title: Go to North side of Ka’anapali beach
reviews.text: Beautiful, sandy beach! Go to the north side of Black Rock to find the real gem - lots of sand but much less crowds (compared to south of Black Rock).  Ok for snorkelling but water a little cloudy on some days. Great for boogie or body boards. Great for families.

reviews.title: surf, sand and sun
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach area is the best place to relax. The beach area is around four miles long with a boardwalk that ties all the different beaches together. There are everything to high end hotels and condos to private homes and public parks in this area. The beach front is open to everyone and has some areas that are very sandy and others that are rocky. The snorkeling is very good and suprises await just off the beach, my son and granddaughter saw a moray eel swimming around twenty yards from the beach. We have spent many vacations in this area and love the atmosphere and the beaches.

reviews.title: Best Beach for Snorkeling!
reviews.text: Awesone surf, but beyond the rocks... a whole coral reef! My family had a blast there and we would easily come again!!

reviews.title: Girls trip 2019
reviews.text: The waves were very very high-hard to stand up in the water. Very windy too. But lovely to sit and watch.

reviews.title: Great beach...but rough surf
reviews.text: The beach is long and beautiful. Be extremely careful of the surf. We had heard about the great snorkeling at Ka'anapali beach, but couldn't find it. Some sneaker waves pounded us pretty hard, I would stay in South Maui for calmer seas next time.

reviews.title: Pretty but dangerous
reviews.text: We stayed on Ka’anapali beach week of July 4. Group ranged from age 7 to 80. The surf was far too rough for most of our group to even wade along the edge. Beach drops quickly and waves break close to shore. I ventured in twice less than 20 feet from shore and both times was swept off my feet and tumbled. I’ll take the Caribbean.

reviews.title: Truly amazing
reviews.text: One of the best beaches we’ve been to. The part in front of the Westin Ka’anapali ocean resort villas has a reef just a few metres out from the shore with beautiful colourful fish and turtles.

reviews.title: Family Trip to Hawaii
reviews.text: Beautiful  location, great time with family.So much to do and see,everyone is so friendly in Hawaii. Can't wait to go back

reviews.title: Awesome Beach
reviews.text: While the surf was mostly calm there were a few rogue waves that caught a few people out.  One young lad was very adept at recovering lost personal items from the surf.  He had recovered 10 pairs of glasses including two prescription eyeglasses a watch and even a pair of dentures! The power of the ocean can be very overwhelming.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We stayed at the Ka'anapali Beach Hotel and we could just walk out of our room and across to the beach.  It was very nice and clean and it wasn't crowded.  My husband enjoyed going snorkeling and it was nice to just walk along in the surf.

reviews.title: Long, sandy beach - great for a quick dip and relaxing
reviews.text: The surf was high while we were in Maui, so it limited our snorkeling and swimming. We went to this beach twice. It's very long, so plenty of room to get settled to relax. There is a reef right off the beach, so you can snorkel when the conditions are right. There are big hotels along this beach, so it's easy to get something if you need it. Public parking is available (get there early), as well as bathrooms.  Very nice!

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful!  Stayed at the Hyatt Regency Resort & Spa and all I had to do was walk outside to get to this beach.  Every inch of it is just paradise and watching the sunset, even better.

reviews.title: Nice beach for swimming, snorkeling, and other activities
reviews.text: We have stayed at this beach twice - for a beach at a hotel with things to do, nice for swimming, and even good snorkeling at a part of it (near black rock), it is a great beach.  You can even see Molokai and Lana'i in the distance!  Just be careful if the surf is high, which happens from time to time (and the first two days of our trip), but most of the time, it is fine.

reviews.title: Beauty all around
reviews.text: My wife and I decided to stop by on a whim in route to Hana and boy were we surprised.  It was a beautiful scenery all around that we'd highly recommend for some cool pictures.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This is one of the better beaches in area. Plenty of amenities and shaded areas for cooling off. Bring plenty of sunscreen.  It is said to put sunscreen on after every trip in the water by the locals.

reviews.title: Great beaches
reviews.text: Went on vacation with 4 young adults. We ate at some of the best restaurants around Lahaina, rented snorkeling and surfing equipment on beach. Some beaches busier than others.

reviews.title: Good place that could get dangerous
reviews.text: We visited with my kids (16, 12 and 9). The beach itself is nice, long and sandy. There is plenty of space where to set your stuff. Public parking is a bit difficult though.We visited this beaxh in the afternoon and found the waves to be very turbulent. My oldest kids loved it. my youngest not so much. There were a lot of people surfing. I'd say this is a good place for older kids and younger adults.

reviews.title: One of our Favorite Beaches!
reviews.text: Why wife and I had the pleasure of traveling to Maui for the second time. Then Kaanapali Beach is one of our favorites on the island. It is adult and kid friendly with a nice sandy beach area. The water is so beautiful and blue.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: The sand is nice but the beach does not have a lot of depth. Also, once you are in the water there are some rocks so consider some water shoes.

reviews.title: Blue, warm water
reviews.text: Spend my retirement celebration here and enjoyed the beauty, sea life, restaurants and sun. Blue, blue water - wading with manta rays, dinner cruise and much, much more,

reviews.title: The Perfect Spot!
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is a beautiful beach and the perfect place for a fun vacation. There are lots of activities taking place on the beach for all ages, or you can just sit and relax in your beach chair. The beach walk takes you by all the hotels and Whaler's Village with many shops and restaurants. You could spend your entire time at Ka'anapali Beach and be happy. It is also the perfect location for venturing off to see the other sights in Maui.

reviews.title: Urban Sprawl
reviews.text: We stayed here one night and glad to leave this huge condominium complex.  The room was very nice but the common areas were crowded with people like rush hour in New York City!  Kids were everywhere and their beach, what little there was, hardly merits a visit.  However get in your car and go around Maui and it’s gorgeous. We moved on to an Air B&B.

reviews.title: Beautiful with fun waves to play in
reviews.text: We love this beach! The beach in front of the Sheridan Resort has plenty of beach front and fun waves to play in. We enjoy snorkeling near black rock and our brave teenagers like to jump off of the cliff!

reviews.title: Beach Peach
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach was a peaceful and beautiful.  The walk along the beach path allowed us to see all the beautiful sights

reviews.title: A must-do for Maui
reviews.text: Beautiful and well-landscaped path along the beach with views that will melt your heart!  This is the Maui that you'll remember for years.

reviews.title: Great Beach and Awesome Time
reviews.text: Pictures of the beach do not die the water justice. Is is so clear and amazing blues. Being able to swim and snorkel with turtles is a super bonus!  What a great time!

reviews.title: Beach keeps you from coming back
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach.  You can see the white sand on the bottom of the beach.  Turtle swims with you. You can spend the whole day there to enjoy the gentle sea breeze.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Accomodations/hotels are close to the beach! There’s plenty of activities to do! The beach can get busy at certain times of the year, certain times of the day for that matter! Going there before 9 am before the beach crowd can let you settle in.

reviews.title: Beautiful sandy beach with perfect body surfing waves and shopping close by
reviews.text: So great to have the hotels right on the beaches but open to all. Walkways go from hotel to hotel to shopping and even a nice park with public restrooms and a payphone! Homes also have easy access and still nothing blocking you from strolling along on the walkway. Beautiful golfing and eateries mixed in with lovely flowering trees and plants. We watched sailboats and parasailing off in the distance and heard that there was great snorkeling. Live music can be heard at times as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful and quiet
reviews.text: I got married on the beach right outside of the Hyatt Residence Club and it was beautiful and elegant experience. The beach was quiet enough for my guest to hear our nuptials but just the right atmosphere for fun and excitement as well!! A++

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Great stretch of beach that offers everything from surfing to snorkeling opportunities. Waves aren’t big, but good for beginners. Black rock is a great place to snorkel but can get a little crowded in the afternoon.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Family friendly, clean beach. Close to town, hotels, food, shopping. The sand is soft. The waves aren’t too bad. It was perfect for boogie boarding and sand castles. My kids ages 6 and 3 loved it. The water is so warm. It’s a slice a paradise!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Once you've been here, it just isn't the same going to the beach anywhere else. The water is incredibly clear.

reviews.title: Soft Sand, Great Amenities
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach offers over a mile of soft coral sand, generally calm for swimming, and loads of good restaurants and nice hotels. The hotels range from cookie cutter national brands to locally owned, our favorite being the Ka'anapali Beach Hotel. Towards the north end is Pu'u Keka'a or "Black Rock," a small vent crater that provides great snorkeling right off the shore, for free.  Get there early for best visibility and least competition for sand and swimming room.  There is a shopping center, Whaler's Cove, about the middle of the beach which has everything from luxury brand stores to an inevitable ABC general store.  There are also restaurants from walk-ups to somewhat upscale, and surf/snorkel beach shops that carry quality stuff.  This beach is West Maui, meaning the warmer and drier side, so be prepared for lots of sunshine.

reviews.title: family vacation on Maui
reviews.text: This is a really great beach.  The black rock at the end of the beach is great for viewing turtles.  There isn't a lot of shade, so if you need some, be sure to get there early and set up on the far right side of the beach closest to black rock.  The beach is soft and the waves are perfect.

reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: We stayed at the ka anapali beach for our honeymoon for 8 days and it was beautiful!!! People were friendly and it is in a great location for finding other places and things to do on the island.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, we had plenty of room for our array of stuff, never felt uncomfortable leaving our things when we went to snorkeling. Not much shade and it does get very windy there, would bring a strong beach umbrella, don’t bring a cheap one as it will get destroyed pretty easily.

reviews.title: Favorite vacation location
reviews.text: This is my favorite vacation location. Beautiful sunsets, gorgeous beaches and condo Ka’anapali Ali’i right next to Whaler’s village for food and shopping.

reviews.title: Rough waters
reviews.text: It’s been 32 years since I was on Kaanapali beach. The waters are pretty and the views amazing but if your a beach lover find another beach. I thought the waters were rough and the beach is small and on a decline. You have many many people and kids making their way up and down the beach so it’s definitely not a sit down and relax kind of beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with little parking
reviews.text: Love this beach.  Beautiful and great water for my teenage daughters to enjoy boogey-boarding.  Parking is tough, so we went pretty early to be sure we had a spot.

reviews.title: Another great day at Kaanapali
reviews.text: Kaanapali never fails to deliver.  Great beach for the entire family and it has changed very little over the 40 years my family has been enjoying the beach.  Usually protected so the waves are small and safe for the little ones and the beach is surrounded by beautiful hotels and Whalers Village which provide all of the food and amenities a family could ever need.  We were happy to find that the beach was not overcrowded during our stay .

reviews.title: Really good family beach
reviews.text: Wide open. Current not too strong. Shade nearby. Clear water. This is a very nice beach to spend the week on.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with waves calm enough to swim and plenty of coral and marine life to check out while snorkeling. Saw three turtles while we were there!

reviews.title: Saguaro Football   State Champions
reviews.text: Our families 27th year of vacationing at Kaanapali. We have nine children and  two sons  were married at the Westin, more engagements and life celebrations have been held here. This year we arranged for our twin grandsons and 18 teammates from Saguaro HS, Scottsdale, AZ football program to do a final team bonding before they all left for college.  We were at the Marriott and it was a wonderful week. Kaanapali offered safety while still allowing these young men freedom to wander to Black Rock, walk to the Hyatts Lual where they danced onstage and were fixtures at Whalers Village for Hula Pie at Leilani’s  The boys all went parasailing, paddle boarding and some took surf  lessons from Tyler. One can never go wrong vacationing in Kaanapali.

reviews.title: Best area of the Island
reviews.text: The Kaanapali beach area of the Island and the resorts that face the beach are some of the best on Maui.  To me the Kaanapali beach is probably the best beach area on Maui.

reviews.title: Excellent Beach
reviews.text: Well first off we loved Maui.  This is a vacation destination everyone that can needs to go too.   Also the beaches are great.  Water has undertow so if tides are high do the pool.   I highly recommend this beach

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The Ka’anapali beach is amazing and stunning. I could of swim in the ocean for days! My only concern being two people were rushed to the emergency room with me being there only 5 days.

reviews.title: awesome and fun ...great waves
reviews.text: this is 4th trip to kaanapali beach and this time the waves were great. lots of whale sightings and the turtles....snorkle and surf, body surf and swim, shells and coral.. mahalo to the ocean....

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Dreamin'
reviews.text: Between Black Rock and the Honokohau River, this is one of the greatest beaches in the world.  It is manicured by hotels and condos along the beach.  A walk takes you past hedges and flowers as well as restaurants and Whaler's Village commercial centre.  The sand is perfect and fresh water showers dot the entrances to the beach.  Beyond the sands are rolling waves and the islands of Lanai and Molokai float along the horizon.  And the stillness of sunsets are a thing of simple purity against a bald sky or compelling multicolored beauty as the clouds float into darkness.      Occasionally Mr. Bubbles comes along and blows large lasting bubbles for kids to chase and play with in the breezes.  And the evening life starts in restaurants gliding along the path into sweet the night.

reviews.title: nice beach
reviews.text: This was a pleasant beach to visit.  It was not crowded when we were there. Our teens enjoyed snorkeling there.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: You can not beat the sunsets. We were staying at the Westin, which was right in the middle of the resort area on the beach. It seems the sun sets right there, right in the middle of the two islands. Amazing views. prob on of the few bright spots about staying on the touristy Ka'anapali resort strip.

reviews.title: A day at the beach
reviews.text: Decided to visit this famous beach and a wonderfully sunny day. The waves were quite dramatic and it was a bit difficult to swim but the view was beautiful, it wasn’t very crowded, and the golden sand went on forever.  My teenage son absolutely love this beach.  Recent shark attack not far from here so that may be a deterrent.

reviews.title: Most crowded beaches on the island
reviews.text: This beach bery crowded, and have very limited places to eat. However, the Monkeypod had amazing Gnocci. Hula grills flat bread is also good. Very few vegetarian options in the area, but the two mentioned was very satisfying. I would stay away from ‘Leilani’s on the beach’, few options and we felt sick after eating here. The Island Vintage Coffee had delish ice coffee. There is a lot of places to rent sunbeds if you are into that, and the beach does not have beds out already, because it’s only allowed to take them out once they are rented. It’s a great place to departure for a day trip on a katamaran, which is really nice. However, I would head somewhere else for more private beaches!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely breathtaking! We have been to many beaches, but this beach has been our favorite so far. The temperature was perfect, and the waves were big enough for boogie boarders and small enough for the little ones to splash in. The sunsets were beautiful too!. Some rocks are hidden in the sand once you get in the water which can hurt depending on where you step and if the waves wash them up. Pictures do this beach no justice, it is truly majestic!

reviews.title: Stung by jelly fish!
reviews.text: The views are fabulous, but the drop off into the ocean is a bit treacherous of the very young and old. Our grandson was stung by a jelly fish, but better that than the shark attack the week before which we knew nothing about til we returned to the hotel and were watching the news.

reviews.title: Parts of beach is dangerous
reviews.text: The stretch of this beach along the big hotels is popular as it is easy.  Walk out the hotel and you are there.  But I think you will find much better beaches just north of there.What I didn’t like is that the waters here are very murky and there is a strong current, especially around Black Rock.I also noticed jagged structures and steel that was sticking out of the sand, presumably left over from the whaling station or other building that were there before.  Some parts also had a lot of rocks past the beach and because of the drop off, you can have rip tides and other hazards.The day after we left the area, a 51 year old man from California was attacked by a shark and died.  He was a bit further out than most people and was experienced swimmer.We usually head up to Napili, Kapalua or DT Fleming for a nicer beach.

reviews.title: Boogie Board and Snorkeling
reviews.text: We used the public parking at Whaler's Village to visit this beach. Good snorkeling near Black Rock and excellent waves for boogie boarding.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely amazing and the views are just stunning left, center and right! Watch our for the coral as there is a lot of it. You can find areas that don’t have it if you want to swim out farther! Great place to relax and have fun.

reviews.title: kaanapali
reviews.text: very nice beach to visit. many options: snorkeling, swimming, surfing, recreation etc.Many touristy restaurants and shops.Long boardwalk to see the many different things to do and see. This is a great beach to bring families or just yourself.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Beach Golden sands
reviews.text: Kaanapali beach is a lovely long stretch of golden sand that’s easy to access. Because if it’s length it never feels crowded despite the resorts along it. We often stay at the Westin Kaanapali Villas and can just walk to it from the pool area but there’s public access as well. There’s nice swimming and good snorkeling right off the beach (please wear reef friendly sun screen that’s readily available).

reviews.title: Undertow too strong for enjoyable time.
reviews.text: Do not recommend as your everyday beach.Beach is shortened in many places by the strong currents. There are other options near by.

reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text: We stayed at westin villas so this put us at the north part of the beach. More slope here with less beach but awesome views , gentle surf and great snorkeling

reviews.title: Seaside.
reviews.text: Great seaside town. Lots to do and see. This is the view from Captain Jacks grill. They have good shopping in the outlets too.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches on Maui
reviews.text: This is a nice wide beach with miles of sand.  You never seem to find it too crowded.   Temperature is pretty constant as the trade winds blow through.   Many access points and worth an afternoon of swimming and snorkeling.

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach by the Hyatt Regency Resort
reviews.text: The beach here was very skinny and quite slanted, making it difficult to enjoy. Also, there was a large divot upon entering the water, where the waves broke and knocked you down. Not a good stretch of beach, but I did notice that further down, by the Marriott Residences and the Westin, it was nice and wide with much level area.

reviews.title: Simply beautiful!
reviews.text: Loved sitting under our umbrella watching the boats and jumpers from Black Rock. Enjoyed a morning walk down the beach walk. The ocean was warm, calm and sparkling clean. Just watch out for the sand on your feet. It is very hot!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: If you stay in a condo along this beach you have almost everything you would want to do. There is a 3 mile sidewalk that runs down the beach, several restaurants with happy hours, breakfasts, lunches, and dinners, a Starbucks, a mall with an ABC store, snorkel rentals, a snorkel cove (Black Rock), and beautiful sunsets! We also took a sunset cruise that boarded right on this beach in front of Leilani’s restaurant. If you load up at Costco’s on the way in, you really wouldn’t have to leave this area at all!

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: Love Kaanapali beach. Beautiful and, because we are used to Southern California beaches, I feel it’s not crowded, and we’ve visited at every season. The water is clear and warm and the beaches are clean.

reviews.title: Snorkeling at black rock
reviews.text: Wasn't a great deal of marine life the day we were there.  The beach is nice. Very convenient showers available. Beach is fairly crowded

reviews.title: Soulless
reviews.text: Although the beach is lovely and the waters are clear. It all feels a little soulless and empty, one of my least favourite parts of Maui because it's not Hawaiian. You could be anywhere; Vegas, Miami beach or anywhere where you can shop in the heat. Lots of hotels and lots of shopping outlets. It amazed me how miserable people looked walking along the pathway that ran behind the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beach was beautiful. The waves can be strong in the afternoon and evening. Very near black rock and whalers village. You can snorkel or if brave enough, jump on the cliff.

reviews.title: Anniversary Vacation
reviews.text: The beach is outstanding. We were there for 10 days at the end of May 2019. The beach was busy but not crowded. There is a sidewalk that runs parallel to the beach from one end of the beach to the other. Hotels and restaurants line the beach which means tourist sometimes crowd the sidewalk. Ample parking and shopping is available at Whaler's Village, a shopping area. The restaurants provide good service and food but they are expensive compared to other areas on Maui.

reviews.title: Beautiful sunsets
reviews.text: Lovely Sunsets but snorkeling can be difficult unless you swim out past the shallows.  Not a surfing beach.

reviews.title: Great surf
reviews.text: Body surfed from 30 feet off the beach. Awesome, clean beach. Nice breezes all day.  Not crowded at all. Best beach in America.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: For a big guy, the sand was tough to walk on but the water is clear with lots to see. Didn't snorkel but everyone we talked to that did, saw a lot without going far.

reviews.title: Best Beach in Maui
reviews.text: This is by far the best beach we went to in Maui.  The Westin has the best beach, however, they were having major renovations going on so we chose the Hyatt.   The Hyatt was great, but the beach at the Westin is the best.

reviews.title: So relaxing!
reviews.text: We love hanging out on that beach. Watching the waves, listening to the ocean. Even though we are living here ... we will never get tired of it. The other day we were at the beach in front of the Hyatt. I picked up trash on the beach (as always, there is plenty to be picked up) and I could not find ANY garbage can anywhere to dispose of it. That is a big thumbs down for me. I took it home. And that's ok. But easily accessible garbage cans would help. : )

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: We really enjoy just being on the beach and in the area. It is very relaxing and there is a lot to do if you are so inclined. Was a little rough this year with the south swell but you were still able to go relax in the waves.

reviews.title: If your going to Maui, this is the perfect spot to lay back and relax.
reviews.text: Stayed off of Ka"anapali Beach numerous times in the Whaler and other hotels, it's one of the best beaches in the world and that's not specifically just my opinion it's been voted as such on numerous occasions by the travel industry. Great restaurants in the area and plenty of shopping too.  However this area may be more suited to the +40 age group and doesn't necessarily have the night life of Honolulu.

reviews.title: Okay beach.
reviews.text: I like the vistas and views but the beach had a lot of rocks.  Also it was very windy during the week we visited and it was rough. This is not the news he’s fault but for me it was okay.

reviews.title: beautiful.
reviews.text: Some beaches are better for swimming than others.  Swim shoes might be good investment.  We loved sitting and watching sunsets and also early morning exploring on the beach.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is simply breathtaking. Love visiting here every year! Been coming here since 2015 and will never stay anywhere else. MAHALO!

reviews.title: Hidden Jem
reviews.text: This was our favorite beach.  Plenty of room, restroom and changing rooms close by.  Seemed to be plenty of parking.  The water is calm enough to swim and snorkel.  There was a shark spotted in the area the day we left...The local safety folks patrolled for a while to make sure it was safe to go back in the water.  The snorkeling in this area was awesome, we swam with  sea turtles. Its our new favorite, we will return.

reviews.title: Fun in the waves
reviews.text: Although the beach is washing out on the south end, it is still very nice on the end by the Sheraton.  It may be my imagination but the waves are breaking a bit harder near the shore line than I remembered in previous years.  It is great fun with boogie boards.  We did not snorkel but plenty were by black rock.  Only negative, some in our group were stung by jelly fish the last day.  Idk much about jelly fish but sounds like they just come in a certain time of year for a few days?  Fun beach and we enjoyed.  I may have felt differently if I had been stung!

reviews.title: Best beach in Maui
reviews.text: This is the exclusive area where you want to stay as a tourist. Private, peaceful, clean, away from locals. It has a great walkway and high end shopping center and restaurants that unites all hotels in the area.

reviews.title: Wonderful Beach Stay
reviews.text: We stayed at a hotel right on Ka'anapali Beach! Safety is the first priority but swimming in the waves was heavenly!

reviews.title: Our Favorite Beach
reviews.text: This is a wonderful, sand  beach with easy access to the water and a few shaded areas.  Black Rock has superb snorkeling, with usually clear water.  The older kids enjoyed climbing up and jumping off Black Rock.  Parking is difficult, we parked at the Sheraton and paid dearly.  Nonetheless, we did it twice because we love this beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited. Fun for teenagers. There were large waves and a strong undertow at times that would be unsafe for small children.

reviews.title: Jim
reviews.text: This is by far one of our best beaches to go to, clean, friendly tress around, if you like to swim and snorkel this is the place, the bathrooms are nice. Parking can be tuff but  I suggest to park across street in the tennis are and walk

reviews.title: Beautiful views, clear blue warm water
reviews.text: This was our 32nd trip to Kaanapali Beach over the last 27 years. We were in the area by The Whaler and Kaanapali Beach Hotel. The views from this beach are remarkable. The water was warm & clear. We spent every single day of our 2 week vacation on this beach. The only downside is the recent erosion of the beach.  The sand has been pulled out to sea and there is so much less to sit on without getting washed out.  We did find a small area to sit that had higher ground and stayed dry for most of the trip. We saw many many people set up their umbrellas & towels on lower levels and they were scrambling to pick up as the waves washed in. Mother Nature always wins.

reviews.title: Parking is non existant
reviews.text: If you are not staying in one of the beach side hotels you can forget about parking. There's a few garage parking spaces but they are always full. By small I mean maybe space for 10 cars. Thats it. The beach is a long strip by the hotels so there is always a lot of people here. We visited lots of beaches and this one has the biggest waves and riptides. Dangerous even for adults. I almost lost a kid. Even if you are only at the edge of the sand it can pull you in. You can drown in 2 inches of water. There are so many beautiful and serene beaches, so unless you stay literally next door in one of the hotels, go somewhere else.

reviews.title: Convenient Beach
reviews.text: Great little beach in front of several resorts and also has public access.  Snorkeling is pretty good especially close to Black Rock.

reviews.title: Fabulous beach
reviews.text: We had a great time walking along the edge of the beautiful blue waters. Just spending time sitting on the beach on the sand was good fun. We built sand castles, no children with us, we did this because we could and it was good fun. It was just so nice to not have crowds around when we were there, the days were nice and warm.

reviews.title: Tricky parking
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach with a lot of resorts behind it. Only negative is if your not staying here parking is limited. All the free spots get taken very quickly so we just parked at Whalers village and got validated at monkeypod. Monkeypod has a great happy hour so it's a no brainer.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a great family beach with plenty of room....the beach is a few miles long and not overcrowded.   The sand is soft.   There are nice restrooms and showers to rinse off and plenty of parking in a nice parking lot.   We had the spectacular luck of seeing humpback whales jumping and playing offshore the day we went and it was thrilling!!    The entire beach stood up and cheered while watching the whales.    The joy we all felt at seeing these magnificent creatures was amazing!!

reviews.title: Our Family Trip to Ka’anapali Villas
reviews.text: We booked three condos at Ka’anapali Villas right on the beach. The place was wonderful for our two week stay. We could play in the ocean, use the lovely large pool, eat superb meals in the onsite restaurant. They also had a free trolley to take you over to Whaler’s Village for shopping and the famous Hula Grill. We also took it over to meet our snorkeling catamaran cruise. Very handy. We would do this again and again. The units were clean, spacious, and replete with Hawaiian decor. There was also a second pool on the grounds. What a perfect location!

reviews.title: Fantastic fun beach
reviews.text: This is a perfect beach in Maui with crystal blue waters and Sandy beaches. There is no coral or rocks near the edges and so families are able to enjoy the water and beach all the time. We interacted with Green sea turtles every day and it was a perfect experience in a beautiful setting with 80° temperature and 77° water.

reviews.title: Great beach in West Maui
reviews.text: This is the only beach I could find without the rocky or reef button which kills your feet, trust me.  Soft sand bottom.  Park at Whalers village and get parking for 4 hours free validation with $20 spent which is easy to do here.  Come early.

reviews.title: Family friendly, quiet, less crowded beach
reviews.text: We went to this beach when we stayed at Sands of Kahana.  The resort sits right on the beach and offers snorkeling equipment and paddle boards for rent which is handy for the family.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Relaxing beautiful beach, loved every minute. Lots of beach side restaurants and shopping. Nice paved walking trail.

reviews.title: Naturally Beautiful Setting
reviews.text: A place offering breathtaking view in any clear day.  Not so much of sandy beach for swimming, but worthwhile to stay and relax.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, rocky around resort area
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful, we stayed at Honua Kai and every entrance around the resorts was rocky with various trees in the water - doesn’t seem fully safe with kids and high tides there. There’s a public beach (airport beach to the locals) that is supposed to have better access, but we did not travel there.

reviews.title: Beautiful, but popular.
reviews.text: It is a long stretch nice 1-2 mile walk. Plenty of space. On main drag of Whaler’s, all the hotels. The water was clear and warm.

reviews.title: Average beach
reviews.text: This was not the beach I expected. Parts of the beach were nearly wiped out by the hurricane last year and have not been repaired. Other parts are OK. Of course the Pacific waters are warm and beautiful, but in all honesty, this beach does not hold a candle to Florida, the Jersey shore, or the rest of the east coast. Sorry Maui.

reviews.title: Vacation with family
reviews.text: Great place to spend a day at the beach. Go early to get a parking spot. Black rock great for snorkeling. Not much shade so take a beach umbrella. Water was quite rough when we were there so check before going.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: We like the beach because it’s close to places to eat, not overly crowded, great views of Lanai and Molikai. This is not a secluded beach but if you want creature comfort’s this is the one for you

reviews.title: Nice beach for walking
reviews.text: This is a long beach that ranges from wide and flat to narrow and steep. Along the edge is a nice path that takes you past resorts and some interesting art.

reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.  Walked from hotel along the shoreline.  Water was great.  We saw people snorkeling and the fire rescue practicing saving people using a board.  There is a boardwalk you can use if you get tired of walking in the sand.  Lots of activity next to the boardwalk like craft show, places to eat and can check out the other hotels for your next visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with lots of resorts on it.  There is also a shopping mall and lots of restaurants and bars to choose from.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This beautiful beach is wide, long, and scenic.  It's great for walking or swimming.  Some shade is available.  This area is extremely developed, with high rise hotels, restaurants, timeshare touts, etc. lining the beach.  Normally, that would be a big detraction for me, but they have done an excellent job of preserving public access.  There is a very pleasant public sidewalk that goes along the beach.  There are also several public access points to the beach as well as free parking at these spots.  You have to look carefully to find them, and arriving early is best if you want to find a place to park.  Many people on this site recommend snorkeling at Black Rock, as did a local scuba tout.  I am a very experienced snorkeler.  Perhaps conditions were unusually bad when I went, but the snorkeling I did at Black Rock was very poor.

reviews.title: An amazing beach.
reviews.text: The cleanest softest sand you could ever ask for. Dark almost navy blue water. An abundance of marine life for the snorkelling enthusiast. Really a treat to spend time there. The only place I shave ever been able swim with sea turtles in the wild!

reviews.title: awesome beach
reviews.text: Surf was kind of high, we loaded a snorkeling cruise from this beach.  But the sand is really soft and there's a wide beach.  Great for playing in the sand or water.

reviews.title: quintessential Maui - picture perfect
reviews.text: This beach is a daily walk for me when in Maui (in part because we stay on it, but also because you can clock an easy 5 miles of exercise while getting an amazing view).I'm fairly confident I left my heart on it, and it is the first and only place in the world that I've seen stars in the sand.   I'm pretty sure from google that these were dinoflagellates, but I've never seen anything like it in my life and would do just about anything to see it again.

reviews.title: A very beautiful and long beach.
reviews.text: This beach is a highlight of our trip here to Maui. We do this walk most days because the views and the sand are more than worth it. This beach has plenty of parking that makes it easy to access. Try it out, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Beach - amazing!
reviews.text: We stayed at a resort right on Kaanapali Beach. Beautiful sunsets every night, and a great place to snorkel! There are many reasons Kaanapali Beach is considered one of the best beaches!!! Absolutely love this place!

reviews.title: Beach visit
reviews.text: My wife and I along with another couple recently were on a 28 day cruise vacation to several Pacific Islands. On this adventure we visited Maui. While on the island we drove to several beaches to see the wonderful sites. We visited Ka'anapali Beach. This beach is very nice with great views of the ocean and the island in the distance.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Good snorkeling right off the beach.  Saw some sea turtles and eels.    Very cool beach with some incredible sunsets

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach offers it all
reviews.text: This is a favorite Beach for good reason.  The beach itself is great for swimming, snorkeling and just soaking up some sun.  A walk way allows access to many restaurants and shopping areas.  Choose your sunscreen wisely - Look for brands that don't have ingredients that will harm the environment (or your body).  The beach area has seen major erosion the last few years and this will be an ongoing threat.

reviews.title: Relaxing and Not Crowded
reviews.text: The water comes up pretty far so make sure to put your things towards the bank. It was not crowded but the people there were very friendly.

reviews.title: Take a stroll on the Beachwalk
reviews.text: We didn't know about the Ka'anapali Beachwalk until we got there. What a great amenity at this resort area! We stayed at the Aston Mahana at the north end of the path and walked all the way down to the Ka'anapali Beach Hotel in a leisurely 50 minutes to enjoy their Sunday brunch. A great way to get to the restaurants at different hotels especially if you're going to happy hour so you don't have to drive. A great way to get your daily steps in with gorgeous ocean views. Put your sunscreen on as there's not much shade along the way.

reviews.title: Beach location
reviews.text: Best beach for easy snorkeling, sunbathing and walking around. Fantastic sand. Plenty of room. Bring your sunscreen!

reviews.title: Killer Beach, nice family spot, not too crowded even during spring break
reviews.text: Killer Beach, nice family spot, not too crowded even during spring break. Wonderful... highly recommended.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: What a beautiful beach, fun to people watch. Even spotted whales while overlooking the ocean from my room!

reviews.title: Maybe not the best beach in the world... but very close!
reviews.text: In front of our resort the beach area is very nice... 60-70 yards between the beach walkway and the water.  Beautiful, clear water, and a good surf to play in.  As many times as we've been here we have never seen the beach area to be overcrowded.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: We have been so happy with our accommodations here. The pool area is amazing, the staff fantastic and the drinks are great! Such a beautiful place to vacation.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Ka'anapali beach is amazing and the beach walk was a great perk! Amazing view...we even spotted a whale breaching when whale season was very near the end.

reviews.title: 40th anniversary
reviews.text: Stayed at the Hyatt for 10 days and had an absolute great time.  Hotel was clean, service was great and people extremely friendly.  Only problem we had was over Easter week the pool didn't have enough chairs for all the guests.  If you didn't go down by 8 am to reserve a chair you couldn't find on if you went to the pool after lunch time.  The weekend after Easter the chair problem went away so its evident during holidays and spring break time look out.  Drinks are on the expensive side at the pool.  Otherwise it was great.

reviews.title: Beautiful sand beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, the sand soft, the water clear. Portions are good for snorkeling, others for swimming. If you want to walk with bare feet through sand and surf and watch an amazing sunset, there may not be a better spot on all of Maui.

reviews.title: Still just as beautiful as ever...after 37 years of coming.
reviews.text: Enjoy a stroll on the walkway, sit in a hammock, eat , shop to your hearts delight. Beach is great as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach - Concerning Erosion
reviews.text: I've spent a lot of time on Kaanapali Beach over the years and have always loved the location. However, my most recent visit was a bit more concerning. The beach, especially in-front of the more Northern resorts, continues to erode. So much so that some of the beach-fronts are just slivers of what they once were. Hopefully there's something that can be done, but if going, I'd suggest the more Southern Kaanapali Beach locations. You'll find a wider beach and more enjoyable experience.

reviews.title: Swim with turtles
reviews.text: Great family beach that features exceptional snorkeling.  While there, we saw green turtles twice that seem to be oblivious to all the humans close by.  Get there early though since it does get crowded with other families.  There is free public parking at the Sheraton parking garage.  Limited spots but you will easily find one if you get there before 8am. Great place too to see sunsets.

reviews.title: Excellent Beach...Postcard Photos!
reviews.text: We visited this beach multiple times while in Maui and were never disappointed.  It can get crowded but there's always space and you'll end up making new friends by the end of your stay.  Waves are great for swimming, and safe enough for kids.  Sandy bottom with a few rocks/shells so you don't need water shoes to enjoy!

reviews.title: Why you come to Hawaii
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, lots of parking and just a fantastic place to sit and recharge.   Nearby amenities for you as well.

reviews.title: The Beach
reviews.text: Great place loved it. We will visit again very nice soft waves you can watch the boats come and right on the beach.

reviews.title: Part of the Maui experience!
reviews.text: A clean, quiet beach with wonderful views of neighboring islands. Swimming, snorkeling, sun bathing, sight seeing or just relaxing, you'll enjoy this family friendly beach. DON'T forget you sun block, especially on cloudy days.

reviews.title: best beach on maui
reviews.text: Put your chairs in front of Whalers Village or the Westin for amazing views of Lanai.  Stay in the late afternoons when the sail boats return and the surf picks up.

reviews.title: Beach was great
reviews.text: This beach was right outside our hotel , The Westin!  It was a great beach to sit and relax!  Plus the water was perfect.

reviews.title: Amazing beach!
reviews.text: I first experienced Ka’anapali Beach in 2006, again in 2007, and most recently just over a week ago.
