It’s beautiful - white sand, warm water, gentle waves but strong enough for boogie boarding and some surfing. The walkway that spans the beach makes it easy to get to the stretch you’re looking for (and also to the shops and restaurant at Whaler’s Village). This most recent visit was during our kids’ spring break and I worried that it would be crowded. I needn’t have - it’s more crowded in summer and even then not bad. Probably due to the fact that the beach is lined with resorts and maybe not frequented as much by locals - but even when we drove past other beaches they were all pretty mellow and not crowded. If you’re making plans to stay in a resort at Ka’anapali Beach, the beach will not disappoint!

reviews.title: More sandy beach as you go south.
reviews.text: This beach really is beautiful and I am so glad we stayed at the Kaʻanapali Beach Hotel, where there is enough beach to sit on the sand and not get hit by the waves of water. The area in front of the Sheraton has less beach and you cannot sit down without the waves reaching you and your stuff! It is also quite crowded at this end because of the snorkelling at Black Rock. There is some shade provided from 2 resort buildings close to the beach (Aston at The Whaler is one of them), otherwise you will need to rent some shaded beach chairs or bake in the sun. There is a lovely walkway along the beach which takes you past beach equipment rentals, restaurants and the Whaler shopping centre. Especially great for morning and evening walks. Lots of resorts here but because the beach is so long, it is not that crowded compared to say, Kamaʻole Beach Park III. During our stay in March, there were lots of water warnings for swimming (big waves) so take care, but plenty of opportunities for boogie boarding and snorkelling too. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: nice view
reviews.text: Our last day at Maui, we went to this place, it was beautiful place, we enjoyed the big waves. bery clear water and not rocky beach.

reviews.title: Turtles and fish and sand oh my
reviews.text: We stayed at the Westin and love the beach here. Water wasnt overly warm but perfect to cool you off from the sun.Nice sand and lots of amenities close by. Great place to relax, get some Ray's and see some underwater wildlife.

reviews.title: Nice beach with beautiful views
reviews.text: Nice stretch of beach to walk along with lots of restaurants and shopping (whalers village). Good for children to play. Beautiful sunsets and views of other islands. Don’t expect to find shells.

reviews.title: Pretty beach
reviews.text: A very good beach, very nice to walk on, beautiful sunset views.  The walkway between the beach and hotels is extremely crowded. There were not a lot of people on the beach, probably due to to many people watching from the hotels.

reviews.title: Snorkeling, beach play and more
reviews.text: Depending on what you want, the beach is fantastic.  Easy access to hotel restaurants and bars (not authentic food and overpriced) but areas in front of the Marriott have long stretches of beach and decent waves while closer to Sheraton and Black Rock are slim stretches of beach, little in the way of waves and a great area to snorkel only 20-30 yards off shore.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I have always wanted to visit Ka’annapali Beach and it did not disappoint.  Clear and beautiful water and soft sand.  It was amazing.  My husband enjoyed snorkeling here as well.  It was a dream come true and we definitely will return.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling
reviews.text: Enjoyed the beach but it is non-existent at high tide. Especially around the Sheraton/Marriott. Luckily we stayed at Kā’anapali Beach Hotel, where the beach was a little wider and there were plenty of grassy patches to enjoy as well. Snorkelled around Black Rock and saw plenty of beautiful fish and some coral, but we got to swim with two large turtles which was amazing.

reviews.title: Westin Villas
reviews.text: Always a great trip. Beautiful and easy. Good pools great area. Snorkeling fun right off the beach, turtles, octopus, without scheduling a tour or a boat ride.

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach
reviews.text: The best thing about Maui is the naturally beautiful things. The beaches, mountains, trees, flowers. This beach is so pretty.

reviews.title: Great beach!
reviews.text: Lots of shade trees for a break from the sun, waves can get rowdy so watch the littles for sure. Plenty of places to set up beach chairs and clean bathrooms.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: As you move from the Black Rock area of Ka'anapali Beach and the Sheraton to the other end which has the Hyatt, you will find that the beach/sand area gets larger near the Hyatt. There is plenty of beach for everyone. If you're staying at one of the hotels on the beach, you can rent one of their chairs and umbrellas or a cabana but if you just want to swim and enjoy the beach, just grab your own towel and get some sunshine. This place is beautiful! Felt safe here.

reviews.title: gorgeous beach
reviews.text: great for snorkeling, lots of turtles, clean, gets windy in the afternoon.Beautiful water, beautiful views

reviews.title: Windy ! Beautiful beach !
reviews.text: Whats there to say, this has to be one of the most beautiful beaches in the world ! If I had to pick a negative was just the amount of constant wind. Would go back in a heart beat.

reviews.title: We saw a turtle
reviews.text: We went to Ka'anapali Beach to practice snorkeling before going on a boat snorkel trip. The beach is easy to access and there is free parking in a small garage attached to the hotel. We saw lots of fish near the coral close to the cliff. And there was a turtle swimming at the surface and it seemed as if he was posing for us. It was great!At sunset, a cliff diver will dive off Black Rock while an announcer tells a story about the tradition of the diver. The sunset was magnificent!

reviews.title: kaanapali beach from honua kai
reviews.text: it is terrible there is barely any sand, and barely any shore, and the ocean drops off pretty quickly and doesn't slope off. altogether,horrible.

reviews.title: Turtle swimming
reviews.text: Loved this beach - soft sand, clear warm waters, and so lucky to see turtles swimming around. Bar far the best beaches for families, with picnic tables, showers and clean washrooms

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Ka'anapali beach is beautiful and the waters are warm and welcoming. We have been to this beach many times and it is never crowded. Very relaxing!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This beach offers everything from snorkeling to surfing. There are areas great for snorkeling and areasFor body surfing. There are moreSandy areas and less sandy areas. He sandy beaches with areas to spread out your beach gear are mostly in front of the Sheraton, kaanapali beach hotel, the Alli and part of the Marriott. The best snorkeling is in front of black rock at the Sheraton and in front of the Marriott. The best body surfing is in front of the alli and Marriott. The beach at the Sheraton seems to have minimalWaves ( seasonal) and is better for little kids.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: This beach is pristine and glorious. The color of the ocean is a varied blue balanced by muted pink sunsets. The location is central for world class hotels and restaurants. Golfing, surfing and pool lounging abound. Give it a go!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Can shop at the village mall for a parking pass validation. Recommend! Surf and waves friendly for beginner swimmers.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Beach, 2019
reviews.text: Stayed on Kaanapali beach at a Westin property.  The beach at this point is a little rocky.  Prefer to stay on the other side of Black Rock, going towards Lahaina.

reviews.title: Lovely surf, sand, water, and view!
reviews.text: Whats not to like when you have such a beautiful location, soft sand, warm water, sunshine, and a great view! Great place to hang out and get wet, suntan, soak in Maui, roll around in the waves, and snorkel. Very family friendly and lots of places to take a break if you get hungry or thirsty too. We will be back!

reviews.title: Great Hotels & Eateries Nearby
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful, but rocky in some areas. There are numerous hotels fronting it that offer stunning views and great amenities.

reviews.title: Reflection and Swimming
reviews.text: Quiet Beach no matter who or how many people are on it.  The waves are mild and swimming was nice.  The water seemed a bit cold at first but was refreshing after a minute.

reviews.title: Beautiful but rocky.
reviews.text: We stayed here at the Westin for 10 days. It’s a beautiful spot but not easy for kids. There are huge rocks along the beach and just under the surf. Water shoes would be a great choice.

reviews.title: Beautiful, fun and relaxing, something for everyone!
reviews.text: We had a lovely day at the beach.  The water was crystal clear and there was some surf for the kids to play around in.  The highlight was jumping off of Black Rock for the teenagers, and we had the perfect view of their adventure from the soft sand!  The shopping area was very convenient for more sunscreen and flip flops, and the beachfront dining was very inviting...something to come back for!

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach, soft sand, soft waves
reviews.text: Great for light snorkeling, swimming in the perfect temperature water, walk along the beach. Sand is nice and soft. Family friendly, lots of hotels behind the beach gives you access to restaurants.

reviews.title: Whales and turtles, sunsets, oh, my!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach!    Simply the best!  We parked at the parking garage near Whaler's.  There's fun shopping and happy hour stops near the beach.  The shops will validate for parking.  We walked the trail along this beach and found many places to enjoy the sunsets.  It was one of our favorite beaches during our trip.

reviews.title: Not the best weather
reviews.text: We had a group beach day here....rainy & windy majority of the morning. Definitely better beaches in the area. Was told there wasn’t any public restrooms and parking was expensive.

reviews.title: Long beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful. Its part of a huge resort planned decades ago. the beach is long. however it planned around resorts. do some research and their are spots where you can find publoc access with great views

reviews.title: Best beach on Maui
reviews.text: Calm water, snorkeling. A board walk from parking and restaurants. We will return several times in the next week. This is also the place to watch the torch lighting ceremony on black rock.  Park at whalers village, buy something at s 15$ value and park for free

reviews.title: Best Sunset Ever
reviews.text: We have visited Maui three times and have stayed on Kaanapali Beach twice. The beach and sunset here is unbeatable and far better than other views. We enjoyed walking on the lighted paved walk path which goes along the shore for quite a ways to all the hotels. When the stars come out the crowds thin out, all is quiet.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We spent the week at a hotel on the Ka’anapali Beach. Beautiful water, lots of nice sand! It seemed like the current was a little intense, and there was kind of a steep drop off, but great beach overall! Would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: Beautiful picturesque beach
reviews.text: Our resort room with ocean views and watching the waves literally roll in. Beautiful, soft sand and easy to walk on for a good work out or jog. Watch out for the waves, they can catch you off guard if too close and knock you down.  Best beach I have ever seen, cannot wait to go back. Mahalo!

reviews.title: Entire family trip with grown children & grandchildren.
reviews.text: We had a fantastic family trip. We were so busy we now need a vacation from the vacation!!! Our entire family was so very pleased to find GREAT snorkeling right out in front of the Westin North & South Towers!!! Our four year old granddaughter LOVED the colorful fish, eels, urchins & adorable Sea Turtles!!!

reviews.title: Great sandy beach
reviews.text: Great for relaxing. Activities available. Fine sand and gentle waves make it a great Beach for families.

reviews.title: USER FRIENDLY BEACH
reviews.text: The beach is a mile long and rather wide, when we went in May 2018 the waters were calm so it would be a great place for the kids to swim. There is also a long concrete walk that you can stroll along as you check out the many shops, eats, drinks and amazing sunsets.Caution, Nov. to March the waters are not so calm so always check with the hotel management about water/surf conditions.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We made the decision to spend most of our week vacation enjoying the beach, It was a good decision. Nice open beach with great views.

reviews.title: Fabulous Beach
reviews.text: We had multiple beach days here while in Maui and same with our previous vacation.This beach is fabulous and the town around it just as charming.Definitely give it a try if you are on the island, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.title: Beautiful! I want to go back now!
reviews.text: I love Maui! Ka’anpali Beach is a favorite. Great swimming/snorkeling, dining and hotels! I would go back during whale season, take a whale watch cruise. It will change your life!

reviews.title: Great Beach and with a view
reviews.text: This is a great beach where you can go for a nice walk. In addition to the actual beach, there is a really nice boarded path along side the beach where you can run, walk, push a stroller, etc. There are a bunch of hotels and resorts along this beach. I stayed at the Royal Lahaina which was very nice. Some resorts have happy hour specials with food and drinks at a reduced price at their pool/beachside bars - this was the case at the Royal Lahaina so you can check with other resorts and find the same kind of deals. I would definitely go back to this beach and stay in this area. Great view from the beach as well.

reviews.title: Perfect beach
reviews.text: Love the gentle waves, perfectly soft sand and ability to get into the water easily. Hotels lining the shore all offer food and drink conveniently. It is the kind of black you see on postcards.

reviews.title: My Idea of Heaven!
reviews.text: I think Ka;anapali Beach is the most beautiful beach I have ever been to. We were there for 10 days (end of Mar-Beginning of Apr) and the sun shone every day, with temperatures in the high seventies (perfect!) The beach extends for miles, and includes a fabulous snorkeling part near Black Rock (north end), and a "Beach Walk" which leads south and passes all kinds of rental stands for beach and water sports equipment, all kinds of open bars and restaurants (with entertainment and special 'happy hour' drink prices, and a wonderful selection of shops. This beach has everything you could possibly want or need for your whole stay on the island!

reviews.title: Great sand and beautiful water
reviews.text: Make sure you hit this beach in the morning since the winds can shift in the afternoon, which completely changes the feel of this beach from calm swimming hole to choppy, windy ocean. Right at Whaler's village where you can park under cover and buy something to get your parking validated.

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: Not hard to see how this is rated as one of the world's best beaches.  The view is fantastic and you can see whales in the distance.  Truly a paradise.

reviews.title: Water was great and clean beaches
reviews.text: We stayed at the Westin Maui Resort and we enjoyed the clean beach and lovely clear water. Fairly water calm for me and my 9 year old daughter.

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: This was the best beach I have visited so far! Stunning views and awesome sunset. Very clean and accessible from the hotel where we were staying.

reviews.title: Best Beach in Maui
reviews.text: Bar none, this beach is THE BEST.  Perfect waves, gorgeous sand, and lots of room to spread out!  I definitely recommend!

reviews.title: Best of Maui
reviews.text: Kaanapali is a prime location. We stay here in the spring and enjoy the great weather, awesome views and the annual whale migration.

reviews.title: most beautiful beach on earth
reviews.text: this is the most awesome beach i have ever seen.  in Kaanapali where we stayed there is a walkway two feet up from the beach which allows you to walk comfortably for more than a mile....many huts along the way with jewelry, shirts, drinks, ice cream, hats, etc.  it's just awesome...no words.  we went in March of 2017.

reviews.title: Excellent snorkeling, only place I’ve seen an Eel
reviews.text: My wife and I snorkeled 7 different beach/corral areas. This area ranked in the top two for diversity of fish and corral. It helped that we snorkeled in the morning when relatively calm. It also helped that we wore wet suits and stayed in the water much longer than without. First eel of the trip! Not as crowded as a couple of the other places we went. We rank this one even higher than the paid for trip to corral beach - supposed to be Molokini but wind and seas were too rough at destination. We snorkeled here 3 years ago and did not have near as much fun. Calm water and wet suits probably made the difference.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Fantastic beach and so close to many amenities. Lots of restaurants to grab a snack when you take a break from the water.

reviews.title: love to walk it
reviews.text: A great beach to walk, sit and relax. Great for picnics as well.can get busy on the weekend but overall I love this beach. limited parking as well.

reviews.title: Maui 2019
reviews.text: Great beach for swimming, boogie boards. Gentle waves. Great location. Only challenge is parking as you need to park at Whalers shopping. If you do not validate they charge you $40 (no joke). But if you spend $15 parking free. But once you are on beach it is great spit with restaurants close by.

reviews.title: Memorable
reviews.text: We stayed at the Sheraton ,snorkeling at Black rock was with in my comfort zone (turtles and tropical fish ),waves on beach were perfect,beautiful pool and good nightly Hawaiian entertainment . Lots of whales spotted for the observant,and lots  of delicious food options within walking distance.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Great beach with nice waves, lots of wildlife-whales and sea turtles right near by. Current and undertow can be strong so just be aware. Good parking as well

reviews.title: Wonderful beach to vacation
reviews.text: This is our sixth visit to ka’anapali Beach.  We love it as there are a lot of activities for both adults and children as well as family activities.  Many hotels to choose from and many restaurants to eat at.

reviews.title: Beautiful location
reviews.text: We stayed at the Royal Lahaina Resort in one of their cute cottages and really enjoyed it. The location was just beautiful - you could sit on the beach and see both Lanai and Molokai in the distance.

reviews.title: Beware the riptides!
reviews.text: This beach is long and covered with a million tourists.About 20 yards out is a vicious riptide. Our family almost lost 3 children to it. Graduation trip to Maui was almost tragic. In my opinion everyone should visit this beach once. Just to let you realize how much you want to stay at another. Ka’anapali and the smell surrounding it is what is wrong with Maui.

reviews.title: A Great day for sunburn.
reviews.text: This beach is gorgeous! And as a result; crowded...One of the, if not THE longest beach in Maui; extending from Black Rock at the North West end, to Lahaina in the South. With plenty of room, although this beach is one of the most popular on Maui and crowded on most days, there is always plenty of room to stake out a spot if you can navigate your way through the expansive, maze-like commercial properties and over-priced resorts. One thing to remember is that there is very little opportunity for shade. The sparse trees and wide sand make this beach particularly exposed to the sun, so go early and bring lots of reef safe sunscreen (avoid those nasty spray-on types as the over spray gets blown into the water and kills all kinds of marine life. Not to mention what comes off of your skin...)We spent a good 6 hours at this beach, playing in the surf, which can get rather high at times... A 10 foot roller caught me while body surfing and stripped me of my shorts to my knees and exfoliated everything between there and my waist when it tumble-polished me onto the beach. Never turn your back to the surf...A great day of fun despite our rough treatment, left more than one of us reddened from sun burn and sequestered to the shade for the next few days.Picturesque, warm, sunny and sandy; if you do not mind large swaths of people (with a respectable amount of space between you) then this is THE beach.If you do not like crowds then move another 5 minute drive to the North or 10 minutes South for less crowded conditions.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. We are staying at the Westin and it is right on the beach. Clean with minimal to no rocks or shells. Lots of options to get chairs or pay for activities such as catamarans, surfing or paddle boarding.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Stayed at the Westin, I'll come back, pool was so popular with my kids it didnt really seem that they cared about the awesome. Beach out our Lanai

reviews.title: Second trip to Kaanapali beach
reviews.text: This beach is excellent! Get there early with your snorkel gear and snorkel around BlackRock. Early birds get to snorkel without a crowd if they get there at about 7:30am. There are plenty of fish to see even if you stay close to the beach. If you go out around the point you start to hear the whales better ( during whale season). I saw a couple Moray eels this time and a couple of turtles. The eels seem to be okay being around people because one of them swam between some swimmers feet and they never knew it was there.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This beach is amazing if you are in Maui definitely visit.   Black rock is awesome it’s frowned upon but you can jump off the cliff. The surf there is pretty tame but you still have to pay attention to the water.

reviews.title: Lovely!
reviews.text: Beautiful views.  All visitors were happy and pleasant.  A wonderful vibe.  The weather was excellent.  Watching whales was phenomenal.  Can't wait to visit again.  Mahalo.

reviews.title: Miles of blue
reviews.text: One of my favorite beaches ever!  So much pretty sand and you can see a couple of the other Hawaiin islands as well.  The sunsets here are to die for! Can hardly wait to go back!

reviews.title: Perfectly sandy and fun
reviews.text: Best beach we’ve been to. No rocks on shore or in water, great waves for boogie boarding for kids, beginner surfing on south end, snorkeling at Blackrock on north end, not crowded.

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: Great swimming beach, with really nice snorkeling opportunities at the Black Rock in front of the Sheraton.

reviews.title: Family friendly beach
reviews.text: We hit this beach to watch the sunset and it was beautiful!  You can also head to Duke's restaurant to have dinner and watch the sunset as well.  There is a great walking path for over a mile that is nice to have a beautiful view of the water.

reviews.title: Catamaran tour and day at the beach
reviews.text: We took an 8:00am whale watching tour with Trilogy that left right from the beach in front of Kaanapali Beach Hotel. There was a lovely view of a rainbow over the ocean as we waited for the catamaran to arrive. After the tour, we set up on the beach for the day. The sand is soft and fine and the views of Molokai and Lanai gorgeous. There is a sidewalk in front of all the resorts we walked along to go to Whaler's Village, where we did a bit of shopping and Aloha Hour. Great day and great beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: It’s a must do.  Beautiful beach with great waves that aren’t too big.  The beach is very busy and not super accessible unless you are staying on the beach.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: We loved the beach and the sunsets I can’t recommend it enough. It’s not to crowed the water is warm. You can spot whales off in the distance and walk the length of the beach s great sunset beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at a condo right on Kaanapali Beach. It was gorgeous and calm and good for swimming. Walked it everyday. Enjoyed the beach walk (boardwalk) as well which connects the hotels and restaurants.Beautiful sunsets too! One of the nicest on Maui!

reviews.title: Fun and Sun
reviews.text: Kaanapali ⛱ Beach is a beautiful sandy beach. Perfect for those morning walks or fun in the sun throughout the day. Caution, the current can be strong the further you swim out. Be safe. Enjoy🌞🌞🌴🌴

reviews.title: Pretty beach
reviews.text: This a very nice beach with public access. You must have water shoes. It has rocks and coral. There is a beautiful view, but not a super beach experience.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Totally delightful Clean and so nice . The snorkeling here in my opinion is better than black rock . Black rock is over crowded and visibility bad . We have loved every minute here

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We swam, boogie boarded, and snorkeled! Each day the beach was different depending on the weather. One day the snorkeling has low visibility, but the next it was spectacular. One day there were virtually no waves and the next it was perfect for boogie boarding. Great shoreline and lost of shops and restaurants nearby.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: We had a great time here. The beach was clean and we felt safe. Everyone there seemed to be having fun!

reviews.title: Gorgeous Sandy Beach for Family, Couples or Singles
reviews.text: I love this beach. Have been coming here for over 15 years and it never disappoints. Beautiful sand, water and the resorts maintain the area from the impact of the tourists. Lots of activity area and the water is safe and warm. Will be back as many times as I can!

reviews.title: Blue blue water Ka’anapoli Beach
reviews.text: Very pleasant beach without the riptides and powerful waves of some of the other Maui beaches. Beautiful water!

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach on Maui!
reviews.text: Gorgeous and popular beach on Maui West Coast....loved our stay here, and not too crowded!  Loved it!

reviews.title: Humpback extravaganza
reviews.text: This has to be one of my favourite beaches in the world, not because of the powdery white sandal or crystal clear water… But because of the sheer volume of activity happening in the ocean.On an average day in February, you can see douzens of humpback whales breaching the water and generally frolicking around, slapping their tails and pectoral fins.Snorkelling is pretty good too, the marine life is fairly abundance although near the shallows the coral is almost all but died out. I didn’t see any turtles but many people who snorkelled saw plenty of turtles which is pretty awesome.You certainly have to watch out for the currents and the conditions, it can at times be pretty dangerous however the people in the resort have access to the snorkelling guide and can give you an indication of how safe the conditions are.

reviews.title: Beautiful area
reviews.text: Great snorkeling nearby: Honolua Bay. (Take tip money for the locals who own this land and allow access to the water; wear shoes, take fins and snorkel gear).Easy to access at Ka'anapali... great walkway on either beach or off the beach path.  Soft sand.  Lots of dining options and hotel options right here.Do NOT order "calamari steak" unless you realize this is NOT beef steak covered with delicious calamari. ;)

reviews.title: Beautiful views of the islands
reviews.text: We stayed at the Westin vacation club. The beach isn’t super deep but it’s beautiful and nice for sunbathing or a stroll without crowds. Much more expansive than the beaches we saw in Wailea like at the Four Seasons and Waldorf where the beach is relatively small and separated from other beaches- offering more privacy but you will likely stay by the pool. Ka’anapali was a very nice change from Honolulu’s Waikiki beach which was fun, but crammed with people.

reviews.title: Great beach, beautiful views
reviews.text: Long beautiful beach, and during whale season a high probability of seeing the beach and play all day.  Lots of hotels with great bars right of the beach.

reviews.title: Sunset
reviews.text: Great view of the sunset. Pull up a chair, order a wine and watch the sunset. I will definitely go back to this beach,

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach.
reviews.text: Very popular area for spending your vacation.  The length of this beach is full of large resorts. ( Sheridan, Kaanapali Beach Resort; The Whaler; Marriot; Hyatt regency, and The Westin)  We've spent many vacations along this beach in a few of the resorts.  Very gorgeous evening sunsets.  Definitely a must!

reviews.title: Busy
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but too many people   I like a more secluded beach   There are plenty of restaurants and lots of bars

reviews.title: Best swimming beach on Maui
reviews.text: I visit Maui often, and a swim at Kaanapali is something I just have to do. The protected space just to the south of Black Rock has deep water swimming and decent snorkeling along Black Rock, usually a turtle to be seen (don't touch turtles, if you haven't heard, or they'll go awayyy). Most Hawaiian beaches can be rough and dangerous at least in winter, watch for shore-breaking waves here--I saw a guy body surfing dislocate a shoulder and get taken away on a cart.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text: Very crowded on a Saturday, parking is available but not very close. A nice place to visit but I wouldn’t want to have to stay there.

reviews.title: Ka'anapali beach March 2019
reviews.text: Just came back from Maui. we stayed at Westin resorts right at the middle of Kaanapali beach. 1. It was very windy and temp around 76 the entire time we stayed there so not beach weather. Very few people were in the water. Apparently windy is normal there and so is the temp this time of the year. KEEP THIS IN MIND. Once inside the water was not bad. So if you are used to Carribean winters and waters---this is not the same.2 Beach is about 1.5 miles long from Hyatt at the southern end to Sheraton at the northern end. It has a nice paved pathway entire distance. Resorts lining the beach are all high rise types. Beach is wide and expansive. The golden sand is soft but not powdery. No seaweed at all--Yay!!3 Water--was very wavy also not unusual for Maui. So clarity was not good with constant big waves. Same with Color--darkish blue not as pretty as the turquoise blue. You can still see your toes so it is not terrible.4 Ambiance---everything closes very early but there are many restaurants lining the strip and all are very efficient. We usually were the last guests in the restaurants at 9 PM. Only the bars in Lahaina Old town open late.  No vendors harassing you.Very clean and polished the entire beach with all the resorts with tropical lush settings.5 Black rock--rocky cove in front of the Sheraton was really cool for Snorkeling. we saw the most quantity and variety of the fish there than anywhere else in western Maui.---------------------------Overall the beach is nice, safe, clean, good sand, no seaweed wide and has a beautiful mountain backdrop. Plenty of restaurants to choose from. But the water does not compare to the Carribean beaches--this one is too windy/wavy/not as pretty color.I would like to go back but the distance from the East coast makes it not worth it.

reviews.title: Amazing beach with great snorkeling
reviews.text: We stayed at the Westin right on the beach and never wanted to leave. The kids went back and forth between snorkeling and the pool for hours. So beautiful!!

reviews.title: Nice beach spoiled by high rise hotels.
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is long and lovely.  Just keep your eyes toward the sea to avoid the jarring view of the line of tall concrete high rises that front it.  Most of the acres of parking are carefully hidden by beautiful bougainvillea.

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: The very reason that we always try to stay at a facility on or near this beach. It is beautiful white sand and clean.

reviews.title: Beautiful!! (Insert palm tree emoji here)
reviews.text: Kids loved jumping off at Black Rock (part of this beach). Underwater it is crystal clear. The sea life is swimming all over making the snorkeling amazing!

reviews.title: Top beach!
reviews.text: Cant really get much better than this. Dont miss it if you're on Maui. We did Sea Maui boat tour from Kaanapali Beach and had an absolute BLAST. Highly recommend

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: We always stay here! We stay on the hotels that are on this path. Make sure you are between black rock at one end and the Hyatt is the farthest to the other end. This is the best beach strip if you have kids.  The waves are not big so you can actually swim and snorkel in the water. There are great corals that wash up so it’s fun to look for those as well. There is lots of and area to set up your area as well. There are lots of restaurants and hotels along this strip as well. You are right by whalers village. There are lots of catamarans and different stands that you can do activities at. HighlyRecommend this area and this beach.

reviews.title: Learned to surf here with my son!
reviews.text: Outstanding beach! Great activities! Fun to learn to surf. Lots of great places to stay. Black rock beach a must for snorkeling!

reviews.title: Perfect swim beach
reviews.text: Lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance. Great beach for boogie boarding and playing in the surf. Black rock is great for snorkeling.

reviews.title: The coral is re establishing itself!
reviews.text: Such a great small beach park. Very good snorkeling on the right side (as you face the ocean. Turtles and fish to swim with. Parking is good if you get there early. Bathrooms and showers are accessible just off the parking lot.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: After spending 5 days visiting a number of beaches and snorkeling spots on the island today was our day for Ka’anapali and Lahaina. We arrived at Ka’anapali Beach about 10:30 and found the steep, narrow beach to be very crowded. The snorkeling area below black rock was also crowded. Visibility was not good. I swam all the way out and around the point and did see a few fish but not in the numbers seen at many other sites that I have been on this trip on the island. I would not go out of my way to visit this beach.

reviews.title: Awesome Sights
reviews.text: Must go must see. Bring a jacket in Feb/March and bring binoculars, photo lens with zoom capabilities. Sunset time colors are beautiful

reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: There are so many beautiful beaches in the Kanapali area of Maui. Try to go to all of them!!! All unique in their own way. Just lovely!!

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach
reviews.text: Fantastic stretch of pristine beach front that stretches several kilometers across some prime high end resorts and condos.  What a great way to relax, sunbathe, daydream and do whatever water activities you want.  Most of all, the sunsets are phenomenal and one can never get enough of sunrises or sunsets.

reviews.title: Quiet and picturesque
reviews.text: Great people watching, quiet, peaceful plenty of space to set up your spot.  We took chairs, umbrella and ice chest from our condo.  Took a picnic lunch and beverages.  Restrooms available at the surrounding hotels. Free parking is pretty much non-existent.  I was surprised that it cost $24 to park for about 5 hours of beach time and shopping.  Stores were willing to validate our parking ticket but we parked in a garage the stores didn’t participate☺️Snorkeling was better than the adventure we paid togo on.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with crystal clear water
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches that I have had the pleasure visiting. The sand was so incredibly fine and soft - the water was a great temperature and not too cold at all for my children. The water did have some rip tide to it, so if you have small children then you will need to be within arms length at all times. Plenty of space on the beach this time of year and the beach was quite long  for a great walk along the water.

reviews.title: The beach is disappearing!
reviews.text: I was horrified when I returned to this beach after a few years absence. The beach was less than 25% in size from what I remember having visited the area last about five years ago. It is now reduced to a strip of sand about 10 metres or 30 feet wide, when it used to be large enough to have loungers and plenty of room for beach games such as frisbee or ball games. Apparently, rising sea levels, higher tides and changing weather and even climate change are all factors. Most west Maui beaches are shrinking. It is very depressing. Also, Maui is becoming very crowded, with traffic problems and parking problems.

reviews.title: BEACH EXPERIENCES
reviews.text: Ka'anapali Beach is a series of connected beaches that differ a little in what they offer.  They are all well suited to sunbathing, castle building, wading, surfing lessions and SUP lessons.  Great beaches for fun in the sun and not super crowded.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches on this planet !!
reviews.text: 3+ miles of beautiful sand and the coastline there is sheltered with the Au'au channel between the island of Lanai and the western side of Maui - the Humpback Whales come between November and April (swimming all the way down here from Alaska) to give birth to their young. They are so abundant in the month of February that the waters between Maui and Lanai and Molokai look like "whale soup."It was where the early Hawaiian Kings & Royalty came to vacation and, it's easy to see WHY when you take a look around.  Maui is definitely "no ka oi."

reviews.title: Pretty but not a walkable beach
reviews.text: Very beautiful but I was surprised how narrow the beach was, esp in front of our hotel. As the beach got closer to Black Rock it widen. I just wasn’t expecting it to be so narrow. Now I know!

reviews.title: Maui's finest!
reviews.text: This sprawling beach has beautiful golden sand, great waves for body surfing, good snorkeling and lava rocks to climb for a dive into the ocean. It's Family Friendly with kiosks to rent loungers, chairs and water equipment. Lots of restaurants and shopping just off the beach make this a destination beach to please everyone.

reviews.title: One of the Best on Maui, but Crowded In Winter
reviews.text: This beach is in front of the hotels and offers a "coastal walk" along the beachfront.   Personally, this is NOT one of my favorite beaches "in the world" as one person listed - but certainly a beautiful beach in Maui - However, it is crowded, commercialized and the hotels seem to make it as inconvenient as possible to enjoy this beach unless you are staying on their properties.  If you aren't with the hotels, park at the nearby shopping center and walk to the beach.  It will cost you, but it is about the only real place to park without staying at the hotels.  A shuttle is provided but seems to mostly run between hotels - check schedule.  This is a  great paddle-boarding beach in winter, and sometimes waves are too large for youngsters so parents beware - what seems to be calm waters can turn quickly into frightening waves for kids.  The sand is a beautiful beige but not the pure white that areas of Florida and Caribbean offer.   I prefer uncrowded beaches without vendors which is why I consider this a beautiful beach but not a favorite.

reviews.title: Lets get wet
reviews.text: We love this beach its a must go to not crowded every one is nice there. Put the chairs out take your ice chest and just relax and have a good time

reviews.title: Whales & resorts
reviews.text: We stayed at Ka'anapali Beach both times we were in Maui.  It is lovely with many sites to see.  It is most definitely touristy with large resort properties almost the full side.  Snorkeling is best done by Black Rock & Will's beach.  In winter, the surf is strong so if you are not a strong swimmer, this will be a challenge.  Restaurants are overpriced for the food but the view is lovely.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach near our hotel! Saw turtles and whales! Clean beach! Great for a sunrise or sunset walk!

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world!
reviews.text: Not joking! This beach has been voted numerous times as one of the best in the world. If you can, go to the north part called Black Rock by the Sheraton. Snorkel around there to see amazing fish and when you snorkel around the corner you can see plenty of turtles. Really cool. North of Black Rock are the latest hotels and resorts. No more space for anything else!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach - plenty to do there!
reviews.text: For a serene, peaceful, beautiful view, sit along Ka’anapali Beach, in the sand, in a lounge chair, at an ocean-view restaurant, in the water, on a boat,….  And just soak in the beautiful blue water, the swaying palm trees, the powdery sand, the surrounding islands, and relax.	Ka’anapali Beach is a beautiful beach, lined with hotels, and many activities during the spring, summer, and fall, and quieter, due to the whales migrating during the winter months (they don’t allow jet skiing, parasailing, etc. during whale season to protect the whales)  You can see Lanai and Molokai from Ka’anapali Beach.  Snorkeling is great near the black rocks by the Sheraton Hotel on Ka’anapali, and you can purchase a fairly inexpensive snorkel and mask at an ABC store, and snorkel right off the beach, often seeing large turtles, many fish, etc.  It is a good idea to have water shoes, if swimming in the ocean, as parts of it have some sharp rocks, spiny sea urchins,…  However, it is a much sandier beach than many on Kauai, so you can still get into the ocean if you don’t have shoes, but you may be more limited in some parts of it.  In front of the Hyatt, at least this February, the waves were a bit smaller than further up the beach, but you could only get in to about waist level, as then there was a sharp reef, that some could get past with water shoes, or carefully floating over it, but there were a lot of sharp sea urchins in the area.  It’s worth getting in the water, but you don’t want to injure yourself.  Many of the hotels will rent shaded lounge chairs on the beach.  In front of the Hyatt, they charged $130/day for a cabana lounger for 2.  If it’s winter months, you’ll want to wait until morning before booking them, because the weather can turn on a dime, and if it’s stormy, it will not be a good beach day.  Some spots rent just regular lounge chairs and umbrellas for less.  You can just kick back on the sand, but it can be nice to have a day or two with a more comfortable lounge chair.  Many of the hotels have lounge chairs only around their pools, and sometimes on a lawn before reaching the beach, which means the walkway along the beach will be in front of you, and sometimes also a hedge, which will slightly impede your view.  Some people purchase small beach chairs at Costco or Walmart when they arrive, to have at the beach, and then just leave them behind.  There are also several restaurants along Ka’anapali Beach, with beautiful views overlooking the ocean.  We went this February specifically to see the whales, which is said can be seen right from the shore.  I saw a few very distant puffs, and one fin waving in the distance, but for me, I needed to take a whale boat tour into the water to see them more up close.  The massive amounts of sunscreen getting into the ocean there is killing the reef, so, while you want sun protection, you may want to find as natural a sunscreen as possible, to help the reefs, as well as for your own health.  The water is beautiful, but it can also be turbulent at times.  Many people often have their belongings washed out to sea with the waves, even when putting their things right up by the hedges at the top of the beach, so be aware of the tides and waves.  And, it is a good idea to always have someone with you when in the water, even if an experienced swimmer.  Some parts of the shore can be fairly calm, and at other times can be rough.  There is a beach pathway that runs all along Ka’anapali Beach, and you can easily walk past the many hotels or to Whaler’s Village of shops, or to the Sheraton for snorkeling or to watch the diving off the cliffs at sunset, or to the Hyatt for their Sunday brunch,….  There is also a Ka’anapali trolley that stops at several hotels and Whaler’s Village if you don’t want to walk from one end to the other.  Parking is expensive, if driving and parking there. There is plenty to do along Ka’anapali, but often the best thing to do there is just to sit still, relax, and enjoy the natural beauty of the area.Why not 5 stars?  The beach can be fairly narrow at times, and your things may not be safe along the beach with waves that can creep up at times, and there are some areas with sharp sea urchins or rocks, so you'll want to be careful, and you are gouged by the hotels if you want a beach chair, or to park.... But, overall, it is a wonderful place to be.

reviews.title: Great beach scene
reviews.text: So easy to relax!  The water is clear and beach is pristine.  Small fun waves to enjoy.  Great opportunity to walk, swim, fly a kite, Boogie boarding, and whale watching.  One day we watched a munk seal rest on the beach.

reviews.title: Great for snorkeling
reviews.text: Beautiful clear water, perfect for snorkeling. The beach was perfect for my boys (8 & 12 years old) to just play in the shore and not get caught in the large waves.  Restaurants and restaurants are nearby.

reviews.title: Stayed At Westin condos-lovely
reviews.text: A beautiful beach...watch the whales.  Lots of available water spots.  Many walking areas.  Very pleased!

reviews.title: Friends and Family Vacation
reviews.text: The number one beach on Maui.  The sunsets are amazing and the view is over the top.  Plenty of areas to just lay out and enjoy the scenery and soak up some sun, but not to much or you will get burned and ruin a couple days of enjoyment on Maui.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Just gorgeousWhite sand, clear water, no wavesAll the hotels in area face the beach, where you can hire seats, beach lounges etc.There is a gorgeous walkway/path which is very popular for tourists to do their daily exercise of walking or joggingBlack is a popular snorkeling area at one end of the beach

reviews.title: Size, quality, support
reviews.text: I found some of the beaches in Maui very small and Ka'anapali was a good size. We ate at a rooftop restaurant with a beautiful view.

reviews.title: Kaanapali beach
reviews.text: This incredible beach is so beautiful. It tends to get crowded so get there early!  You can snorkel with turtles just off the beach and there can be good boogie boarding. You can hear the whales singing near black rock if you just put your face down in the water. Wonderful spot

reviews.title: MASSIVE BEACH EROSION
reviews.text: The February storms in Maui has eroded the once 30 yards of wonderful beach from THE WHALER and NORTH down to only 10 yards.  If you are planning to go there, CALL YOUR DESTINATION and inquire, and be ready to CANCEL.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach...so much to enjoy!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful day at Kaanapali Beach.  We walked along the water & loved the beautiful sand.  We found a spot to relax & watch surf school...many were able to successfully ride a small wave.  We walked toward the black rocks, and saw people jumping from the rocks.  In the little cove nearby we also saw sea turtles swimming near shore.  We also saw a few whale spouts in the distance.  Watch out for the waves-you will get wet!    The sunset was absolutely spectacular!

reviews.title: Water, the "bluest"!
reviews.text: Walk the beachwalk or follow the water's edge to know you are in paradise.  Whales, whales and more whales in Late January and February.You can see them Right-From-The-Shore!!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Our condo unit was at Papakea which did not provide great access to the beach but a short journey down the road allowed us the enjoyment of this wonderful beach. Sunny skies and clean sand and water makes this one of the best.

reviews.title: highly rated
reviews.text: our hotel KBH was right on the beach,  clean sand. clean water.Black Rock was a short walk away.  great spot to snorkel.

reviews.title: Big waves. Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: I have been to the Maldives a couple of years ago. The beach there is calm and quiet. Kaanapali Beach clearly has a bigger wave. good for surfing.A bit too crowded.

reviews.title: Hotel Beach
reviews.text: We stayed at one of the hotels along this beautiful beach walk. Our particular stretch of beach was not the best for swimming, steep with a sharp undertow, but very beautiful nonetheless, and literally just steps from the hotel. Clean and well kept shoreline.

reviews.title: Great beach but busy.
reviews.text: This is a great beach, conveniently right beside Whalers Village for shopping, lunch/supper and wash rooms etc. Very busy though. Centre of the beach is good for waves and calmer further towards Black Rock where it’s good for snorkelling.

reviews.title: Popular but very nice beach!
reviews.text: Our resort was right on this beach, enjoyed long walks along here.  Beautiful, clean shoreline.  Lots of activity with boats comeing & going to pick up passangers for whale tours.  But thatnkfully you can see lots of whales from the beach in this season.  Sand was pretty soft & easy to walk in.  Plenty of restuarnt opportuities along as there are quite a few resorts.

reviews.title: Close to lots of shopping
reviews.text: This was our first beach we went to after arriving in Maui. I loved the near by shopping. The beach was quiet. The weather was windy and rainy, but you can't complain when you are in Hawaii. :)

reviews.title: Nice but busy beach
reviews.text: If you want a secluded beach this isn’t the place for you.  However if you are okay with activity and people, this is a wonderful place. We chose to walk along the boardwalk for a while and then moved over to the beach.  There were crowds at the hotel pools but fewer people were on the beach.  We saw a monk seal napping on the beach which isn’t unusual according to some of the people we spoke with.  You should check out the Penguins in the lobby at the Hyatt while in the area. Don’t forget sun screen even if you are just taking a short walk.

reviews.title: Kaanapali Beach
reviews.text: Great sand and a great stop off for a relaxing afternoon.  Needed more time on this beach but of course had other things to do and at this time there was alot of rain so did not go on other days

reviews.title: Snorkelling
reviews.text: Great beach! Good snorkelling, lots of fish and turtles... hiding in the rocks but you can see them anyway... beach has some public loos on at the entrance. The entrance to the beach is on some slippery, steep sone steps so might not be suitable for people with limited mobility

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is a beautiful white sand beech to snorkel from and whale watch. Along the more expensive resorts but free beech access and parking if you look for signs.

reviews.title: Kaanapali beach
reviews.text: We visited this beautiful beach with our entire family. The older boys 16 and 25 and older loved the large waves. They loved to body surf and boogie board. I would not recommend this beach for children under five as the waves were quite large and riptide strong and my daughters were concerned about their babies. The snorkelling was only average on that day as it was quite windy and the water was a bit murky. But all in all a very fun beautiful beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with some rocks
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this beach, white sand, palm trees, restaurants and some rocks which hurt your feet.I didn't enjoy trying to get out in the water with the rocks, but it is a very nice place to hang out at and walk along. A must see area of Maui in my opinion.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Great for sunset & good snorkeling. We saw a whale breaching from the beach! A little hard to find parking and there are a lot of resorts right there, but the beach wasn’t overly crowded. Very nice sand and calm waters when we were there.

reviews.title: Girls trip!
reviews.text: I would never get tired of that view!  It was absolutely breathtaking!  And during whale season you could watch nature put on a show!  And then look forward to the beautiful sunset!

reviews.title: Always great!
reviews.text: We’ve been coming here for 15 years.  The beach is beautiful, safe, and during this time of year you can spot whales from shore.  Smaller waves, so good for little kids and wake boarders. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance.  Completely touristy but still beautiful.

reviews.title: Great parts, “pick your adventure”
reviews.text: This is a beach that has something for everyone. The southern part was wide and not crowded at all with coral just off the shore (and fish!), fairly calm waves and a chill vibe. A little further north the waves increased in size for surfing and boogie boarding. Further north the beach narrowed and got more crowded but there was more of a “party” vibe and more adjacent restaurants and retail. At the north end near Black Rock the snorkeling is amazing and easily accessible to all. Lots of folks jumping from Black Rock but after seeing what’s under them while snorkeling, I wouldn’t chance it.

reviews.title: Awesome beach with great snorkeling
reviews.text: Nice beach, close amenities, rentals, shopping, and dining, and great snorkeling. Nice walkway to take a stroll any time of day.

reviews.title: Dont miss this
reviews.text: Gorgeous long stretch of beach with restaurants and shopping and hotels. Something for everyone. You can spend a couple hours here or an entire day.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Great place to walk and people watch! Nice boardwalk!Places to eat shop Parking can be hard to find!

reviews.title: Nice in places
reviews.text: A lovely beach in places, especially on the central and north parts.  To the south it is rocky  and not suitable for swimming.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: If you are lucky enough to be on Maui, make sure to visit this gorgeous wide, soft-sand beach with beautiful views of Lanai and Molokai, and- in the winter months- a fantastic place to watch the humpback whales as they frolic in the warm Maui waters before heading back to their feeding grounds in Alaska! Head over to Kahekili (aka Airport Beach) Beach Park on the Ka’anapali Beach for fantastic snorkeling right off the shore! At that beach park there is a beautiful lawn, change house/toilet facilities and beach-shower. Anywhere on Ka’anapali Beach is where you want to be, anytime of the year!

reviews.title: Such a beautiful beach!
reviews.text: This beach seems to go on for miles and is a beautiful, pristine beach with a wonderful miles-long boardwalk full of restaurants, shops, crafts, etc.  If you happen to have a hotel in Kaanapali you don't even really need a car to enjoy all the beauty of Maui.  The swimming and snorkeling is awesome from this beach, and the area known as Black Rock (a rock promontory out into the water just in front of the Sheraton Hotel) is an excellent snorkeling site. One must beware, though.  I will never go out there again without fins and a boogie board.  Both my husband and I got caught in a mild rip and had to be rescued.  We did not bring our fins that year which was a huge mistake.  I know what they say about getting out of a rip, and it is good advice, but VERY hard to follow!  With fins it would probably not have been a problem.  (We were strong swimmers once, but it's hard to believe that age takes its toll.)

reviews.title: Ka'anapali Beach beautiful and hard to leave
reviews.text: Visited Ka'anapali Beach in February of 2019. I spent four days here and had a hard time going anywhere else at least when the sun was up. Whales are seen everywhere.  Especially this time of year.  Beach is clean and not overly crowded when I was there.  A few surfers but there are other beaches if you're looking for that.  Overall just a beautiful place to lay in the sun and relax. Wish I was there now.

reviews.title: Busy, busy, busy Boardwalk
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. The boardwalk along the resorts is extremely busy though. If you enjoy a 'Vegas strip' experience, this is the thing to do.
